Keeping the information as text makes the reader's input grow with the retained history, while compressing it into a fixed number of latent vectors bounds the interface but is typically trained to reconstruct text or imitate reference answers, both of which are scored on sequences the reader never produced. We present MemFold, which optimizes a fixed-budget soft memory by the behavior it supports. A query-conditioned textual memory is compressed into K continuous vectors that form the reader's memory interface, and the reader is then trained on its own rollouts under two complementary signals: group-relative rewards for task outcomes, and confidence-gated on-policy distillation in which a frozen textual-memory teacher re-scores the student's sampled tokens under the textual memory. The teacher is never sampled from, so supervision stays on the student's current distribution and adds no autoregressive decoding; at inference it is removed entirely. Across three Qwen backbones, MemFold attains the highest accuracy we measure on PersonaMem-32K and PersonaMem-128K, with margins that widen at the longer history length, and transfers to PrefEval and LongMemEval without target-domain training. Ablations attribute most of the task gain to the reward term and a smaller additional gain to the teacher signal, and memory interventions show that the reader depends on the instance-specific content of its soft memory.

</details>


### [55] [Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36452)
*Zhenghao He,Bohan Liu,Guangzhi Xiong,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究掩码扩散语言模型(MDLM)并行承诺的可靠性问题，提出无需训练的可靠并行解码方法RPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDLM通过并行预测多个掩码token实现高效生成，但同一次前向传播的预测一起提交时未必可靠。作者发现仅凭置信度无法确定可靠的承诺顺序：序列末端附近的高置信预测可能在上游计算尚未建立前就固定答案，且随着上游上下文不确定性增大，下游预测可靠性下降。

Method: 提出Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD)，一种无需训练的方法。它依据逐层预测稳定性与最终置信度筛选候选，并基于前序掩码位置的累积熵预算进行承诺；对上游上下文不确定的预测予以推迟，其余候选并行承诺，无需固定块调度。

Result: 在LLaDA和Dream上的数学推理与代码生成基准测试中，RPD在评估方法中实现最高解码吞吐量，同时保持或提升准确率。

Conclusion: 并行承诺的可靠性取决于逐层预测稳定性、最终置信度及上游上下文不确定性，RPD通过熵预算调度在提升吞吐的同时保持准确率。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) can generate text efficiently by predicting multiple masked tokens in parallel, but predictions from the same forward pass are not necessarily reliable when committed together. We study when parallel commitment is reliable. Our diagnostics show that confidence alone does not determine a reliable commitment order: confident predictions near the end of the sequence can fix an answer before its supporting computations are established, and downstream predictions become less reliable as the uncertainty of their upstream context grows. At the same time, a single forward pass can already resolve several masked tokens, and predictions that remain stable across the final layers are more likely to be correct. Based on these findings, we propose Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD), a training-free method that selects candidates by layerwise prediction stability and final confidence, and commits them under a cumulative entropy budget over their preceding masked positions. RPD defers predictions with uncertain upstream context while committing the remaining candidates in parallel, without relying on a fixed block schedule. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on LLaDA and Dream, RPD achieves the highest decoding throughput among the evaluated methods while maintaining or improving accuracy.

</details>


### [56] [Memory Consolidation Flattens the Temporal Shape of User Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36457)
*Sugam Panthi,Muhaiminul Yeamin,Siyan Luo,Rabab Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 长期记忆系统将对话压缩为短笔记时会丢失"该事实是否仍然成立"的时态线索，作者提出"aspectual flattening"现象并构建 LAPSE 基准来量化，发现记忆写入模型选择性地压平进行时态，且这种缺失线索会影响下游读者判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆系统把对话转成简短笔记时，可能保留事实却丢失其是否仍然成立的证据（如把进行时的"I am driving a Peugeot"压平为一般现在时的"The user drives a Peugeot"）。这种"aspectual flattening"此前未被系统定义和测量，需要评估其普遍性及对后续模型决策的影响。

Method: 构建 LAPSE 基准，包含仅时态形式不同的配对用户陈述；用 381 对语句测试多个记忆写入模型及已部署管线 mem0、Graphiti、Letta，观察是否选择性压平；再用探索性实验考察读者模型在仅改变存储动词、以及可向用户提问时是否改变"事实仍成立"的判断与行动。

Result: 三个写入模型在 381 对中有 244 对压平进行时陈述而保留其一般现在时配对，反向从未出现；这种不对称在全部 11 种模型配置以及 mem0、Graphiti、Letta 中均成立。仅更改存储动词即可改变三个读者模型对"事实仍成立"的估计；当读者可先询问用户时，三个中有两个在压平笔记上更常不询问直接行动。原计划的记忆使用任务因读者几乎对所有存储事实（含过期）都行动而无法检测该效应。

Conclusion: 记忆写入过程可能系统性地移除后续模型用于判断是否行动的时态证据，造成选择性压平并影响下游决策；这提示记忆系统设计需保留时间/证据线索。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems turn conversations into short stored notes. A note can keep a user fact while losing evidence about whether the fact still holds. For example, "I am driving a Peugeot" can become "The user drives a Peugeot," which drops the cue that the activity is ongoing. We call this aspectual flattening and measure it with LAPSE, a benchmark of matched user statements that differ only in temporal form. We find that memory writers flatten aspect selectively. Three writer models flattened the progressive statement but kept its simple-present match in 244 of 381 pairs, never the reverse. The asymmetry holds in all 11 model configurations tested and in the installed pipelines mem0, Graphiti, and Letta. The lost cue matters to later readers. In exploratory tests, changing only the stored verb shifted all three readers' estimates that a fact still holds. When readers could ask the user before acting, two of three acted without asking more often on flattened notes. Our planned memory-use task could not detect this, because readers there acted on almost every stored fact, even expired ones. Memory writing can thus remove evidence that later models use to decide whether to act.

</details>


### [57] [FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36474)
*Rikhiya Ghosh,Himanshu Kumar,Sriram Venkatapathy,Sahil Wadhwa,Alexandre G. R. Day,Pranab Mohanty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FinRT是一个结构化红队框架，通过自适应策略构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，在消费金融领域大幅提升攻击成功率与严重度，同时降低成本并保持多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在消费金融等受监管行业中，看似无害的用户查询可触发大模型安全漏洞，使回答逼近政策红线。现有自动化红队方法在攻击效果与生成成本间难以兼顾，且将覆盖率、严重度与多样性视为附带指标而非联合优化目标。

Method: 提出FinRT结构化框架，从自适应红队策略中提炼可复用的对抗提示生成器，将面向目标的攻击生成摊销为可复用生成器，并对覆盖率、严重度与多样性进行联合优化。

Result: 在消费金融六个受害模型上，FinRT显著优于自适应搜索基线：攻击成功率近翻倍（32.9% vs. Rainbow Teaming 17.2%），最大对抗严重度提升33%，并保持与迭代搜索方法相当的政策域内语义多样性；同时具备高跨模型迁移性，并呈现特定的受害模型族专化模式。

Conclusion: FinRT通过可复用生成器实现了高效、高严重度且多样化的红队攻击，兼顾效果与成本，并揭示跨模型迁移与受害族专化规律，为受监管行业的大模型安全评估提供了可行方案。

Abstract: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.

</details>


### [58] [Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36475)
*Sumin Hong,Katsumi Ibaraki,Renee Shi,David Chiang,Toby Jia-Jun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文比较人类与视觉语言模型(VLM)在跨模态联想(如bouba/kiki效应)中的选择与注视行为，发现选择对齐不等同于注视对齐，注意力匹配也不能保证跨模态加工的人机一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究多在不同刺激或任务下比较人类与VLM的跨模态联想，缺乏在同一刺激、同一任务下对"选择"与"注视位置"的联合考察，无法判断模型是否真正具备类人的跨模态加工机制。

Method: 让53名人类被试与多个VLM接受相同任务：呈现一个伪词和两张图片，记录其选择及眼动(并公开数据)；对比选择对齐度与注意力-注视相似度(以中心偏置高斯为基准)，并对小模型进行人类选择微调、人类注视训练等干预实验。

Result: 部分较大VLM出现选择对齐，但其显著性图与人类注视的匹配度低于中心偏置基准；微调小模型可使其在选择上达到人类多数投票水平，但注意力仍不如该基准；用人类注视训练注意力虽提升注意力-注视相关性，却不改善选择对齐，单一平均注视图也能带来类似提升。

Conclusion: 在跨模态加工上匹配人类选择、甚至匹配人类注视模式，都不足以作为人机对齐的证据；需要更严格的评估标准来判断模型是否具备类人的跨模态机制。

Abstract: Cross-modal associations are systematic pairings of features across modalities, such as the association of 'bouba' with round shapes and 'kiki' with sharp shapes. Prior work has compared humans and vision-language models (VLMs) on such associations, but often using different stimuli or tasks between humans and models. Here, we ask whether VLMs align with humans not only in choices, but also in where they look when making those choices. We study both VLMs and humans (N = 53), presenting them with the same stimuli, a pseudo-word and two images, and record participants' choices and eye movements, which we release. We find choice alignment in a few larger VLMs, but their saliency matches human gaze less closely than a center-bias baseline, a fixed Gaussian at the center of each image. Fine-tuning small VLMs on human choices brings their choice alignment to the level of a human majority-vote reference on unseen words and images, yet their attention still matches human gaze less closely than this baseline. Training model attention on human gaze raises attention-gaze correlation without improving choice alignment, and a single average gaze map per image position raises it by a similar amount. Matching human choices, or even human gaze patterns, is therefore not sufficient evidence of human-aligned cross-modal processing.

</details>


### [59] [Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36515)
*Faiz Ghifari Haznitrama,Afrizal Hasbi Azizy,Faeyza Rishad Ardi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用潜变量与因子分析方法，分析13251个评测分数、1618个语言模型、456个基准，检验语言模型中是否存在类似人类流体智力的通用智能因子。结果显示通用因子解释力有限（最宽松估计70.8%，多数方案远低于此），内容相似的基准未必聚类，g因子也非由某类主题主导，质疑将通用智能作为可操作开发目标的做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型开发中常见假设：认知能力围绕一个通用、跨领域的智能因子（类似人类流体智力）组织。该假设很少被直接检验，已有尝试规模也小得多。作者希望用心理测量学的潜变量方法，在大规模数据上直接检验这一假设。

Method: 采用潜变量与因子分析降维思路：每个具体问题集表现受领域特异与领域无关潜因子共同影响。数据为13251个已发表评测分数，覆盖1618个语言模型和456个纯文本基准。由于数据高度稀疏，使用多种数据加密与插补方法进行三角验证，以检验结果在不同偏差模式下是否稳健。

Result: 稳健模式有三：1) 通用智能因子在最宽松估计下只解释70.8%的模型表现方差，多数方案中远低于此；2) 内容相似的基准不一定聚在一起；3) g因子不被任何常见主题主导，且缺乏证据表明标准“智力”基准能很好地代理它。

Conclusion: 研究结果与当前在语言模型开发中定义、识别并追求通用智能这一实体构念的努力相悖。针对单一概念能力的策略缺乏支持，因为它必须触及的一阶能力往往部分具有特异性，并在实践中难以识别。

Abstract: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.

</details>


### [60] [When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36535)
*Chenxu Wang,Chaozhuo Li,Xinze Shi,Songyang Liu,Kyrie You Wu,Ziluowen Luo,Shun Zhang,Chenxi Li,Litian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对LLM自我进化中出现的"退化"现象（性能提升后停滞再下降），提出基于可学习信息增益的整体框架ATRI，从系统层面调控训练，实验验证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我进化让LLM用自生成数据迭代提升，但存在自我进化退化问题：性能先升、后停滞、再下降。现有方法仅在组件层面（Questioner或Solver）处理，忽视了自我进化是紧耦合系统。

Method: 提出可学习信息增益的整体框架，衡量某轮相对上一轮提供的新颖、可参数化信息的多少。理论上该增益等于两轮数据分布的KL散度加熵变化。实践中通过让小语言模型拟合上一轮、并用负对数似然对新生数据打分来估计。基于该诊断提出ATRI（基于信息增益的自适应训练调控），在轮内对样本重新加权，并在轮间信息增益持续偏低时停止训练。

Result: 在主流数据集上的实验证明了所提方法的优越性。

Conclusion: 从系统整体视角出发，以信息增益作为诊断与调控信号，可有效缓解自我进化退化，优于仅针对单一组件的现有方法。

Abstract: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

</details>


### [61] [DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36544)
*Divyansh Chandarana,Sandipan De,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 DraftTrace，一个同时捕获"最终作品、写作过程、AI助手交互"三视角的写作环境，用于更好地理解生成式AI时代的写作过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI改变了学生写作方式，仅凭最终作品已无法理解写作过程，需要多视角的写作分析。

Method: DraftTrace 重建文档随时间的发展，并将信号整理为提交级、纵向和班级级分析；在81名研究生的NLP课程中部署，对比学生会话、自动工具生成的LLM回复和复制粘贴式回复。

Result: 产品指标可区分文本表述差异，过程指标可区分文本输入方式差异，两者结合可刻画复制粘贴等情形；交互轨迹显示学生在写作早期用助手澄清问题、后期用于验证答案。

Conclusion: 初步教师调研凸显了多视角写作分析及其可解释性的重要性。

Abstract: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.

</details>


### [62] [Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36550)
*Josepha Michiko Leo,Hyun-seok Min,Yehoon Jang,Irvan Zidny,Jin-Woo Chung,Sungchul Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文以专利权利要求修改为可判定对错的测试场景，构建7385件USPTO案例语料与七探针评测，用确定性五通道指标检验检索是否真正引导修改而非注入模板。对四个前沿LLM的9600次预注册调用显示：没有模型表现出可检测的先验注入行为，检索效应微弱且方向不一致，且该零结论在多种检索器、深度和接地指标下稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）广泛用于专业写作，但"检索是真正引导修改，还是仅注入模板"这一问题很少在"正确"有明确定义的场景中被检验。专利权利要求修改提供了这种信号：审查员指明被攻击的限制并引用现有技术，thus提供逐案例的真值。

Method: 发布三项产物：(i) 7385件USPTO审查案例语料，含XML对齐的修改前/后权利要求、驳回理由与被引现有技术；(ii) 七探针评测组，在固定提示框架下比较随机检索与结构匹配检索两种策略；(iii) 确定性五通道指标（C1-C3及C5为主，C4为补充），无需LLM评估。

Result: 对四个前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet 4、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-4o-mini）进行9600次预注册调用，没有任何被测试模型表现出可检测的经典先验注入行为；检索效应很小且在随机与结构检索之间方向不一致；该零结论在稠密（语义）检索器、检索深度k∈{1,3,5,10}以及改写敏感接地指标下均保持不变。修改局部性揭示了模板通道无法捕捉的模型特异性差异。

Conclusion: 被视为探索性的四格分类法中，先验注入者格子始终未被占据，表明在这些条件下检索并未导致经典的先验模板注入，RAG的作用机制需重新审视。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

</details>


### [63] [SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36590)
*Hankun Lin,Patrick Pynadath,Ruqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SEED方法，将解码器重解释为隐式编码器-解码器，复用验证时计算的深层表示进行廉价高质量草稿，实现最高2.7倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自推测解码在草稿质量与成本间存在矛盾：early-exit低成本但草稿质量差，MTP质量好但每步需完整前向。需兼顾高质量与低成本的草稿方法。

Method: 将标准解码器重解释为隐式编码器-解码器：前若干层作为编码器构建深层上下文表示，最后几层作为解码器出词。编码与验证合并为一步，验证由完整编码器-解码器完成，并缓存已验证前缀的上下文表示供草稿复用。草稿阶段轻量解码器自回归生成多个token，每步条件于缓存表示及先前草稿。

Result: 多个基准测试中，4B规模模型上平均加速最高达2.7倍，优于early-exit和MTP类自推测基线，比SOTA的EAGLE-3快28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。

Conclusion: SEED通过复用验证时的深层表示，实现了廉价且高质量的草稿，兼顾加速与生成质量，优于现有自推测解码方法。

Abstract: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.

</details>


### [64] [Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36617)
*Sebastian Joseph,Zichao Wang,Jennifer Healey,Alexa Siu,Junyi Jessy Li,Ani Nenkova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM能否生成"诱发修改"的问题以改进论文草稿，通过比较GPT与人类审稿人的提问效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM是否能为作者提供有益的、能促使论文改进的提问，并与人类审稿人对比。

Method: 在ICLR和NeurIPS的投稿-定稿配对论文数据集上，比较带/不带完整论文上下文的GPT模型提问与人类审稿人提问的有用性。

Result: GPT生成更多诱发修改的问题，关联更广泛的修改和更多样的内容；但GPT问题中真正诱发修改的比例远低于人类审稿人。

Conclusion: 自动化提问对作者有益；但在需要正确处理长上下文的示例任务中，会削弱推理模型产生有益输出的能力。

Abstract: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

</details>


### [65] [Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36675)
*Ziqi Zhao,Fanqing Meng,Haocheng Lu,Lingxiao Du,Qiguang Chen,Mengkang Hu,Xiao-Ming Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Gödel Forest多智能体框架，将递归自我改进组织为协同进化的搜索树集合，通过动态共享记忆实现深度与广度的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心RSI需训练模型参数来验证数据策略，代价高昂。现有方法陷入两难：单智能体易陷窄方向、缺乏探索广度；朴素并行搜索或大量轨迹共享又牺牲长程搜索深度。因此需要兼顾深度与广度的搜索机制。

Method: Gödel Forest将RSI组织为协同进化的搜索树组合。每个智能体自主生长持久树，依据模型反馈深化、分支或剪枝数据策略以保证深度；并行树探索不同数据区域扩展广度。核心是动态协同进化记忆：智能体将成功与失败蒸馏为紧凑程序性经验，锚定全局排行榜，实现跨树信息共享——某树死胡同警示全森林，突破则催生邻近树新分支。

Result: 在RSIBench-Data的六个领域上，Gödel Forest较单智能体基线平均提升10.70%，并在五个任务上减少墙钟时间。消融显示协同进化共享记忆相较独立并行搜索带来+7.00%增益。

Conclusion: 集体蒸馏是大规模自我改进的关键，Gödel Forest验证了协同进化共享记忆在多智能体RSI中实现可扩展自我改进的有效性。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

</details>


### [66] [ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36684)
*Jianshu Zhang,Keliang Wu,Chengxuan Qian,Xiyuan Yang,Ce Zhang,Ariel Tian,Anbang Liu,Haoran Lu,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出ContextProgress-Bench基准诊断PRM在长任务中的上下文依赖进度估计问题，发现即使读取全部历史，PRM仍会迷失，但提供正确上下文可使误差降低77-82%；进而提出ProgressCompass自主循环，用通用VLM为冻结PRM供给上下文，误差降低63%、排序一致性提升76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体承担的任务越来越长，仅凭最终成败难以反映过程；PRM可提供密集奖励，但在长任务中当前帧往往不足以判断进度，进度依赖历史上下文，即"上下文依赖的进度估计"问题。现有基准多聚焦可从当前观测直接读出进度的短任务，PRM在需要上下文时能否估计进度仍缺乏探索。

Method: 构建ContextProgress-Bench，含24个操作任务、120个episode，覆盖三种设置：State Recall（所需信息出现在早前帧）、Sequence Tracking（步骤固定顺序，需知道已完成与下一步）、Recurrence Disambiguation（相似帧对应不同进度）。设计配对诊断：两次运行输入格式相同，其中一次指令整合正确上下文。并提出ProgressCompass——自主智能体循环，重定向现有PRM，用当前通用VLM补充PRM所需的上下文。

Result: 即使读取完整历史的PRM也会在进度估计中迷失；给定正确上下文后，五个模型进度误差降低77-82%。将同一冻结PRM包入ProgressCompass循环后，误差降低63%，排序一致性提升76%。

Conclusion: 具身PRM并非不能估计进度，而是缺少正确上下文时会迷失。通过ProgressCompass这类"指南针"机制为其提供上下文，PRM可在更长更复杂任务上显著更好地估计进度。

Abstract: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

</details>


### [67] [Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36691)
*Jianshu Zhang,Ce Zhang,Xiyuan Yang,Chenwei Xu,Haoran Lu,Yijiang Li,Yaqi Xie,Katia P. Sycara,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD)任务与Video2Skill基准，评测460个开源VLM从视频流中构建可复用技能库的能力，发现组织事件分组与技能库扩充是核心瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作行为多样但共享少量可复用技能，用技能做规划有助于具身智能体泛化。但智能体只能使用已知技能，需从观察经验中反推技能（规划的逆过程）以积累技能库。VLM能描述单个操作事件，但能否将事件流组织为可复用技能尚不清楚。

Method: 形式化SESD问题：模型按序列观看视频并维护持续更新的技能库以影响后续决策。提出Video2Skill基准，覆盖机器人桌面操作与人类厨房活动，测试三项能力：(i)时间定位操作事件，(ii)将同一变换的事件分组，(iii)决定复用已有技能还是新建技能。评测19个开源VLM，并提出反事实库状态再平衡（CLaRe）监督微调方法。

Result: 19个VLM中许多分组接近随机水平，规模扩大并不稳定带来提升。错误与感知和库更新的耦合方式有关：联合模型把不同变换合并为一个技能；基于文本描述更新库的模型则重复创建已有技能。监督微调（含CLaRe）改善分组，但暴露更深瓶颈：模型巩固熟悉技能却很少扩充技能库，库规模停滞在参考规模一半以下，训练中未见过的变换虽能被时间定位却几乎不被赋予新技能。

Conclusion: 从观察中组织可复用技能对流式VLM仍是难题；识别"现有技能不足"并主动扩充技能库是核心挑战。

Abstract: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

</details>


### [68] [Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36700)
*Pranav Handa,Ariful Azad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模仿真研究揭示RAG/GraphRAG在多轮对话中的评估错配：多轮交互导致性能下降高达21%、不可靠性增加47%，并识别出"翻译迷失"与"对话迷失"两种失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户与LLM对话常从简单问题逐步构建为多跳问题，但RAG与GraphRAG几乎只在单轮、完整表述的查询上评估，存在明显的评估错配。

Method: 基于多轮LLM评估的先前工作，将多跳QA基准问题转化为欠明确的多轮对话，评估10个LLM助手与8种检索系统，共150万次模拟对话。

Result: 多轮交互造成普遍性能退化：相对性能下降最高达21%，不可靠性增加47%，RAG系统同时变得更不准确、更不可靠。

Conclusion: 识别出两类失败模式：一是"翻译迷失"（对话改写扭曲检索查询），二是"对话迷失"（检索成功但LLM无法综合跨轮分布的证据）。

Abstract: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

</details>


### [69] [LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36707)
*Amrita Singh,Aditya Joshi,Jiaojiao Jiang,Hye-young Paik*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LAURA框架，通过知识蒸馏与IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，将教师LLM知识迁移到≤1B的开源学生模型，实现可解释的歧义条款识别，兼顾分类与理由生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律合同中的歧义会给企业带来财务和法律风险。部分歧义可灵活解释而不引发争议，部分则导致重大法律冲突，因此仅靠识别不够，还需可解释的理由分析。

Method: LAURA采用知识蒸馏，结合IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，将教师LLM的知识迁移到≤1B参数的开源学生模型，并用分类损失与理由生成损失的联合目标进行训练。

Result: 在7个基线和7个开源模型上实验，LAURA搭配Flan-T5（250M）在可解释性上超越所有可解释基线，达到SOTA，同时识别性能与最佳的不透明基线相当。

Conclusion: LAURA支持法律与非法律利益相关者就哪些歧义需要进一步关注做出明智决策。

Abstract: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

</details>


### [70] [ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36722)
*Xinghao Chen,Junnan Dong,Cai Ke,Chak Tou Leong,Haocheng Sun,Keyu Chen,Siyu An,Ruizhi Qiao,Xing Sun,Wenjie Li,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Attuner，通过学习查询侧低秩适配来读取冻结的PIC缓存，恢复质量并加速最高3.73倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体反复加载可复用内容（技能、文档、记忆）时重新编码浪费算力。PIC独立编码并以任意位置复用KV状态，但相比全上下文预填充有质量损失。

Method: 先定位损失来源：位置不匹配影响小，独立缓存工件表征可靠；失败在注意力而非KV重算。据此提出Attuner，在查询投影插入低秩适配器，通过蒸馏全预填充分布训练，仅训练不到0.05%参数，推理无需缓存重算或全上下文参考。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B上，跨技能、文档、记忆、代码七项基准，Attuner显著超越先前PIC基线，域内域外均优，匹配全上下文预填充质量，加速最高3.73倍。

Conclusion: Attuner以极小参数代价解决PIC质量损失，兼顾质量与效率，为LLM智能体复用缓存内容提供高效方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [71] [Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36734)
*Ayan Sengupta,Vaibhav Seth,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CaRE-KD，一种置信度门控的知识蒸馏框架，用不确定性自适应优化替代静态目标，解决LLM中教师不可靠问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准知识蒸馏假设教师模型是可靠预言机，但在大语言模型中，教师预测常具高熵和幻觉，导致蒸馏损害学生模型良好的校准先验。

Method: CaRE-KD包含两部分：token级损失CaRE-Divergence，根据师生置信度在正/反向KL散度间自适应切换；batch级认知拒绝机制Revival，当教师比学生更不确定时抑制更新。并通过梯度级分析证明该双粒度设计诱导条件校准机制。

Result: 在8组师生对、11个基准（指令跟随、对话对齐、代码生成、数学推理）上一致优于Skewed-KL、α-β散度等基线。指令跟随ROUGE-L最高+3.2，MBPP pass@1 +2.1，GSM8k +1.7，CollegeMath +1.8，事实性最高+2.5。

Conclusion: CaRE-KD有效缓解不可靠教师监督问题，且Revival可作为与损失无关的通用插件，系统性增强现有蒸馏目标。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

</details>


### [72] [VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36804)
*Yitong Han,Nankai Lin,Juan Luo,Hongyan Wu,Lianxi Wang,Shengyi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，结合CoT蒸馏、SFT、RL和自一致性解码，通过投票引导优势分配解决中文语义纠错过纠与CoT收益传递问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中文语义纠错(CSEC)针对的语义错误比拼写和语法错误更微妙复杂，但研究不足。现有LLM方法面临两个障碍：过纠正，以及CoT推理与自一致性解码之间交互不清，导致CoT的收益无法可靠传递到最终纠正结果。

Method: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，融合CoT蒸馏、监督微调(SFT)、强化学习(RL)和自一致性解码。RL阶段设计符合CSEC最小编辑原则的任务特定奖励函数；提出组级相对策略优化(GLPO)，根据单次rollout奖励与投票聚合组奖励间的差距重新分配GRPO优势，使RL训练目标与推理时的自一致性目标对齐。

Result: 在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam上实验：在CSED-C上以47.72%的F0.5超越所有LLM基线，达到42.15%的最高召回率；在NaSGEC-Exam上以41.55%的F0.5刷新SOTA。

Conclusion: VAA-CSEC通过投票引导的优势分配有效缓解过纠正并实现CoT与自一致性解码的对齐，在中文语义纠错任务上取得领先性能。

Abstract: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

</details>


### [73] [Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36850)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建面向生成内容场景的多模态假新闻数据集Weibo26，并提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR)框架，将生成性信息融入新闻真实性推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成内容日益参与新闻生产与传播，假新闻形态变复杂，而现有研究割裂：多模态假新闻检测只做真实性评估、较少刻画生成性对证据可靠性的影响；AIGC检测只判断内容是否由生成模型产生，不能确立事件真假。需在数据与评估上弥合二者。

Method: 构建Weibo26多模态假新闻检测数据集；提出GAHR框架，结合全局判断与局部校正，使生成性信息参与新闻真实性推理。

Result: 在多个现有多模态假新闻检测基准和Weibo26上，GAHR在真实性检测上具竞争力，同时能有效识别生成内容。

Conclusion: GAHR桥接了假新闻检测与AIGC检测，统一考虑生成性差异与新闻真实性，并验证其有效性。

Abstract: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

</details>


### [74] [Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36893)
*Zhenwen Ji,Lei Jin,Shanyong Wang,Jiaming Lu,Chengqiang Lu,Yi Wu,Yao Hu,Lizhen Cui,Yanyu Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MoCo Rubric，一个两阶段框架，通过共享参数的多任务 SFT 和动量模型机制协调 Caption Policy、Rubric Generator 与 Rubric Judge 三个角色，在五个图像描述基准上取得平均 72.83% 的成对胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 详细图像描述需要兼顾事实准确性、信息覆盖度和清晰度。现有基于评分标准的强化学习通常使用分离模型分别生成描述、构建标准和评判，导致角色间理解不一致；动态标准方法虽交替更新策略与生成器，但评判器固定，分阶段优化仍可能使标准构建与评判滞后于策略优化。

Method: MoCo Rubric 分两阶段：1）角色条件、共享参数的多任务监督微调，使单一视觉语言模型同时充当 Caption Policy、Rubric Generator 和 Rubric Judge；2）Generator 基于当前 Policy 采样的描述、参考描述和图像证据在线构建标准，Judge 提供基于标准的奖励，仅 Policy 接受 GRPO 更新；并用 Policy 参数的指数移动平均更新一个由 Generator 和 Judge 共享的动量模型，使其逐步跟踪策略更新。

Result: 在五个图像描述基准上，MoCo Rubric 取得 72.83% 的平均成对胜率、盲排中的最佳平均排名，以及基于描述问答中的最高平均分。

Conclusion: 通过统一三角色并引入动量模型渐进同步，MoCo Rubric 有效缓解了角色不一致和分阶段优化脱节问题，提升了图像描述质量。

Abstract: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

</details>


### [75] [RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36902)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhongjie Ba,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出事件级证据检索框架ELERF与关系感知证据图网络RAEGNet，解决现有多模态假新闻检测中实体级检索引入噪声、忽视危害差异的问题，并在三个数据集上全面超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态假新闻检测方法多依赖外部信息，但大多基于实体级检索，容易引入与事件无关的噪声；同时这些方法只关注整体性能提升，未考虑不同假新闻实例危害程度的差异。

Method: 设计事件级证据检索框架ELERF，基于新闻的完整事件语义检索外部证据；提出关系感知证据图网络RAEGNet，构建包含新闻-证据立场关系与证据-证据交互关系的有向图，并引入条件危害分支，联合建模真实性与潜在危害。

Result: 在Weibo-21、Fakeddit及自建SSS数据集上，RAEGNet在所有评估指标上均优于多个基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过事件级证据检索与关系感知图建模，并联合建模真实性与危害，可有效缓解证据噪声问题并兼顾不同实例的危害差异，实现更优的假新闻检测性能。

Abstract: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

</details>


### [76] [MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36903)
*Ke Wang,Houxing Ren,Zimu Lu,Yunqiao Yang,Zhuofan Zong,Mingjie Zhan,Hongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文沿长时间跨度和多方交互两个方向扩展Moshi范式，在英中双语上发布57.6k小时合成全双工训练数据（MultiTalkPT/MultiTalkFT）和基于真实录音的MultiTalkBench评测集，并训练出可长时间维持多方双语对话的模型，性能大幅优于Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端全双工语音模型在长上下文鲁棒性和多方交互上受限，而会议、小组课堂、社交机器人接待等真实场景要求单模型长时间追踪、理解并回应多个说话人。进展受数据与评测双重制约：开放多方语音语料规模小且非为codec帧级全双工建模设计；长音频基准偏被动聆听，语音到语音基准多为短时双人对话。

Method: 沿长时间跨度和多方交互两轴联合扩展Moshi范式，覆盖英中双语。构建57.6k小时合成训练数据（MultiTalkPT与MultiTalkFT），支持长时、多方、英中全双工对话，并可控制时长、参与人数、轮次转换、重叠、反馈语、打断、受话人切换和长距离指代；提出由真实人类录音构建的MultiTalkBench，用于评测长时多方双语全双工对话；训练一个双语Moshi风格模型。

Result: MultiTalkBench对话平均时长32.6分钟，包含长距离实体追踪、话题连贯性和受话人选择探针。所训练模型能长时间维持连贯的多方英中对话，并在MultiTalkBench上显著优于Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct等开源基线。

Conclusion: 通过联合扩展长上下文与多方交互能力，并配套大规模合成数据与真实录音评测基准，研究推动全双工语音对话模型更接近真实多方长时交流场景，为开放机器对话提供新的数据与评测基础。

Abstract: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.

</details>


### [77] [BaLEEN: Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities for Context-Aware ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36913)
*Chihiro Taguchi,Yotaro Kubo,Rujikorn Charakorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BaLEEN是一个基于超网络的轻量级框架，可在不微调ASR模型的情况下实现动态上下文偏置，显著降低关键词漏检率并改善整体识别率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR在转录特定领域实体和罕见专有名词时仍有较大困难，需要一种无需微调、轻量的动态上下文适配方法。

Method: 用预训练语言模型编码变长上下文关键词，经Perceiver瓶颈压缩为固定长度隐向量序列，并将上下文相关的偏置向量直接注入ASR编码器中间表示；语言模型和ASR主干均冻结，作为即插即用适配器。

Result: 在基于CTC的ASR模型和Wikipedia语料上测试，相比无偏置基线，关键词漏检率降低8.7%，词错误率改善21%，字符错误率改善28%；上下文偏置预计算时推理零额外开销。

Conclusion: BaLEEN提供了一种无需微调、轻量且高效的动态上下文偏置方案，能有效提升ASR对领域实体和专有名词的识别性能。

Abstract: Transcribing domain-specific entities and rare proper nouns remains a major challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). In this paper, we propose BaLEEN (Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities), a lightweight, hypernetwork-based framework for dynamic contextual adaptation without fine-tuning the underlying ASR model. BaLEEN encodes variable-length contextual keywords using a pretrained language model, compresses them into a fixed sequence of latent vectors via a Perceiver bottleneck, and injects context-dependent bias vectors directly into the intermediate encoder representations of the ASR model. Because both the language model and the backbone ASR model remain entirely frozen during training, BaLEEN operates as a plug-and-play adapter that incurs zero computational overhead at inference time when context biases are precomputed. We evaluate our method on a CTC-based ASR model using a Wikipedia-derived corpus with annotated named entities and synthetic speech. Experimental results demonstrate that BaLEEN reduces keyword miss rate by 8.7% on the test set relative to the unbiased baseline while simultaneously improving overall word error rate by 21% and character error rate by 28%.

</details>


### [78] [Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36914)
*Jiacheng Guo,Suozhi Huang,Shuzhen Li,Yunlong Gao,Zerui Cheng,Jason Ge,Shushu Liang,Zihao Li,Hao Lu,Ming Yin,Shilong Liu,Jiashuo Liu,Xu Kuang,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究后训练能否提升语言模型在金融市场预测上的能力。在时间顺序的股价沙盒中，用SFT加PPO训练Qwen3-4B得到AURA-4B，方向-幅度得分从20.94翻倍到43.31，接近前沿模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练在数学推理、软件工程等"结果可验证"任务上效果显著，但金融市场预测的结果带有噪声，且相关信息系统不明，模型需自行决定收集哪些信息并在结果未知前给出数值判断，因此后训练是否有效尚不清楚。

Method: 构建时间顺序的股价沙盒，模型收集价格、成交量、相对表现和市场背景证据并预测未来收益。先用工具使用示范对Qwen3-4B做SFT，再用PPO以终端奖励（预测评分对比实际收益）进行后训练，得到AURA-4B。

Result: 方向-幅度得分从20.94提升到43.31（翻倍以上）；条件幅度一致率从33.3升至66.2；方向准确率从62.9变为65.4。SFT扩大工具使用，PPO进一步提升排序和市场背景查询的比例。

Conclusion: 在该结果选择性基准上，后训练能显著改善金融预测表现，并改变模型调查市场的方式。

Abstract: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

</details>


### [79] [Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36920)
*Fernando López,Pablo Gómez,David Solans,Paulo Villegas,Jordi Luque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对11个ASR系统（10个开源模型+1个商业API）在5种伊比利亚语言（含德语、土耳其语对照）上进行基准评测，基于85小时数据评估准确率（WER）与效率（RTF/RTFx），揭示了准确率、效率与语言覆盖之间的权衡、低资源语言（尤其巴斯克语）的显著退化，以及跨系统一致的性别差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伊比利亚语言的ASR综合评价仍有限，低资源语言、偏见和效率权衡尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 对11个系统（10个开源权重模型+1个商业API）在5种伊比利亚语言（巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语、加利西亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语）上进行基准测试，并以德语和土耳其语作为对照。评测使用覆盖朗读语音、广播媒体和有声读物的85小时数据集，通过WER和RTF/RTFx评估准确率与效率。

Result: 没有单一模型占优：准确率、效率和语言覆盖存在明显权衡。低资源语言（尤其巴斯克语）性能显著退化，凸显训练覆盖的作用。大多数系统存在一致的性别差异。

Conclusion: 该基准为现实场景下的模型选择提供了实用指导，并揭示了多语言ASR中的公平性挑战。

Abstract: Comprehensive evaluations of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for Iberian languages remain limited, and low-resource languages, biases, and efficiency trade-offs are underexplored. We benchmark eleven systems, ten open-weight models and one commercial API, across five Iberian languages (Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese, Spanish), with German and Turkish as controls. Evaluation uses an 85-hour dataset covering read speech, broadcast media, and audiobooks, assessing accuracy and efficiency via word error rate (WER) and real-time factors (RTF/RTFx). Results show no single model dominates: accuracy, efficiency, and language coverage present clear trade-offs. Low-resource languages, especially Basque, degrade significantly, highlighting the role of training coverage. We observe consistent sex disparities across most systems, highlighting fairness challenges in multilingual ASR. Overall, the benchmark provides practical guidance for real-world model selection.

</details>


### [80] [Dating the Model: Hidden Dates in System Prompts Affect LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36931)
*Mario Sanz-Guerrero,Minh Duc Bui,Manuel Mager,Katharina von der Wense*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现LLM系统提示中被隐藏注入当前日期，导致输出仅因日期变化而产生波动，影响性能与排名，威胁可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现性是科学研究的基础，先前研究已表明LLM输出会随硬件与批处理变化。作者指出一个被忽视的因素：系统提示中被隐藏注入的当前日期，用户无法控制且每天变化，可能破坏可复现性与公平比较。

Method: 在9个近期LLM与6个数据集上测试，覆盖多选题问答（MCQA）、数学推理、代码生成和机器翻译，比较不同日期下的表现，并与批大小、数值精度等其他非确定性来源对比；同时测试链式思维（CoT）与少样本提示是否能降低敏感性。

Result: 性能仅随当前日期变化：MCQA最高波动6%，数学推理14%，代码生成7%，机器翻译2.84 BLEU。模型排名也会变化，影响排行榜。该日期效应超过批大小和数值精度等其他非确定性来源。标准提示技术无法降低敏感性，CoT甚至放大该效应。

Conclusion: 隐藏日期注入会显著影响LLM评估结果，破坏可复现性和公平比较。研究强调需要更严谨的评估协议，以保障LLM研究的可复现性与公平性。

Abstract: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching. We identify an overlooked factor: the hidden injection of the current date into system prompts, which users cannot control and which changes every day. Across 9 recent LLMs and 6 datasets spanning multiple-choice QA (MCQA), math reasoning, code generation, and machine translation, performance varies solely with the current date, with deltas of up to 6% on MCQA, 14% on math reasoning, 7% on code generation, and 2.84 BLEU on machine translation. Model rankings also shift, affecting leaderboards. This date effect exceeds other sources of non-determinism, such as batch size and numerical precision. Standard prompting techniques -- chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting -- do not reduce the sensitivity; chain-of-thought even amplifies it. Our findings underscore the need for careful evaluation protocols to ensure reproducibility and fair comparisons in LLM research.

</details>


### [81] [ER-JEPA: Experience Replay Improves Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36952)
*Jingnan Pu,Zi-En Fan,Feng Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ER-JEPA，在LLM-JEPA基础上加入情景回放路径，通过记忆存储与检索训练对提供额外监督，在多个数据集上稳定超越LLM-JEPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM擅长token级生成，但可能学到不良抽象语义且缺乏全面感知。LLM-JEPA通过联合嵌入预测架构对齐同一知识的不同视图来缓解，但强对齐未必导致准确稳定的预测。

Method: 在LLM-JEPA上增加情景回放路径。将训练对存入记忆，每步存储并检索相关数据提供额外监督，从而同时从当前批次和已存训练对中学习，为token预测和表示对齐提供额外监督。

Result: 在NL-RX、GSM8K、Spider和NQ-Open多个数据集上，ER-JEPA一致优于LLM-JEPA。

Conclusion: 情景回放能有效增强LLM-JEPA的监督信号，提升预测性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at token-level generation but may learn undesirable abstract semantics and lack comprehensive perception. LLM-JEPA mitigates this by aligning different views of the same underlying knowledge via a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). However, strong alignment does not necessarily lead to accurate, stable predictions. To address this, we propose ER-JEPA, which adds an episodic replay path to LLM-JEPA. ER-JEPA stores training pairs in a memory. At each step, it stores and retrieves relevant data to provide additional supervision. This enables learning from both the current batch and stored training pairs, providing additional supervision for token prediction and representation alignment. Experiments across multiple datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, and NQ-Open) demonstrate that ER-JEPA consistently outperforms LLM-JEPA.

</details>


### [82] [Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36965)
*Zexiao Wang,Zihao Zhang,Xudong Wang,Pan Wang,Ziyi Ye,Haoyu Zhao,Zuxuan Wu,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Chinese-Jev，一种面向中文决策任务的System One模型，通过统一数据处理与训练流程，在保持高效推理的同时提升中文决策准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有System One模型（如Jev）虽比生成式语言模型更高效，但中文决策准确率有限，限制了其在通用和垂直领域的应用。

Method: 将异构中文标注转换为候选选项的概率目标，实现跨领域统一训练；采用轻量级encoder-only骨干网络编码文本并对候选答案打分；先在大规模通用语料（1000万样本）上预训练，再分别针对医疗、法律、金融领域微调；并提出评测基准CJ-Bench。

Result: 预训练后在通用任务上准确率超闭源Jev 1.24%，提速20.3倍；领域微调后在医疗上比Jev高4.0%，在专业领域达到Jev平均准确率的92%，提速17倍，平均延迟仅15ms；INT8量化模型可在移动端部署，单次决策延迟约1秒。

Conclusion: Chinese-Jev有效弥补了System One模型的中文决策短板，兼顾高准确率与高效率，并支持端侧部署。

Abstract: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at https://gulucaptain.github.io/Chinese-Jev/.

</details>


### [83] [Repetition, Not Length: Isolating the Counting Failure in Neural Text-to-Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36974)
*Kirill Borodin,Vasilii Kudryavtsev,Maxim Maslov,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究TTS模型在重复文本上的失败现象，通过配对控制实验证明问题根源是重复本身而非文本长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTS模型在处理大量重复短语的文本时会出现循环、截断和计数丢失等问题，作者想探究究竟是重复本身还是其伴随的长度导致模型失败。

Method: 为每个重复句子配对词数、句数匹配但无相邻词重复的控制句；测试三种架构的六个模型，在k>=6时比较精确正确率，并进行贪婪解码、重复惩罚扫描、四个独立语音识别器及420种分析规格的稳健性检验。

Result: 控制句几乎完美渲染，而重复句失败：k>=6时精确正确率为94.3%对18.2%；该差距在所有检验中从未反转；留出的第四种架构预测差距误差在1个百分点内；两个非自回归基线之一表现相同失败；随文本周期变化，失败随周期性平滑增长，即使无相邻词自我重复时仍有一半失败。

Conclusion: 重复性本身（而非长度）是导致TTS模型失败的核心原因。

Abstract: Text-to-speech models loop, truncate and lose count on text that repeats a phrase many times. We show that repetition itself is what breaks them, not the length that comes with it. Every repeated sentence in our test set is paired with a control of matched sentence and word count in which no word ever repeats back-to-back. Six models from three architectures render the controls almost perfectly and fail the repeated twins: 94.3% against 18.2% exactly right at k >= 6. The gap survives greedy decoding, repetition-penalty sweeps, four independent speech recognisers and 420 analysis specifications without once reversing sign; a held-out fourth architecture lands within a point of its predicted gap, and one of two non-autoregressive baselines shows the same failure. Varying the period of the text shows the failure grows smoothly with periodicity, half of it surviving when no word is adjacent to itself.

</details>


### [84] [AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations---Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36976)
*Tao Hwang,Yishi Diao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出AMU框架，用小语言模型引导的结构化方法在写入时控制记忆，解决LLM长期交互中记忆写入不受控的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为个性化助手需在长期交互中维护持久用户记忆，但现有系统多关注存储、检索或整合，记忆写入缺乏控制，导致临时请求、重复陈述、过期用户状态进入记忆并被检索，影响个性化效果。

Method: AMU采用SLM引导的结构化框架进行写入时记忆控制：用结构化记忆过滤决定哪些内容进入记忆；用SLM引导的存储管理判断被接纳记录应单独存储、作为重复丢弃还是作为更新融合。

Result: 在受控的记忆写入与检索设置下评估，AMU能维护更干净、更可检索的个性化记忆。

Conclusion: 写入时记忆控制是提升个性化对话记忆质量的有效方向，AMU通过过滤与更新管理改善了记忆的清洁度与可检索性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of personalized assistants, but maintaining persistent user memory across long-term interactions remains challenging. Existing memory systems often focus on storage, retrieval, or consolidation, while memory writing remains less controlled: transient requests, duplicate statements, and outdated user states may enter memory and later be retrieved for personalization. In this paper, we present AMU: Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations, an SLM-guided (Small language model guided) structured framework for writing-time memory control. AMU uses structured memory filtering to decide what should enter memory and SLM-guided storage management to determine whether an admitted record should be stored separately, discarded as a duplicate, or fused as an update. We evaluate AMU in a controlled memory writing and retrieval setting. Experimental results show that AMU maintains cleaner and more retrievable personalized memories.

</details>


### [85] [SRJudge: Empowering Large Language Models with Selective Reasoning for Fine-Grained Knowledge Concept Tagging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36982)
*Zhiwei Yang,Jiahua Yang,Huiru Lin,Xing Chen,Quanlong Guan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SRJudge三阶段框架（Select-Reason-Judge），通过SLM缩小候选集、轻量LLM推理与强化学习对齐、大LLM评审，解决知识概念标注中决策空间过大的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识概念标注对教学至关重要，LLM虽表现良好，但在大规模候选集中因决策空间高维而难以选出正确概念。

Method: 三阶段框架：Stage1 Selector用微调SLM(如BERT)将候选缩至top-K；Stage2 Reasoner用轻量LLM精炼推理，结合改进强化学习、动态任务奖励函数与剪枝机制；Stage3 Judge用更大LLM评估推理与解释的合理性以定最终输出。并构建S_Bio与S_Phy两个数据集。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上持续超越SOTA基线，验证了方法的有效性与优越性。

Conclusion: SRJudge通过选择性推理能力有效提升细粒度知识概念标注性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Knowledge concept tagging aims to assign specific concept or topic labels to educational content, which is essential for both educators and learners in traditional and online teaching practices. Recent work has explored large language models (LLMs) for this task, achieving promising performance. However, LLMs still struggle to select the correct concept from a large-scale candidate set due to the high dimensionality of the decision space. In this paper, we propose a novel three-stage Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge) framework, which empowers LLMs with selective reasoning capability for fine-grained knowledge concept tagging. Specifically, the Selector in Stage 1 first narrows the candidate concepts to a top-K shortlist by fine-tuning a small language model (SLM), e.g., BERT, since the top-$K$ predictions hit the correct concept in most cases, thereby reducing the decision space of correct candidates. Next, the Stage 2 Reasoner employs a lightweight LLM for refined reasoning over the shortlisted candidates. It further integrates an improved reinforcement learning strategy with a dynamic task-specific reward function and a pruning mechanism to better align with human reasoning preferences. Finally, a larger LLM acts as a judger that evaluates the overall rationality of the reasoning process and its explanations to determine the final output. In addition, we construct two high-quality datasets for further validation, i.e., the biology dataset S_Bio and the physics dataset S_Phy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmark datasets, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. Resources are available at: https://github.com/Nicozwy/SRJudge.

</details>


### [86] [CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36987)
*Yuzhe Zhang,Weijie Zhu,Haolin Yang,Ziyun Zhang,Xianwei Xue,Mengke Chen,Qiutong Pan,Huaqian Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CypherTurn，首个多轮对话式Text-to-Cypher基准，含721会话/5927轮次，评估15模型揭示自主操作下的能力分歧等四发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只评估孤立的单轮查询，无法反映分析师实际进行的多轮对话式工作流程。

Method: 构建CypherTurn基准，涵盖7个知识图谱、13种对话现象、721会话、5927轮次；在引导式oracle协议与完全自主agentic协议下评估15个模型。

Result: 最佳模型执行准确率仅64.7%，会话级正确率低于5%；自主操作下前沿模型出现"自主性分歧"式排名重排；动作预算x3增至x10无法弥合自主性差距；单轮微调损害多轮指令遵循，架构适配的专用化模型超越部分前沿模型。

Conclusion: CypherTurn为对话式图数据库推理建立了开放挑战，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Graph databases are increasingly queried through natural language, yet every existing benchmark evaluates isolated single-turn queries rather than the multi-turn sessions through which analysts actually work. We introduce CypherTurn, the first benchmark for conversational Text-to-Cypher evaluation, comprising 721 sessions and 5,927 turns across 7 knowledge graphs and 13 conversational phenomena. We evaluate 15 models under a guided oracle protocol and a fully autonomous agentic protocol, yielding four findings. First, the best model reaches only 64.7% execution accuracy, and session-level correctness remains below 5%. Second, despite strong overall rank correlation, frontier models exhibit a consequential reordering of the top of the leaderboard under autonomous operation, a phenomenon we term the Autonomy Divergence, which reveals error-management as a partially independent capability from raw generation skill. Third, scaling action budgets from x3 to x10 fails to close the autonomy gap, as the strongest frontier models self-limit to approximately two actions per turn regardless of available budget. Fourth, single-turn Cypher fine-tuning degrades multi-turn instruction following, while architecture-appropriate specialization outperforms several frontier models. These results establish CypherTurn as an open challenge for conversational graph database reasoning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BarryQ/CypherTurn.

</details>


### [87] [LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37017)
*Shinan Zhang,Tao Zhang,Qihui Zhu,Mengjie Zhang,Dong Jin,Yunpeng Hou,Shuangwu Chen,Xiaobin Tan,Quan Zheng,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 LatCom，一种跨智能体潜在压缩框架，通过将多发送方潜在表示映射到固定数量的接收方可读槽位，解决多智能体潜在协作中的冗余与开销问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统采用潜在协作以避免自然语言通信的信息损失与重复编解码开销，但直接转发所有发送方潜在表示会使接收方上下文随智能体数量和推理长度增长，增加计算、内存与延迟。现有潜在压缩方法各自独立压缩再拼接，未解决跨智能体冗余。

Method: LatCom将多个发送方潜在表示映射为固定数量的、接收方可读且任务相关的槽位；不重建所有发送方隐藏状态，而是面向接收方任务效用优化压缩表示。训练分两阶段：单发送方可读性学习建立冻结接收方可解释的潜在接口；多发送方融合学习训练压缩器融合互补证据并去冗余。

Result: 在多个基准、Qwen3-4B上，LatCom相比LatentMAS平均推理加速2.46倍，输出token用量减少70.3%，并保持可比的平均准确率。

Conclusion: 跨智能体潜在压缩能有效缓解多智能体潜在协作的上下文膨胀与冗余，在保持准确率的同时显著提升效率。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

</details>


### [88] [Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37040)
*Federico Torrielli,Gianluca Barmina,Andrea Blasi Núñez,Amon Rapp,Luigi Di Caro,Peter Schneider-Kamp,Lukas Galke Poech*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究自然语言自编码器解释中应审计哪些token位置，发现聊天结构排序优于计算信号，解释5%的位置即可保留几乎全部成功率的威胁解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言自编码器可将模型内部激活转为可读解释，但解释每个token位置代价高昂，需要确定审计者应检查哪些位置来理解潜在威胁。

Method: 在提示注入和隐藏行为上分析470万条解释，比较模型计算信号与仅基于聊天结构训练的排序器，并测试预训练verbalizer对微调隐藏词的恢复能力。

Result: 聊天结构通常比计算信号选出更相关解释，且无需模型前向传播；四个数据集中的三个，仅解释5%位置即可保留几乎全部成功率；预训练verbalizer无需额外训练即可恢复模型通过微调学会隐藏的词。

Conclusion: 这些结果指明了审计者可集中生成解释的位置，并表明有用解释可超越verbalizer原本训练描述的模型范围。

Abstract: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

</details>


### [89] [Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37044)
*Wanqi Ren,Jianxiang Wang,Danxuan Liu,Linyi Ding,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究通过on-policy distillation (OPD)迁移LLM显式推理优势，提出ThinkOPD方法，用trace-response divergence (TRD) 与组内奖励增益进行响应级监督路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式中间推理让LLM具有更强解题能力，但如何通过OPD有效迁移这一"think-mode"优势尚待研究；现有Uniform ThinkOPD在所有同组响应上均匀蒸馏同一think trace，即便前缀on-policy，trace也未必与每条响应兼容，导致教师-学生差异不一致。

Method: 提出trace-response divergence (TRD)刻画trace与响应的交互；设计ThinkOPD，在响应级别进行监督路由，结合组相对奖励增益与基于TRD的兼容性代理，并在每个rollout组内归一化最终响应权重。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD在同模型设置及跨模型师生对中均优于Uniform ThinkOPD，并在受控比较中超过代表性rationale与self-distillation基线；干预实验表明结果收益与TRD代理提供互补的路由信号。

Conclusion: Think-enabled OPD为研究教师优势如何沿学生响应迁移提供了受控环境，ThinkOPD通过TRD与奖励增益实现更有效蒸馏。

Abstract: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

</details>


### [90] [Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37082)
*Jingyuan Ma,Lynx Aster,He Zhang,Siyao Song,Weijie Yuan,Zhe Zhang,Kai Jia,Zhifang Sui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出自主搜索框架（Rubric/Answer/Verify三状态）与Seal Memory主动上下文管理，通过只训练上下文管理后的最终片段解决Seal Collapse，35B模型BrowseComp达72.83。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程信息检索智能体易积累噪声或误导性上下文，导致早期错误持续存在且难以恢复。

Method: 自主搜索框架：智能体通过Rubric（定义有效答案标准）、Answer（按标准搜索）、Verify（独立验证后决定终止或继续）三状态管理搜索过程；配备Seal Memory工具实现主动上下文管理；针对RL训练引发的Seal Collapse，采用仅训练上下文管理之后最终片段的策略。

Result: 35B模型在BrowseComp上达72.83，超越同类开源系统，并在BrowseComp-ZH、xbench、DeepSearchQA、WideSearch、金融调查、产品搜索上持续优于基座模型。消融实验表明自主压缩优于自动压缩，并验证了RL设计。

Conclusion: 自主搜索与记忆管理框架有效提升长时程检索智能体性能，简单训练策略可解决Seal Collapse问题。

Abstract: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

</details>


### [91] [What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37104)
*Hongyang Li,Xiao Li,Caesar Wu,Grégoire Danoy,Pascal Bouvry*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文审计Qwen3在多语言数学推理上的语言可及性差距，揭示后训练各阶段的瓶颈转移，并提出实现多语言可靠交付的后训练路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言间存在推理能力获取不平等。当模型能解题却无法用用户语言给出完整解答时，语言就从性能差异来源变成了"访问障碍"。

Method: 在11种语言的竞赛数学任务上审计Qwen3检查点，评估同一模型家族的13个端点（已发布检查点、两种规模的多语言SFT、受控SFT消融、三种RL奖励形式），联合追踪正确性、语言遵守、终止性和交付效率。
