Result: 10种非英语语言中仅15.4-17.9%的问题能在16次采样中得到正确且终止、含可见推理的目标语言解答，英语则为92.9%。已发布模型常用英语推理；多语言SFT恢复目标语言推理但损害准确率（非多语言混合特有），且非英语推理易陷入不终止循环；RL两臂均恢复终止且不损失准确率，但只有含语言奖励项的RL能实现语言交付，仅奖励正确性会退回英语。

Conclusion: 后训练各阶段瓶颈不同，通过多语言SFT加含语言项的RL奖励，可构建从英语中心能力到可靠多语言推理交付的建设性路径。

Abstract: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

</details>


### [92] [Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37121)
*Nikitas Theodoropoulos,Maria Lymperaiou,Giorgos Filandrianos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文训练使用音素输入的双语 BabyLMs，以英语为固定 L2，变动 L1（德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语），研究跨语言影响。结果显示：相比正字法输入，音素输入下语法学习轨迹的 L1 差异更强，而早期词汇差异与音素库相似度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言影响是双语一语习得的核心议题。人工学习器可通过受控比较研究 L1-L2 互动，但人类与模型仍存在根本差异，尤其是输入模态：儿童主要从口语输入学习，而语言模型通常基于正字法文本训练。为缩小这一差距，作者希望结合发展上合理的双语模型与音素表征方向。

Method: 训练双语 BabyLMs，采用音素（phonemic）输入而非正字法文本。固定英语为 L2，L1 分别选取德语、瑞典语、波斯语和巴斯克语，以覆盖与英语在句法距离和音素库距离上的不同组合。比较音素输入与正字法输入下的学习表现。

Result: 在音素输入下，语法学习轨迹中与 L1 相关的变异比正字法输入更强；早期词汇层面的差异则与音素库相似度相符。

Conclusion: 音素输入能增强双语模型中 L1 对语法学习的跨语言影响，同时早期词汇差异受音素库相似度驱动，为研究 L1-L2 互动提供了更贴近人类语言习得的受控框架。

Abstract: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

</details>


### [93] [LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37127)
*Kajetan Ożóg,Alicja Wojciechowska,Dawid Malarz,Paweł Batorski,Artur Kasymov,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM Unbranding新任务，处理文本输出中的品牌"商业外观"(trade dress)，构建评估数据集，并推出MUTE方法在推理时中和品牌信息而不损害通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM频繁在多样上下文中生成品牌描述，带来商标稀释、虚假归属和品牌诽谤等风险。借鉴图像生成中的unbranding实践，需在文本层面应对这一新兴挑战，尤其是比视觉logo更隐蔽的trade dress（语言、口号、风格标记）。

Method: 正式定义LLM Unbranding任务，聚焦文本输出中的trade dress管理；构建涵盖多商业领域知名品牌的综合评估数据集；评测现有SOTA机器遗忘模型；提出MUTE——一种推理时方法，通过迭代精炼循环优化系统指令，无需脆弱的参数更新。

Result: 现有SOTA机器遗忘模型在选择性文本unbranding上存在明显局限；MUTE能有效中和文本trade dress，同时保留LLM的通用能力和实用性。

Conclusion: LLM Unbranding是一个重要且具挑战性的新任务，MUTE通过推理时指令优化为安全消除品牌泄漏提供了有效方案，为后续研究奠定基准。

Abstract: Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates.
  Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/LLM_unbranding. The implementation of MUTE is available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/MUTE.

</details>


### [94] [Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37171)
*Xinkai Du,Chao Lv,Yalin Sun,Quanjie Han,Lei Yao,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出KASB框架，通过语义空间对齐与知识融合提升RAG的段落选择质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG存在查询与检索上下文之间的语义空间不匹配问题，制约了其效果。

Method: Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB)，多阶段过程，融合生成式与检索式知识，实现查询与检索文档的语义空间对齐，提升段落选择的相关性与准确性。

Result: 在三个开放域问答数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: KASB通过语义对齐缓解语义空间不匹配，提升RAG段落选择质量。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [95] [VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37175)
*Qingsong Yan,Xia Jiang,Yaoxin Wu,Wen Song,Lu Zhang,Yingjie Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出通用视觉-语言组合优化求解器，用输入衍生的视觉表示增强文本描述，单一VLM经SFT与验证器引导的RL训练，跨任务提升解质量，复杂问题及大规模下增益显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型为端到端组合优化提供统一接口，但纯文本序列化可能掩盖对求解至关重要的空间与关系结构，因此需要引入视觉信息。

Method: 构建通用视觉-语言求解器，用输入衍生的视觉表示（不含任何真值解或解相关信息）增强文本实例描述；采用单一VLM跨CO任务，先监督微调，再进行验证器引导的强化学习。

Result: VLM整体解质量优于纯文本基线，在CVRP、JSSP等更复杂问题上增益尤为明显；视觉信息的优势在大规模问题上更突出。

Conclusion: 视觉输入即使不含解相关信息，也能有效补充空间与关系结构，验证了通用视觉-语言求解器在组合优化中的价值，且对复杂及大规模问题更具潜力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

</details>


### [96] [CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37223)
*Aakash Kumar Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CredWise信用风险决策支持框架，融合XGBoost预测、概率校准、可解释AI、政策检索、SQL分析与智能体工作流，在Lending Club数据上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单纯的风险预测无法解释申请人为何有风险，也难以与其他证据结合，因此需要整合预测、解释与政策证据的决策支持系统。

Method: 基于Lending Club数据（1345310笔贷款、18个特征），按时间划分训练/验证/测试集，训练XGBoost模型并进行概率校准；结合SHAP解释、FAISS政策检索、SQL分析与受控智能体路由。

Result: 2018测试集ROC-AUC为0.7109、PR-AUC为0.2993、F1为0.3714、准确率65.44%；校准将Brier分数从0.2157降至0.1273、ECE从0.2862降至0.0585；SHAP解释时间稳定（Spearman 0.9959）；FAISS检索Hit@1为0.929、MRR为0.964；智能体路由准确率95.6%，SQL基准三项指标均为1.0。

Conclusion: CredWise能将预测、解释、政策证据与结构化分析整合于一个受控工作流，为信用风险决策提供支持；当前为学术原型，最终决策仍由人工审核者做出。

Abstract: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

</details>


### [97] [Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37226)
*Soyeong Jeong,Sujay Kumar Jauhar,Sung Ju Hwang,Andrew Joohun Nam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CorpusMap，一个基于实体组织的语料导航层，将重复实体的提及解析为Entity Page并链接相关文档，形成可遍历的异构图，使关系可跨查询复用。在7个模型、3个数据集上，CorpusMap提升证据发现与答案质量，平均消耗更少token，并优于4种替代导航层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型文档集合问答需跨文档连接分散证据。现有LLM agent通过迭代搜索整个语料，但语料仅以扁平文件呈现，相关文档之间关系不明确，agent每次查询都要重新发现关系，既易遗漏互补证据又消耗大量token。因此需要一种能显式组织文档间关系的导航层。

Method: CorpusMap围绕语料中可识别的重复实体构建导航层。将每个重复实体表示为Entity Page，聚合该实体信息并链接所有提及它的文档，从而形成实体-文档图供agent遍历以收集原本孤立的证据。CorpusMap离线构建，通过跨文档的实体提及消解（entity resolution）建立链接，因此链接在查询间共享，而非推理时反复重新发现。

Result: 使用7种模型、3个基准数据集，CorpusMap在证据发现和答案质量上均优于原始语料的agentic搜索，且平均使用更少token；同时优于4种替代导航层。

Conclusion: 实体可作为导航大型文档集合的有效锚点，CorpusMap通过实体中心的导航层提升跨文档问答的效率与效果。

Abstract: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

</details>


### [98] [SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37361)
*Zetong Zhou,Wentao Zhang,Jingyuan Wang,Yifan Yang,Zizhuo Wang,Shixi Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SemOPT，一个语义引导的优化建模纠错框架，结合语义奖励模型与自适应纠错系统，在七个基准上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 自动将自然语言问题转为求解器代码时易出错，其中语义错误（能返回目标值但违背原问题意图）不会触发运行失败，因而难以检测与修正。

Method: SemOPT 包含一个语义奖励模型，用于区分忠实的数学模型与貌似合理但错误的模型；并配合一个自适应纠错系统，在建模空间上执行分层奖励引导搜索。

Result: 在七个优化建模基准上，SemOPT 达到新的 SOTA，在复杂数据集上相比最强基线平均提升 7.6% 准确率。

Conclusion: 语义引导的奖励与分层搜索能有效纠正 LLM 优化建模中的语义错误，显著提升建模准确率。

Abstract: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

</details>


### [99] [Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37371)
*Rebecca Ramnauth,Brian Scassellati*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"适应编译"(adaptation compilation),将模型适应策略(在哪、如何、多大程度适应)重构为联合预测与决策问题。编译器从先前适应中学习,预测候选方案的反事实响应曲面,无需重新搜索即可在不同优先级下复用。在Llama-3.1-8B上接近穷举搜索并优于默认方案,Gemma-2-9B上验证了可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型适应通常遵循固定配方,但不同更新方案会产生显著不同的行为结果。为每个学习任务重新搜索候选方案成本高昂,且单标量评分无法捕捉多维行为后果,限制了适应策略的复用性与灵活性。

Method: 提出"适应编译":将适应视为联合预测与决策问题。编译器从历史适应中学习,预测候选方案对获取、迁移、有界性和保留四个维度的反事实响应曲面(向量值),并在适应开始前选择方案。由于预测的是多维几何而非单一最优或标量分数,可在不同下游优先级下复用而无需再训练。

Result: 在五种学习类型中,首选方案在任务间差异显著且可从适应前信息预测。Llama-3.1-8B上,编译器选择的方案接近穷举搜索效果,并优于全局和特定目标默认方案。Gemma-2-9B上复现了方案异质性,但需在偏离强默认时考虑不确定性才能利用选择空间。

Conclusion: 适应搜索可在相关学习问题间被摊销,将先前的适应经验转化为决定未来学习方式的依据,实现了跨任务的高效适应策略选择。

Abstract: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

</details>


### [100] [Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37408)
*Annabelle K. L. Chua,Forster J. Khoo,Joel C. R. Tan,Huey Ting Ang,Kheng Hwee Tan,Joel Y. A. Sim,Shirley W. H. Ow,Ria Mundhra,Elsie C. K. Toh,Youfeng Xu,Lynnette H. X. Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种叙事抽取流水线，将网络仇恨叙事表示为实体-评价对，利用LLM推理（扩展ABSA）抽取并用Leiden聚类与LLM引导细化，应用于2024年英语Reddit对Taylor Swift的批评评论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算方法依赖语义表示，仅捕捉表层含义，导致仇恨叙事抽取精度有限；需要更精确、可解释的叙事识别方法以支撑严谨的检测系统。

Method: 将叙事表示为实体-评价对；用LLM推理流程扩展基于方面的情感分析（ABSA），识别方面、将其判断类型分类为评价依据并推导评价；再用Leiden算法对抽取的叙事聚类，并通过LLM引导的细化过程将聚类解析到目标粒度。

Result: 以2024年英语Reddit中批评Taylor Swift的评论为例展示该流水线，并分析了一个表现出仇恨言论模式的代表性聚类，验证其解释价值。

Conclusion: 将叙事建模为实体-评价对并结合LLM推理与聚类细化，可提升仇恨叙事抽取的精度与可解释性，为仇恨言论检测提供有效支撑。

Abstract: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

</details>


### [101] [Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37443)
*Yi-Xuan Deng,Yi Zhang,Wei Liu,Chao Xue,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MERA框架，将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定的证据状态分离，用RL训练轻量规划器进行检索增广，提升长时记忆问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时记忆使语言模型能利用历史交互，但回答问题所需证据常分散在遥远轮次中，且问题本身缺少定位线索；已检索到的事实可揭示这些线索，因此检索决策应基于已找到的证据。

Method: MERA将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定证据状态分离，已验证证据引导后续检索而不限制对全局记忆的访问；通过强化学习训练轻量规划器，奖励能恢复此前缺失证据的查询。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B和GPT-4o-mini骨干上取得强答案准确率。以Qwen3-30B处理证据和生成答案时，0.6B规划器在LoCoMo达77.40%、LongMemEval-S达71.29%，分别超过无检索接地训练的30B规划器4.10%和3.96%。LoCoMo上后续检索轮次将累计证据召回从55.5%提升至80.5%。

Conclusion: 证据状态引导的迭代检索与RL训练的轻量规划器可显著提升长时记忆问答效果，小模型规划器性能优于大型无训练规划器。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

</details>


### [102] [Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37469)
*Suting Chen,Peichun Hua,Yunming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出RINSE方法，在生成答案前仅依据问题和证据判断证据充分性，避免生成器依赖参数知识或产生不必要调用，并在六个数据集上超越10种基线方法及前沿模型API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG中检索到的段落常只提到正确实体却缺少回答问题所需事实，即使要求弃答，生成器仍对40.0-99.3%证据不足问题给出答案；训练生成器弃答会绑定模型权重、可能奖励参数知识回忆且需完整生成调用。核心问题是：能否在生成答案之前，仅凭问题与证据判断充分性。同时，现有不足证据测试构造存在表面特征泄漏标签的陷阱。

Method: 构建配对基准，采用替换、删除和问题交换等构造方式改变答案支持度，同时控制词使用等选定表面特征。提出RINSE，结合三种信号：问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落提供答案、以及小语言模型联合阅读段落后的充分性判断。

Result: 在六个数据集上，RINSE将充分证据排在不足证据之上得分0.837（随机为0.5），超过10种先前方法最佳值0.746和通过API查询的前沿模型0.784；最弱数据集得分0.684，也高于其他方法最弱值0.676。RINSE在生成前本地运行，单GPU每问题耗时36.5 ms。

Conclusion: 证据充分性可以在没有生成答案的情况下判断，但单一信号无法跨所有数据集通用；RINSE通过组合覆盖、答案可用性与小模型整体判断实现更强且更稳健的充分性判定，并具备低延迟本地部署优势。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.

</details>


### [103] [Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37491)
*Zeyan Li,Qirong Guo,SIyuan Qiu,Hu Xu,Chun Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)，通过对同一问答的匹配变体进行训练，让单一 reader 在支持证据存在时作答、证据缺失时弃答，无需 verifier 或阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强语言模型在证据缺失时仍会作答，根源在于以答案为中心的微调对无支持上下文没有目标信号，无法区分弃答与猜测。

Method: RBA 在匹配变体上训练单一 reader：当上下文支持问题时产生 gold 答案（含存在冲突证据的情形），当移除正确支持时则弃答；推理时使用普通解码，无需验证器、阈值或 regime 标签。

Result: 在三个多跳 QA 数据集、三个随机种子上，相比 conflict-focused 训练，RBA 将无支持回答率降低 60+ 个百分点，同时保持支持准确率；在 TriviaQA 检索未命中切片上，无支持回答率从 100% 降至 1% 以下，并提升支持准确率。

Conclusion: 证据门控式作答必须在支持边界的两侧同时学习。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

</details>


### [104] [Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37494)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Abobaker Ahmed,Nawaf Barebood,Hussain Bu Subayt,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AnswerPool：将共享上下文的 N 道题的所有选项混入一个列表，让模型为每道题指定答案。不需新写题目或改标签，却能显著提升难度、量化"排除法"得分，并评估弃答能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多项选择基准便宜但趋于饱和，而通过重写更难的题目来补救既慢又需对每个基准重复进行。饱和的基准中仍隐藏着更难的挑战：由于每道题的干扰选项是单独设计的，模型可以靠排除少数选项来提高分数。

Method: AnswerPool 方法：取共享同一上下文的 N 道题，把所有选项汇总成一个列表，要求模型为每个问题分配答案。不写新题、不改标签；从答案池中删除答案可使问题无法回答，从而在同一次评估中对弃答进行评分。

Result: 五道四选项题全部猜对的概率从 10⁻³ 降至 5×10⁻⁷；能识别答案的模型仍保持其多选题成绩，因此准确率损失衡量了格式给予的排除法优势。在八个文本、图像与视频基准和十八个模型上，pooling 对所有模型都更难；排除法优势在弱模型上最大；八个开放权重模型中有七个对 87%–100% 无法回答的问题仍给出答案。

Conclusion: AnswerPool 无需新出题即可有效对抗多选题饱和，揭示出模型依赖排除法获得的虚高分数，并暴露模型在应弃答时的过度自信倾向，为更严格的评估提供了低成本工具。

Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

</details>


### [105] [Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37497)
*Stefania Butnaru,Claudiu Creanga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验编码器Transformer（DeBERTa等）是否在默认NLI中运用M-Heuristic语用原则区分词汇使役与迂说使役，发现其并无此能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在语义关系上表现优异，但其语用推理能力（如M-Heuristic标记形式暗示标记意义）尚未被充分研究，需检验模型是否真正掌握此类语用区分。

Method: 用NLI框架对比词汇使役（Larry stopped the car）与迂说使役（Larry caused the car to stop），覆盖188种条件、15个兼役动词，测试DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART；并进行探针与对照实验、30组三元组语义相似度分析，以及Gemini Flash-Lite的元语言显式提示实验。

Result: 三个编码器模型均未捕捉使役语用区别，DeBERTa在100%案例预测为"Neutral"；探针实为追踪句法复杂度而非语用；迂说使役在29/30组中更接近无中介方式描述，与M-Heuristic相反；Gemini在显式元语言提示下达100%准确率。

Conclusion: 该语用原则在模型中被隐式可用但在默认NLI中被弃用，编码器式Transformer缺乏默认的M-Heuristic语用推理能力。

Abstract: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied. This paper investigates whether encoder-based transformers such as DeBERTa employ the M-Heuristic (the neo-Gricean principle that marked linguistic forms implicate marked meanings). We test this hypothesis by contrasting lexical causatives (e.g., ``Larry stopped the car'') with periphrastic causatives (e.g., ``Larry caused the car to stop'') using a Natural Language Inference framework. Our experiments across 188 conditions with 15 ambitransitive verbs reveal that DeBERTa, RoBERTa, and BART show no evidence of capturing the pragmatic distinction between these forms, with DeBERTa predicting ``Neutral'' for 100% of cases. Probing analysis initially suggested a representation-use dissociation, but control experiments reveal the probe was tracking syntactic complexity, not causative pragmatics. Semantic similarity over 30 triplets places periphrastic causatives closer to unmediated manner descriptions in 29/30 cases, opposite to M-Heuristic predictions in the embedding space. Under explicit metalinguistic framing, Gemini Flash-Lite reaches 100% with item-specific traces, so the principle is available under instruction yet unused in default NLI.

</details>


### [106] [The Rashomon Wikipedia: A Data-Perspectivist Analysis of Divergent Historical Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37498)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu,Anca Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 分析维基百科五种语言版本中关于罗马尼亚三个争议历史事件的跨语言史学偏倚，提出"引用隔离"现象，并设计"Peace-Maker"流程以自动化冲突调和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维基百科宣称提供统一、中立的史实记录，但其各语言版本常成为独立的知识共同体，对争议事件产生分歧叙事。论文旨在系统考察这种跨语言史学偏倚。

Method: 选取罗马尼亚语、匈牙利语、俄语、土耳其语和英语五个语言版本，针对波萨达战役(1330)、苏联占领比萨拉比亚(1940)、塔尔戈维什泰夜袭(1462)三个争议事件；结合人工标注者与大语言模型，分类引用立场并量化2005至2024年的叙事演变。

Result: 发现"引用隔离"现象：波萨达战役中仅119条引用有2条为各语言版本共享，罗马尼亚版本呈91%亲本国偏倚，匈牙利版本则较平衡。纵向分析显示叙事波动且受当代地缘政治影响，俄语对比萨拉比亚的表述在2024年显著转变。

Conclusion: 提出"Peace-Maker"流程用于自动化冲突调和；标准提示会使模型虚构共识，而"对抗性"提示（明确要求保留并归属分歧）可达到近乎完美的中立性得分。

Abstract: Wikipedia aims to provide a unified, neutral record of history, yet its independent language editions often function as distinct epistemic communities, creating divergent narratives around contested events. This paper investigates cross-lingual historiographical bias by analyzing Wikipedia articles across five languages (Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Turkish, and English) focusing on three contentious events in Romanian history: the Battle of Posada (1330), the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia (1940), and the Night Attack at Targoviste (1462). Using human annotators and Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify citation stance and quantify narrative evolution from 2005 to 2024, we identify a phenomenon of "citation isolation". In the case of the Battle of Posada, only 2 out of 119 citations were shared between language editions, with the Romanian edition exhibiting a 91% pro-national bias compared to the balanced Hungarian edition. Longitudinal analysis reveals that these narratives are volatile and responsive to contemporary geopolitics, evidenced by a significant shift in the Russian framing of Bessarabia in 2024. Finally, we propose a "Peace-Maker" pipeline to automate conflict reconciliation. We demonstrate that while standard prompting leads models to hallucinate consensus, "adversarial" prompting, which explicitly instructs the model to preserve and attribute disagreement, achieves near-perfect neutrality scores.

</details>


### [107] [Who Warmed the Archives? LLMs Overestimate Historical Warmth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37499)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 历史档案可用于回溯气候记录，LLM能提取气候指数，但需检验其误差是否可用于跨世纪比较。作者比较了词汇基线、微调历史Transformer和LLM提示在五百年德语文本上的表现，发现词汇方法优于所有微调Transformer，且所有六个LLM均表现出随时间增长的暖偏差，表明相关性不足以验证LLM作为历史气候指数工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史档案是扩展器测气候记录的重要但未被充分利用的来源，气候学家手工推导指数，LLM提供了自动化提取的可能。然而，仅凭相关性得分无法排除系统性的、与时代相关的偏差，因此需要检验LLM误差是否适合跨世纪比较。

Method: 在五百年德语文本的Pfister温度指数上，比较词汇基线、微调历史Transformer（包括从历史德语从头预训练的模型）和LLM提示方法；测试六个LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek v4 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.7-Plus、Kimi-K2.6-Fast）；并进行消融实验，去除引文中的显式日期和日历时代标记。

Result: 词汇方法优于所有微调Transformer（其中从历史德语预训练模型r=-0.016）。六个LLM全部表现出随日历年增长的暖偏差，符号一致（斜率+0.13至+0.34/世纪，p<0.01），效应量适中（r²约0.01至0.05）但跨模型一致。最佳相关的Gemini 2.5 Flash达到最佳词汇相关性（r=0.32），但误差翻倍。消融实验去除日期和时代标记后趋势基本不变。

Conclusion: LLM的暖偏差更可能源于不合时宜的当代先验，而非正确推断引文时代。仅凭相关性不足以验证LLM作为历史气候指数工具（oracle），需要额外检验系统性时代偏差。

Abstract: Historical archives are an under-used source for extending the instrumental climate record backward in time, and LLMs offer a way to extract the indices climatologists derive by hand. Beyond measuring how well systems extract this signal, we check whether their errors are safe to use for cross-century comparison, since a good correlation score does not rule out systematic, era-linked bias. Comparing lexical baselines, fine-tuned historical transformers, and LLM prompting on the Pfister temperature index across five centuries of German text, lexical methods beat every fine-tuned transformer we test, including one pretrained from scratch on historical German (r=-0.016). All six LLMs we test (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast) show a warm bias that grows with calendar year, with the same sign in every model (slopes +0.13 to +0.34/century, p<0.01). The effect is modest in size (r-squared approx equal to 0.01 to 0.05) but consistent across six independently developed models. The best-correlated of the six, Gemini 2.5 Flash, matches the best lexical correlation (r=0.32) at double the error. An ablation stripping explicit dates and calendar-era markers from the quotes leaves this trend essentially unchanged, favoring an anachronistic present-day prior over the model correctly inferring the quote's era. Correlation alone is thus insufficient for vetting an LLM as a historical-climate-index oracle.

</details>


### [108] [Evaluating Bounded Autonomy in Regulated Agentic AI: A Diagnostic Harness with Constitutional Rewards, Escalation Labels, and Runtime Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37501)
*Dipankar Sarkar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RegLLM诊断框架，用于受监管智能体工作流中的有界自主性，通过六项可信度信号与确定性运行时监督器评估系统，并以小规模实验揭示配置方差对调优效果的冲击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受监管场景下的智能体需在"自主行动"与"升级人工"之间做可测量的决策，但现有评估缺乏对可信度信号来源的区分以及对有界自主性的诊断手段，调优效果也易被配置方差掩盖。

Method: RegLLM插件化六个可信度信号：引用有效性、来源接地、模式合规、升级正确性、宪法对齐和不安全动作率；按监督来源（程序化验证器、任务级升级标签、AI评判分数）区分。确定性运行时监督器阻断无依据回答并强制升级，记录干预。同一领域宪法贯穿评估、训练奖励与服务护栏；任务级"应升级"标签作为训练信号。用Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO在两个单GPU试点上验证。

Result: 离线参考运行(n=12)在启用治理后升级召回从0升至0.67，不安全动作率从0.33降至0.08。两个同种子、同评估划分的试点(n=8)差异显著：名义相同的RL-base配置任务成功率为0.25对0.12，升级召回为1.0对0.5。答案质量适配器在Run A使召回1.0→0.5，Run B则0.5→1.0；升级感知变体在Run B无可测变化。

Conclusion: 小规模试点不足以确立可靠的适配器效应或生产就绪性，其诊断价值在于表明配置方差可能压倒有界自主性指标上的表面调优效果，从而呼唤更大评估集与重复运行。

Abstract: We propose RegLLM, a diagnostic harness for bounded autonomy in regulated agentic workflows. It instruments six trustworthiness signals: citation validity, source grounding, schema compliance, escalation correctness, constitutional alignment, and unsafe-action rate. Signals are distinguished by their source of supervision: programmatic verifiers, task-level escalation labels, or AI-judge scores. A deterministic runtime supervisor blocks ungrounded answers and forces escalation, logging interventions. The same domain constitution informs evaluation, training rewards, and serving guardrails. Task-level should-escalate labels make the act-versus-defer decision a measurable training signal. We demonstrate the harness at smoke scale. An offline reference run (n=12) lifts escalation recall from 0 to 0.67 and reduces unsafe-action rate from 0.33 to 0.08 when governance is enabled. Two single-GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO pilots (n=8, same seed and evaluation split) expose substantial variation: nominally identical RL-base configurations yield task success of 0.25 versus 0.12 and escalation recall of 1.0 versus 0.5. An answer-quality adapter changes recall from 1.0 to 0.5 in Run A, but from 0.5 to 1.0 in Run B. An escalation-aware variant produces no measurable change in Run B. These small pilots do not establish reliable adapter effects or production readiness. Their contribution is diagnostic: configuration variance can overwhelm apparent tuning effects on bounded-autonomy metrics, motivating larger evaluation sets and repeated runs.

</details>


### [109] [From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37510)
*Yuhao Wang,Ruiyang Ren,Yinan Zhang,Ruiqing Zhang,Jing Liu,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究on-policy distillation中教师干预的分配策略，提出基于局部策略不一致的MAESTRO方法，自适应决定干预时机与时长，在多个数学推理基准上取得最优效果并大幅缩短训练响应长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD中学生基于自身推理轨迹学习并接受更强教师的反馈，教师干预虽能提升轨迹质量，但会改变学生学习的分布。作者发现仅用rollout质量作为分配教师指导的标准并不充分：更深的干预对准确率收益递减却增加off-policy负载；在受限rollout horizon的训练实验中，学生准确率峰值与性能保持率偏好不同的干预强度；最优干预深度与位置也随基准变化。因此需要自适应地决定教师接管时机与生成时长。

Method: 提出MAESTRO，利用局部策略不一致（local policy disagreement）联合自适应地决定教师何时接管以及生成多久。其策略不一致分数结合了教师加权的候选覆盖率与局部分布相似度，并在推理段落（paragraph）内聚合。

Result: 在八个数学推理基准上，对0.6B与1.7B的Qwen3学生，MAESTRO在所比较方法中取得最高的宏平均准确率，且1.7B学生在每个基准上均领先。相比标准OPD，MAESTRO将平均训练响应长度减少67.3%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于局部策略不一致自适应分配教师干预，能在提升蒸馏效果的同时显著降低off-policy负载与训练响应长度，为OPD中的教师指导分配提供了更优准则。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout horizon, peak student accuracy and performance retention favor different intervention strengths. The preferred intervention depth and placement also vary across benchmarks. These findings motivate MAESTRO, which uses local policy disagreement to jointly adapt when the teacher takes over and how long it generates. Its {policy disagreement score} combines teacher-weighted candidate coverage with local distribution similarity and is aggregated within reasoning paragraphs. Across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MAESTRO achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among the compared methods for both 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students, with the 1.7B student leading on every benchmark. MAESTRO also reduces average training response length by 67.3\% relative to standard OPD. The code is available at https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO.

</details>


### [110] [E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37533)
*Arseny Ivanov,Alexander Kolesov,Alexander Korotin,Ivan Oseledets,Mikhail Goncharov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出E-MoE，用MoE专家路由决策作为离散共享隐变量构建混合反向过程，避免后验坍塌，在不增加激活参数下提升少步生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型(MDM)每步解掩多个token，但反向过程逐位置分解，在少步生成时质量受限；而用连续高斯隐变量捕捉位置间相关性的方法易发生后验坍塌，隐变量被忽略。

Method: E-MoE以MoE骨干网络的专家路由决策作为离散共享隐变量，将反向过程建模为该离散隐变量条件下的分解分布混合，且相比分解基线不增加激活参数量。

Result: 在合成多模态基准、二值化MNIST以及LM1B上，E-MoE在少步生成上优于分解基线。

Conclusion: 用离散的专家路由隐变量替代连续高斯隐变量，可有效建模位置间相关性并规避后验坍塌，提升少步生成质量。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion's speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE), which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.

</details>


### [111] [RunyaNER: Auxiliary Language Selection for Runyankore NER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37543)
*Prosper Arineitwe Asiimwe,Francois Meyer,Jan Buys*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RunyaNER——首个公开的东非语言Runyankore的NER基准数据集，并利用它研究跨语言迁移中的辅助语言选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言的NER常依赖跨语言零样本迁移或多语言微调，但在缺少目标语言基准时，不确定哪种辅助语言选择策略能带来最佳迁移效果，且东非语言资源匮乏。

Method: 用半自动流水线构建并全人工校验的RunyaNER数据集（30k句子、超237k标注词）；在其上对预训练模型进行基准测试，并系统研究跨语言零样本迁移与多语言微调下的辅助语言选择，比较基于嵌入的度量与传统语言学特征（元数据、类型学）。

Result: RunyaNER规模与质量足以训练有效的Runyankore NER模型；迁移性能对辅助语言选择高度敏感，基于有标注训练片段计算的嵌入度量比传统语言学特征与下游迁移性能的相关性更强。

Conclusion: 通过发布RunyaNER并提供辅助语言选择策略的系统分析，本文既贡献了新的基准资源，也为低资源场景下的多语言迁移提供了实用洞见。

Abstract: Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer. Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences. We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models. We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings. Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology. By releasing RunyaNER and providing a systematic analysis of auxiliary language selection strategies, this work contributes both a new benchmark resource and practical insights for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [112] [Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37564)
*Zijing Wang,Yongkang Liu,Mingyang Wang,Ercong Nie,Mengjie Zhao,Yunpu Ma,Kang Liu,Zihan Wang,Shi Feng,Daling Wang,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DiGA框架，将任务向量按几何属性正交分解为独立分量分别合并，避免跨分量耦合，提升模型合并性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法将每个任务向量视为不可分割的整体合并单元，忽略了其中编码的异构几何变化，导致跨分量耦合：基于完整任务向量统计的合并决策会让某分量的几何特征干扰其他分量的选择、加权或组合，降低合并模型质量。

Method: 以预训练权重为共享几何参考，将每个任务向量正交分解为对应不同几何属性的分量；在各子空间内独立聚合对应分量，再重组为统一更新。该分量式公式保持各分量的几何特性，防止相互干扰，且可嵌入多种现有合并方法。

Result: 在多种模型、任务和合并方法上的大量实验表明，DiGA提升了合并模型性能并减少能力退化。代码已开源于 https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA。

Conclusion: DiGA通过几何解耦的分量式合并策略有效缓解跨分量耦合问题，且具备与现有方法广泛兼容的通用性。

Abstract: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how another is selected, weighted, or combined, potentially degrading the quality of the merged model. To address this issue, we propose DiGA, a
Disentangled Geometry-Aware model merging framework. Using the pretrained weights as a shared geometric reference, DiGA orthogonally decomposes each task vector into components corresponding to distinct geometric attributes. Rather than merging the task vectors as a whole, DiGA aggregates corresponding components independently within their respective subspaces and subsequently recombines them into a unified update. This component-wise formulation preserves the geometric identity of each component and prevents the characteristics of one component from interfering with the aggregation of another. Furthermore, DiGA can be incorporated into a broad range of existing model merging methods. Extensive experiments across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods demonstrate that DiGA improves merged-model performance and reduces capability degradation. Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA.

</details>


### [113] [Devils in Question Relay: Source-Conditioned Relay Steering to Mitigate Hallucinations in Audio-visual Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37568)
*Yu Zhang,Pingrui Zhang,Xuefeng Bai,Pengfei Zhang,Yang Xiang,Kehai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了AVLLM中"源混淆接地幻觉"的"问题中继"机制，并提出免训练的SECRET方法来缓解跨模态干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频-视觉大模型(AVLLM)存在源混淆接地幻觉：来自未使用模态的线索会诱导出所需模态并不支持的响应，损害实际应用可靠性。现有方法虽有缓解进展，但该失败如何从内部跨模态交互中产生仍缺乏理解。

Method: 通过路径干预与表征分析，发现"问题中继"机制——问题状态携带干扰线索与所需源证据。据此提出SECRET（Source-Conditioned Relay Steering），一种免训练方法：利用不同模态路径干预诱发的对比性问题表征，将原始问题状态引导向所需源证据，在问题中继处缓解跨模态干扰。

Result: 在CMM和AVHBench两个基准、三种AVLLM上，SECRET持续优于先前免训练方法，显著缓解源混淆接地幻觉（如相比基模型最高提升+18.0和+7.1个百分点），并在模态特定描述任务中展现出开放式生成的泛化能力。

Conclusion: SECRET表明问题中继是跨模态干扰的关键位置，通过源条件化的表征引导可在无需训练的情况下有效提升AVLLM的接地可靠性。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have made remarkable progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning through interactions among visual, auditory, and linguistic information. However, recent studies show that AVLLMs face a critical challenge: $\textbf{source-confused grounding hallucination}$, where cues from the unused modality induce responses that the required modality does not support, undermining reliability in real-world applications. Existing methods have made progress in mitigating this failure, yet how it arises from internal cross-modal interactions remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct path-intervention and representation analyses, revealing a $\textbf{question-relay}$ mechanism: question states carry interfering cues alongside required-source evidence, undermining grounding in required-modality evidence. Cutting pathways from interfering modality to question states yields greater correct-answer logit recovery than cutting those to the generation position. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{SECRET}$ ($\textbf{S}$ourc$\textbf{E}$-$\textbf{C}$onditioned $\textbf{RE}$lay s$\textbf{T}$eering), a training-free method that mitigates cross-modal interference at the question relay. Using contrasting question representations elicited through different modality-pathway interventions, SECRET steers the original question states toward required-source evidence. Experiments on two widely adopted benchmarks CMM and AVHBench across three AVLLMs show that SECRET consistently outperforms prior training-free methods, substantially mitigating source-confused grounding hallucinations (e.g., up to +18.0 and +7.1 percentage points over base models). Modality-specific captioning further demonstrates its generalizability to open-ended generation.

</details>


### [114] [Pair Difficulty Matters: Rethinking Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation and Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37577)
*Bruno Brocai,Maria Becker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出，用位置偏差、传递性和成对一致性评估LLM评判者存在误导，因为这些代理指标被"接近排名差距"的成对比较主导，建议改用按排名差距分层的条件化指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判者广泛用于成对比较排序，但其可靠性通常通过位置偏差、传递性和成对一致性三个代理指标评估。大量文献据此报告评判者表现不佳，可能误导实践者放弃本来有效的评估器，因此需要纠正这一评估方式。

Method: 作者基于成对聚合背后的Bradley-Terry几何进行理论论证，并通过控制模拟和两个人工评分语料库进行验证，分析三个代理指标与真实排序准确率的相关性及预测成分的来源。

Result: 三个代理指标与金标准排序准确率仅弱相关，其预测成分主要集中在"远差距"成对比较区域；代理指标主要被信息论上本就不一致的"近差距"成对比较主导。

Conclusion: 应使用按排名差距分层的条件化指标评估LLM评判者，最好以人类排序为金标准，而非依赖传统代理指标。

Abstract: Large Language Model judges are widely used to rank texts and text-generating systems through pairwise comparison, and their reliability is typically assessed via three proxies: position bias, transitivity, and pairwise agreement (self- or human-labeled). Because these proxies drive judge selection and benchmarking, a substantial literature reporting that judges perform poorly on them risks steering practitioners away from otherwise capable evaluators. We argue this assessment is misleading. Under the Bradley--Terry geometry underlying pairwise aggregation, each proxy is dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, where inconsistency is information-theoretically expected and individual verdicts contribute little to the aggregate ranking; far-gap pairs carry the ranking signal but barely move the proxies. We formalize this argument and validate it in a controlled simulation and on two human-rated corpora: the proxies correlate only weakly with ranking accuracy against gold, and their predictive component concentrates in the far-gap regime. Judges should therefore be assessed on rank-gap-conditional metrics, ideally against human rankings. Code at https://github.com/brunobrocai/PairDifficulty.

</details>


### [115] [Correct, Don't Delete: Mitigating Emergent Misalignment with Corrective Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37624)
*Jacob Epifano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究"emergent misalignment (EM)"现象：在少量有害示范（如坏医疗建议）上微调语言模型会导致其在无关问题上广泛失准。作者比较了两种处理被投毒训练样本的方法——删除还是纠正，发现纠正比删除更有效地降低EM率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有防御方法是定位并删除有害数据行，但行定位器在留出测试中失败，且删除行效果低于预期。作者提出新问题：对于固定的被投毒数据行，纠正是比删除更好的选择吗？

Method: 在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上，用坏医疗建议与良性对话数据的混合数据微调，预先选取四分之一的投毒行，分别进行删除或替换为针对同一提示的纠正答案，其余保持一致。进一步测试不同替换比例、第二个基础模型和第二个失准模型，并对比替换内容（改写但保留坏建议、数据集自带的正确答案、改写器答案）以及纠正训练数据类型（通用对话、其他医疗提示、是否指示写作助手避免伤害）。

Result: 替换行将EM率降低约三分之一，并改善留出医疗问题的回答，而删除相同行几乎没有可测量效果；纠正一半投毒行时优势更大，且在第二个基础模型和第二个失准模型上同样成立。改写但保留坏建议无明确益处；数据集自带正确答案与改写器答案效果相当。在纠正训练中，纠正数据优于等量通用对话数据；纠正其他医疗提示与纠正被投毒提示效果相近；指示写作助手谨慎避免伤害相比普通纠正无额外收益。

Conclusion: 在测试的设定中，纠正有害训练数据比删除更能减少EM。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter's. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.

</details>


### [116] [Co-Linguistics: AI-augmented Theory Construction in Linguistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37635)
*Emmanuel Chemla,Benjamin Spector,Alexandros Kalomoiros,Philippe Schlenker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将AI作为"共同科学家"用于语言学研究("Co-Linguistics")，帮助构建和评估语言学理论，而非作为人类语言能力的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言学历来发展可数学形式化的理论，而AI在数学领域的革命将对语言学产生影响，但语言学家目标并非证明新定理，而是寻找最佳公理集来推导经验陈述，因此需要新的AI应用方式。

Method: AI可加速研究：将现有理论完全显式化、比较竞争理论、并提出新理论(对应机器学习中的"程序归纳")；同时借助数据优势加速关键预测的识别与检验(对应"主动学习")。

Result: 理论评估与理论构建的循环可能带来递归甚至自主的语言学理论改进。

Conclusion: 人类仍居核心地位：语言学家提供科学方向并概念性评估理论，实验参与者用于评估超出LLM能力的经验预测。

Abstract: LLMs have been studied in recent linguistics as potential models of humans' linguistic abilities. Here we discuss an entirely different use of AI, namely as a co-scientist, to help construct and assess linguistic theories (we refer to the result as "Co-Linguistics"). Since the 1960s, linguistics has developed theories that are in principle mathematically formalizable, often in the language of formal language theory or model theory. The AI revolution in mathematics will thus have consequences in linguistics-but with an essential twist: proving new theorems is rarely the linguist's goal. Rather, one seeks to find the best set of axioms to derive empirical statements. AI could accelerate research by making existing theories fully explicit, by comparing competing theories, and more ambitiously, by proposing new theories (in machine learning, this relates to "program induction"). It will also help assess theories by accelerating the identification and test of crucial predictions, thanks to unparalleled access to data (in machine learning, this relates to "active learning"). While the cycle from theory evaluation to theory construction may give rise to recursive and possibly autonomous improvement of linguistic theories, humans remain central: linguists provide scientific directions and evaluate theories conceptually, and experimental participants are needed to assess empirical predictions that are outside the reach of LLMs.

</details>


### [117] [Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37647)
*Tobias Deußer,Lorenz Sparrenberg,Rafet Sifa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 评估Jev（TypeSafe AI的System One模型，不生成文本，仅返回选项选择、评分或概率）在37个数据集上的零样本表现，并与Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-4-E4B对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev面向信息访问管线中的小决策（路由、接地检查、内容审核、评分），需验证其准确性与概率校准在实际任务中的表现。

Method: 在37个数据集（涵盖分类、路由、NLI、阅读理解、常识、审核、法律条款、评分）上零样本评估Jev-1.13.0，每数据集固定模板、全量测试集，共346,009次请求（成本低于10美元）；同时对Qwen3.8-27B与Gemma-4-E4B用相同请求、以其选项精确下一token概率评分。

Result: Jev在IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag、ARC达95-99%，Belebele跨122语言86.7%；在37个数据集中胜Qwen 27个（Qwen的9个领先均不显著），全部胜Gemma。三模型在低资源语言、细粒度/噪声标签、评分任务上均退化。Jev选择概率校准良好，支持选择性预测；二分类概率排序好但相对0.5阈值位置不佳，训练集调阈值可将UNFAIR-ToS micro-F1从0.50提升至0.75。Jev在MMLU计算题更准（94% vs 91%），而两个开源模型及三模型在C-Eval上相反。旋转选项不影响Jev准确率，去掉问题则降至近随机，排除浅层记忆但未排除记忆的问答对。

Conclusion: Jev作为小决策模型在多任务上表现强劲且概率校准良好，但对低资源语言、噪声标签和评分任务仍有明显退化；开源代码、测试框架和所有原始响应已发布。

Abstract: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.

</details>


### [118] [Corpus-Guided Dual-Path Propagation for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37661)
*Baoxian Liu,Tong Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NexusRAG，通过为无关系Tri-Graph增加基于实体共现与语义相似度的语料级实体邻域结构，引导互补的语义传播和结构传播路径，提升多跳检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多跳图检索方法主要依赖查询-句子相似度搜索证据，易漏掉相似度低但关键的桥接证据，并激活与推理链无关的偶然实体。

Method: 为无关系Tri-Graph扩展语料级实体邻域结构（联合实体共现与语义相似度）。通过两条互补传播路径：句子间的邻域约束语义传播确定查询相关实体前沿；相邻实体间的直接结构传播扩展前沿。传播的实体权重用于邻域感知的段落初始化并驱动Personalized PageRank。

Result: 在三个多跳QA基准和GraphRAG-Bench领域子集上持续优于现有方法；在GraphRAG-Bench子集中所有问题类别证据召回率最高，超基线4.2-8.1个点。

Conclusion: NexusRAG以简单有效的方式增强了无关系图检索，兼顾语义与结构信息，显著提升多跳检索性能。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation supports multi-hop retrieval by organizing corpus information into graphs. However, existing relation-free graph retrieval methods rely primarily on query-sentence similarity to search for evidence. This can exclude useful bridging evidence with low query similarity and activate incidental entities unrelated to the reasoning chain. In this paper, we propose a simple and effective approach called NexusRAG, which augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level entity neighborhood structure derived from joint entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. NexusRAG employs this structure to guide two complementary propagation paths: neighborhood-constrained semantic propagation through sentences identifies the query-relevant entity frontier, while direct structural propagation between neighboring entities expands that frontier to structurally related entities. The propagated entity weights also inform neighborhood-aware passage initialization for Personalized PageRank. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms existing approaches. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all question categories, exceeding baselines by 4.2-8.1 points. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/Jacob-biu/NexusRAG.

</details>


### [119] [Reader Proficiency Shapes Layer-wise Surprisal Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37688)
*Akio Hayakawa,Horacio Saggion*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究LLM各层surprisal与不同熟练度读者、不同注视指标的层间关系，发现低词汇熟练度读者FPGD预测深度更深，TGD预测深度整体更深。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阅读行为不仅受语言输入影响，还受读者熟练度影响，需探究LLM分层surprisal与人类注视行为的层间关系是否因熟练度和注视指标而异。

Method: 使用MECO L2眼动语料库，比较高/低词汇熟练度读者在首次注视时长(FPGD)和总注视时长(TGD)上的表现，通过Predictive Depth量化surprisal跨模型层预测力的分布，测试12个LLM，并进行留一分析。

Result: 低词汇熟练度读者FPGD的Predictive Depth更深，TGD差异较小；TGD在两个熟练度组中均比FPGD预测深度更深；留一分析显示信息层优势可泛化到未见文本，但实际预测提升有限。

Conclusion: 分层LLM surprisal为理解读者群体和注视指标间的阅读行为差异提供了有用视角，预测力集中层次与阅读过程的时间性和广度相关。

Abstract: Reading behaviour varies not only with linguistic input, but also with reader proficiency. In this study, we investigate whether the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from large language models (LLMs) and human gaze behaviour differs across readers with different levels of proficiency and across gaze measures. Using eye-tracking data from the MECO L2 corpus, we compare readers with high and low vocabulary proficiency on first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD). We quantify the distribution of the predictive power of surprisal across model layers using Predictive Depth. Across 12 tested LLMs, we find that readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, while this difference is smaller for TGD. Also, TGD itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both proficiency groups. These patterns suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency. Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of informative internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the practical improvements in prediction are limited. Overall, our results show that layer-wise LLM surprisal provides a useful perspective on variation in reading behaviour across both reader groups and gaze measures.

</details>


### [120] [Billiger.de Products: A Bilingual Entity Matching Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37713)
*Aaron Steiner,Ksenia Elagin,Ralph Peeters,Johannes Knopp,Christian Bizer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Billiger.de Products，一个涵盖13个消费品类别的德英双语实体匹配基准，包含多种难度变体与跨语言测试集。用六种监督匹配器和零样本GPT-5.2验证，结果显示该基准难度高于WDC Products和Abt-Buy，且多数匹配器在英文版上得分更高，而零样本LLM对语言不敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有产品匹配基准主要基于英文数据，且多集中于电子等单一品类，缺乏多品类与非英语场景的评测能力。

Method: 数据来自德国比价平台billiger.de，参照WDC Products设计，构建多难度变体（转角案例比例、开发集大小、训练未见过实体比例不同），并提供对齐的英文翻译，保持所有配对、划分与标签固定，同时构建混合德英记录的跨语言测试集。用六种监督匹配器和零样本GPT-5.2在德、英及跨语言版本上评测。

Result: 多数匹配器在英文版上平均得分高于德文版，RoBERTa与HierGAT差异最大，零样本LLM对语言基本不敏感；PLM匹配器在该基准英文版上的F1低于其在WDC Products和Abt-Buy上的表现，说明本基准更难。

Conclusion: Billiger.de Products 是一个更具挑战性的双语多品类实体匹配基准，能揭示语言与品类对匹配性能的影响，为产品匹配研究提供更严格的评测平台。

Abstract: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces Billiger.de Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform billiger.de. Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that Billiger.de Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.

</details>


### [121] [Which papyrus HTR is good enough? Character-error-rate tolerance of four papyrological tasks on Greek texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37755)
*Anton Repushko,Elena Chepel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过模拟不同字符错误率(CER)的希腊纸莎草文本，测试四种纸草学任务对HTR精度的容忍度，为希腊纸莎草HTR设定基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数希腊纸莎草文献尚未出版和数字化，需要自动转写(HTR)来发掘未读文献。然而古希腊纸莎草识别系统尚处萌芽期，且各纸草学任务对精度的具体需求未经验证。

Method: 从papyri.info的63,846份文本中去除编辑层构造"完美HTR"，用种子算法降解到1-50%的CER(含丢失行与四种错误形态)；训练小型模型(TF-IDF、fastText、字符CNN、ByT5-small)完成文档类型、断代、文献/文学分类任务，并测试八种关键词检索方法；对比净文本与噪声文本训练，评估各CER下的表现。

Result: 容忍度因任务而异：净训练模型下，文献/文学分类在20% CER内保留90%指标；文档类型达7.5%；子类型与检索达5%；断代仅3%。在含错文本上重新训练可消除15% CER以上出现的急剧退化。长文档中集中损伤的容忍度优于短文本中的分散小错。

Conclusion: 研究为四种任务分别给出CER目标，并证明在噪声文本上训练的模型可使当前不完美的文本识别对它们有用。

Abstract: Purpose: Most Greek papyri remain unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would let scholars discover documents and literary works that have so far gone unread. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi, and how accurate they must be for a given papyrological task has not been examined. To answer this and set a benchmark for Greek papyrus HTR, we test a range of character error rates (CER) against four papyrological tasks, using published editions as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in papyri.info, we imitate a letters-only "perfect HTR" output by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1 - 50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. On these data we train small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for document type, dating and documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight keyword search methods. We compare models trained on clean text with models retrained at a specific CER level, and evaluate across CERs. Results: Tolerance differs by task. With clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification retains 90% of its metric up to 20% CER; document type up to 7.5%; subtypes and search up to 5%; dating only up to 3%. Retraining on text containing character errors largely eliminates the sharp degradation that otherwise sets in above 15% CER. Models generally tolerate concentrated damage in a long document better than small errors spread across a short text. Conclusion: The study provides a CER target for each of the four tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make current, imperfect text recognition useful for them.

</details>


### [122] [Selecting What Matters: Semantic Compression-Guided Selective Pooling for Long-Context Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37782)
*Zifeng Cheng,Jie Zheng,Zhiwei Jiang,Shuwen Wang,Fei Shen,Shiping Ge,Qing Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SCSP是一个免训练框架，通过语义压缩提示选出信息量大的token用于长上下文嵌入，提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM长文本嵌入用均匀平均池化，会因冗余内容稀释关键语义信息。

Method: 将文档分句成块，为每块附加语义压缩提示，用提示隔离注意力掩码保留文档token信息流并限制提示到本地上下文；用提示引发的注意力模式估计token重要性，选出信息token并聚合其中间层表示成嵌入。

Result: 在长上下文嵌入基准上，SCSP可即插即用集成到零样本和微调模型中，持续提升性能。

Conclusion: SCSP通过语义压缩实现token选择，有效改善长上下文嵌入质量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings. Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content. To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding. Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk. A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context. We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding. Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.

</details>


### [123] [A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37788)
*Zhangshu Joshua Jiang,Zina Ibrahim,James T. Teo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估语言模型回答中临床推理表达能力的多维评分量表（rubric），整合医学教育评估、临床LLM基准与通用推理评估三方面工作，但目前尚未经过实证效度检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床LLM基准多为任务特定指标，通用推理评估框架又缺乏临床针对性；需要一个结构化、透明的量表来评估模型回答中表达的临床推理质量。

Method: 融合三类来源：(1) 医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、关键特征问题、OSCE）；(2) 临床LLM基准（MedR-Bench、HealthBench、TIMER-Bench、DR.BENCH、PrIME-LLM、PatientSafeBench）；(3) 通用LLM推理评估（Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith）。将"事实性"改编为临床导向的"groundedness"。构建多维框架，对金标准临床案例的自由文本回答评分，含临时行为锚点、适用性规则及独立的安全性关键错误标记。

Result: 提出该量表框架，明确其定位与限制：不替代案例特定参考标准或既有基准的任务特定指标；尚未检验评分者间信度、构念效度或临床实用性。

Conclusion: 该量表的直接目的是使评估决策显式化、可被审视，作为实证测试前的概念性工具；通用领域框架仅供设计参考，不被视为已验证的临床工具。

Abstract: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR.BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

</details>


### [124] [CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37807)
*Philipp E. Glass,Alina Miron*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布 CompOrca，对 423 万条 OpenOrca 语料进行合规/不合规标注，由 5 次独立 LLM 评判投票，提供一致性与不确定性标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究微调如何影响拒绝与不服从行为，需要识别拒绝、回避或未完成任务的训练样本，但现有标注仅覆盖最多几千条提示的评测集，规模严重不足。

Method: 用开源权重的 LLM 评判器（LongCat-2.0，1.6T 参数）对全部 4,233,923 条 OpenOrca 样本做五次独立合规判定，输出一致合规、一致不合规、非一致行及原始投票数。

Result: 单次判定标记 2.7–3.2% 为不合规，五次一致仅 1.28%；对 450 条人工标注（150 条双标，人-人 κ=0.93），一致合规与一致不合规精确率分别为 97.3% 和 86.7%，后者是高精度子集而非完整枚举；现有拒绝检测方法召回仅 0.4%–94.1%。

Conclusion: CompOrca 提供大规模合规标注语料及逐行标签与投票数，可用于过滤歧义样本、支持拒绝与不服从行为研究，并揭示现有检测方法召回差异巨大。

Abstract: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires identifying training examples that refuse, evade or otherwise fail to fulfil the requested task. But existing annotation covers evaluation sets of a few thousand prompts at most. We present CompOrca, a compliance labelling over the entirety of the 4,233,923-example OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five independent passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters), and the corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%) along with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, allowing for filtering the most ambiguous samples. Against 450 human-annotated examples, 150 of them annotated twice (human-human $κ= 0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise, the latter a high-precision subset, not a complete enumeration, of noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1% of the noncompliance class. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca

</details>


### [125] [Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37818)
*Shengbo Cai,Yuxiang Wang,Jingran Xie,Zhisheng Zhang,Shun Lei,Di Cao,Teddy Sun,Zhiyong Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 LoopSLM，用循环 Transformer 做隐式推理，两阶段训练分离"推理"与"回应"学习，缩小感知-推理鸿沟，无需 CoT 即可直接推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共情口语对话需同时利用"说了什么"和"怎么说"。显式 CoT 虽能提升副语言感知并显化声学线索，却不保证其在回应规划中被有效使用（感知-推理鸿沟），且 CoT 难以完整捕捉词语中的声学线索，还带来推理延迟。

Method: LoopSLM 基于循环 Transformer 进行隐式推理，复用同一解码块，每轮迭代在声学接地条件下精炼隐状态；采用两阶段训练，将"学习推理"与"学习回应"分离，从而无需 CoT 即可直接推理。

Result: 在 EchoMind 上，副语言理解、推理与回复质量均优于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B；相比 CoT-SFT 基线，推理准确率提升 20+ 分，同时 token 减少 64.5%、延迟减半；在多数共情回复指标上超过 Qwen3-Omni-Thinking，延迟低 34 倍；仅用对话数据训练也能提升通用音频基准准确率。

Conclusion: 通过循环隐式推理与两阶段训练，可有效弥合感知-推理鸿沟，在降低延迟与 token 开销的同时提升共情对话表现，并展现跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.

</details>


### [126] [The Geometry of Inference in Transformer Residual Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37824)
*Timur Mudarisov,Mikhail Burtsev,Radu State*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究Transformer残差表征如何在推理中逐步变得"特定"于最终结果，对比中间残差状态与自身终点及经验"终点库"，揭示竞争集收缩、方向对齐改善与距离变化的解耦机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer语言模型通过逐层残差更新构建预测，但其表征如何逐步聚焦到某个最终结果仍不清楚。作者希望刻画推理过程中表征"几何特异性"如何增长，并厘清距离、竞争者数量与终点集中度等不同视角的关系。

Method: 在六个预训练语言模型上，比较中间残差状态与自身最终状态、以及其他上下文的经验最终状态库；分析竞争者集合随深度的变化；构建简单高维模型分离范数、方向对齐与终点几何的作用；并从理论上证明指向自身终点的直线路径（欧氏与余弦距离下）不会引入新竞争者；最后考察终点与输出token排名的关系。

Result: 自身终点在早期即比平均替代终点更受偏好，但许多个体终点仍更接近；竞争集随深度总体缩小但成员变化，存活终点未必更彼此相似。方向对齐与终点排名可改善而到终点的欧氏距离几乎不变。观察到的竞争集进入现象表明收敛偏离直线路径。排名越低的输出token对应终点在余弦距离上越远（所有模型一致）。

Conclusion: 这些发现刻画了Transformer推理中几何特异性递增的过程，说明距离、竞争者数量与存活终点的集中度是互补而非冗余的视角，并将残差几何与输出组织联系起来。

Abstract: Transformer language models build predictions through successive residual updates, but how their representations become specific to an eventual outcome remains unclear. We study this process by comparing intermediate residual states with their own final states and an empirical bank of final states from other contexts. Across six pretrained language models, the own endpoint becomes preferable to the average alternative early, while many individual endpoints remain closer. These competing sets generally shrink with depth, but their membership changes and their surviving endpoints need not become more similar to one another. Directional alignment and endpoint rank can therefore improve while Euclidean distance to the final state changes little. We develop a simple high-dimensional model that separates the roles of norm, alignment, and endpoint geometry, showing how gradual directional changes can produce sharp reductions in competition. We also prove that a straight path toward the own endpoint cannot introduce new competitors under either Euclidean or cosine distance; observed entries thus establish departures from straight-line convergence. Finally, endpoints associated with lower-ranked output tokens tend to lie farther away in cosine distance across all studied models, connecting residual geometry to output organization. Together, these findings characterize increasing geometric specificity during transformer inference and explain why distance, competitor count, and concentration of the surviving endpoints provide distinct views of that process.

</details>


### [127] [Can Vision-Language Models Stay Helpful When Facing Implicit Risks? Intent-Privilege OPSD for Efficient Safety-Helpfulness Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37837)
*Haotian Deng,Wenbin Xing,Gang Xu,Tao He,Jinkai Zheng,Chun Li,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出OPSD方法，用训练时的意图作为特权监督，通过单次rollout的自蒸馏让VLM识别跨模态隐性风险，在安全与有用性上均提升，同时大幅降低数据、训练和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM面临跨模态隐性风险：单独看似无害的图文组合会共同诱发不安全响应。现有安全方法需要大量偏好数据、昂贵的多rollout训练或推理时额外防护，且常因直接拒绝而牺牲有用性。

Method: OPSD（Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation）：训练时将基于证据的意图作为特权监督，把教师模型在意图条件下对响应的偏好，通过每个prompt单次rollout蒸馏到学生模型。学生推理时无需意图标注或额外安全模块即可直接响应。

Result: 仅用1,447条安全样本（比标准偏好数据集少95%），训练时间较多次rollout的GRPO式训练减少5倍，平均推理长度降低7%。在全部五个评测组中安全-有用联合成功率最高；在SIUO+HoliSafe合并集上，该成功率从43.9%提升至53.5%。

Conclusion: 训练时的意图监督能够同时提升安全性和有用性，并显著降低数据、训练与推理成本，优于需要大量数据或多rollout的现有方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to cross-modal implicit risks: visual and textual inputs that appear benign in isolation can jointly elicit unsafe responses. Existing safety methods often require large preference datasets, costly multi-rollout training, or additional safeguards at inference time.
