### [188] [When Hedging Changes the Payoff: Option Replication with Price Impact and Execution Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36257)
*David Itkin,Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文研究在对冲中因交易本身产生价格冲击与执行成本，导致对冲操作改变待复制收益的“移动目标”问题，用二项模型和连续时间定价PDE刻画并得到凸收益的精确复制结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用标的资产对冲衍生品时，对冲交易本身会改变标的与衍生品的价格，从而使原本想复制的收益发生变化，形成“移动目标”问题；作者希望在有价格冲击与执行成本的条件下研究这一现象。

Method: 在二项模型中用不动点方程刻画复制；在连续时间下推导非线性定价PDE，其隐式终端条件体现对冲者的移动目标特征；对单调凸Lipschitz收益（如看涨看跌期权）在中间价执行成本下证明精确复制，并进行数值实验。

Result: 数值实验显示：价格冲击会平移有效执行价；期权价格对合约数量呈非线性依赖；执行成本平滑终端持仓；对冲者自身交易可能使原本无价值的期权变为价内；并依据标的市场价格冲击与限价订单簿形状解释期权市场的价差与订单簿形态。

Conclusion: 该框架捕捉了对冲交易引发价格冲击与成本时的“移动目标”复制问题，为期权定价与期权市场微观结构提供了新的解释。

Abstract: Hedging a derivative by trading the underlying asset changes the payoff that the hedging intended to replicate. We study this phenomenon when trading generates price impact and execution costs. In a binomial model, we characterize replication through a fixed-point equation. In continuous time, we derive a nonlinear pricing PDE whose implicit terminal condition captures the nature of the moving target problem of the hedger. For monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs (such as calls and puts) we establish exact replication under midpoint execution costs. Numerical experiments illustrate: (i) how price impact shifts the effective strike, (ii) the non-linear dependence of the option price on the number of contracts, (iii) how execution costs smooth terminal holdings, (iv) the extent to which the hedger's own trading can bring an otherwise worthless option into the money, and (v) we explain the spread and the shape of the limit order book in the options market based on the price impact and the shape of the limit order book of the underlying.

</details>


### [189] [Dyson-Schwinger Effective-Action Methods for Rough Volatility: A Correlation-Response Architecture for Calibration, Exotics and Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37741)
*Frédéric Pauquay*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文提出基于2PI有效作用量与Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程的非微扰随机波动率期权定价框架，用自洽高斯近似状态变量联合分布，统一处理马尔可夫与粗糙(Volterra)模型，在多个模型上达到高精度且计算高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机波动率(尤其粗糙波动率)模型期权定价缺乏统一、非微扰且高效的计算框架，传统泰勒截断与bump-and-revalue方法精度或效率不足。

Method: 在log-price/log-volatility或Lamperti坐标下，用2PI有效作用量及Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程，以自洽高斯近似联合律；均值与有效扩散由2PI平稳条件给出，漂移Jacobian由统计线性化确定；指数与CEV交互用精确高斯矩生成函数而非泰勒截断。时间局域性区分马尔可夫(间隙方程化为少数ODE)与粗糙(保留双时传播子，特征函数化为对数方差场上的高斯积分)。

Result: 在exp-OU、SABR、rough Bergomi及rough SABR上，确定性引擎与PDE或QMC参考匹配：误差从exp-OU的亚基点级、SABR与rough Bergomi的单位数基点级，到rough SABR的数十基点级；rough Heston作为可精确变换的对照。条件于波动率场时，远期起始微笑与连续监测障碍化为仅场积分；因果响应块一次收缩即得完整impulse-vega曲线，比bump-and-revalue快1-2个数量级。

Conclusion: 该2PI/间隙方程框架为随机波动率期权定价提供统一、非微扰且高效的确定性引擎，覆盖马尔可夫与粗糙模型，并自然导出微笑、障碍及vega的高效计算；附技术补充含完整推导、扩展基准及随机利率FX局部波动率等二次应用。

Abstract: We develop a non-perturbative framework for stochastic-volatility option pricing organised by the two-particle-irreducible (2PI) effective action and the Dyson-Schwinger gap equations of quantum field theory. In log-price, log-volatility or Lamperti coordinates, the joint law of the state variables is approximated by a self-consistent Gaussian whose mean and effective diffusion follow from the 2PI stationarity conditions, with the drift Jacobian given by statistical linearisation. The smile-generating exponential and CEV interactions are evaluated through the exact Gaussian moment-generating function rather than a Taylor cut. Whether the dressed inverse propagator is local in time separates Markovian models, where the gap equation collapses to a few ODEs, from rough (Volterra) models, where the full two-time propagator is retained and the characteristic function becomes a Gaussian integral over the log-variance field. Across exp-OU, SABR, rough Bergomi and rough SABR, the resulting deterministic engines match PDE or quasi-Monte-Carlo references from sub-basis-point (exp-OU) through single-digit basis points (SABR, rough Bergomi) to tens of basis points (rough SABR), with rough Heston as an exactly-transformable control. Conditional on the volatility field, forward-start smiles and continuously-monitored barriers reduce to field-only quadratures, in rough Bergomi directly on the native Volterra field, and the causal response block yields the full impulse-vega curve in one contraction at one-to-two orders of magnitude below bump-and-revalue. A technical supplement with complete derivations, extended benchmarks and secondary applications (stochastic-rate FX local volatility, quadratic Gaussian Volterra variance and the arbitrage-free FX triangle) is provided as an ancillary file.

</details>


### [190] [Finite-Horizon Reversible Investment under Multi-Factor Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36405)
*Junkee Jeon,Takwon Kim,Jinwan Park,A. Max Reppen*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 研究有限期可逆投资问题，通过奇异控制-最优切换对应将边际容量的价值转化为抛物双障碍问题，证明解的存在唯一性与自由边界性质，并数值发现需求改善对撤资边界的影响呈超加性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业在多因子不确定环境下需在购买成本与较低残值之间权衡容量调整；现有分析对有限期、多因子、含撤资的可逆投资自由边界刻画不足。

Method: 在多因子几何布朗运动下建立有限期可逆投资模型（比例购买成本、较低残值）；利用奇异控制与最优切换对应，导出边际容量价值满足一族抛物双障碍问题；证明强解存在唯一及局部Sobolev正则性；刻画投资、等待、撤资区域由连续且严格分离的自由边界划分；验证反射容量过程的最优性；进行数值分析。

Result: 需求联合改善使两条边界均以超加性方式移动；在撤资边界处影响强度为1.5–2.7倍（取决于因子相关性）。

Conclusion: 给出有限期多因子可逆投资问题边际价值的严谨刻画与自由边界结构，并揭示联合需求冲击对撤资决策的超加性放大效应。

Abstract: We study a finite-horizon reversible investment problem in which a risk-neutral firm adjusts capacity at a proportional purchase cost and a lower salvage value under multi-factor geometric Brownian motion. Via the singular control--optimal switching correspondence, the marginal value of capacity solves a family of parabolic double-obstacle problems. We prove existence, uniqueness and local Sobolev regularity of the strong solution, characterize investment, waiting and disinvestment regions by continuous, strictly separated free boundaries, and verify optimality of the reflected capacity process. Numerically, joint demand improvements shift both boundaries super-additively, 1.5--2.7 times as strongly at the disinvestment boundary, depending on factor correlation.

</details>


### [191] [Global Structure and Local Specifications in Sublinear Valuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37881)
*Jongjin Park,David Criens,Hyungbin Park*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文在带消灭的时间齐次马尔可夫框架下，研究次线性估值规则、不确定性结构与局部设定之间的关系，通过鲁棒估值、全局化、局部化三个映射建立联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刻画次线性估值、不确定性结构与局部设定三类对象之间的内在联系，提供序关系、概率与PDE表示及模型恢复的框架。

Method: 在上生成元的有限性与局部性及Lyapunov条件下，引入鲁棒估值、全局化、局部化三个映射，并进行序同构分析、局部设定刻画与HJB方程的粘性解刻画。

Result: 不确定性结构与次线性估值规则类通过鲁棒估值映射序同构；局部化与全局化的复合产生规范极值元而非还原原对象；局部设定生成的次线性估值由HJB方程的最大粘性下解刻画；带消灭的不确定性结构可唯一表示为累积折现过程与状态律配对的族。

Conclusion: 该框架在不需要鞅问题唯一性或粘性比较原理的前提下，为次线性估值提供了序关系、概率与PDE表示及模型恢复的统一理论基础。

Abstract: This work studies the relationships among sublinear valuation rules, uncertainty structures, and local specifications in a time-homogeneous Markovian framework with killing. These objects are linked, under finiteness and locality of the upper generator and a Lyapunov condition, by three maps: robust valuation, globalization, and localization. First, we show that the corresponding classes of uncertainty structures and sublinear valuation rules are order-isomorphic via the robust valuation map. Second, our analysis clarifies how local specifications constrain sublinear valuation and uncertainty structures, as well as what information localization and globalization preserve. In particular, the compositions of localization and globalization need not recover the original objects but yield canonical extremal elements. Third, the sublinear valuation generated by a local specification is characterized by the greatest viscosity subsolution of the associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation. Finally, each uncertainty structure with killing admits a unique representation by a family of pairs consisting of a cumulative discounting process and an underlying state law. These results provide a framework for order relations, probabilistic and PDE-based representations, and model recovery in sublinear valuation without requiring uniqueness of the underlying martingale problems or a viscosity comparison principle.

</details>

### [192] [A Generalized Langevin Model of Latent Liquidity and Concave Price Impact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37872)
*Andrey Itkin*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 将市场冲击建模为对提交订单流的响应，净除潜在交易者的反向流；潜在池的耗尽与恢复由广义Langevin方程控制，聚合后自然涌现平方根冲击规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释市场冲击中平方根规律等非线性现象的来源，避免人为假设平方根冲击律，并从微观个体交易响应出发推导宏观冲击形态。

Method: 以潜在交易者反向流为核心，其激活取决于价格位移是否超过个体阈值；订单流耗尽该池，恢复过程用广义Langevin方程描述，记忆核为有限指数和，从而获得精确的Markovian提升；在未耗尽池假设下对个体响应进行聚合推导冲击规律。

Result: 聚合后在线性小订单与线性大订单极限之间自然出现中间平方根区间；令阈值与响应随价格噪声缩放，冲击与波动率成正比；阈值随执行期限增长时冲击与期限无关；固定显示深度下，对数价格约定的期望往返成本非负，且与记忆无关。数值实验显示耗尽会缩窄平方根区间，不同记忆谱在大量先前交易后表现不同。

Conclusion: 该模型从潜在交易者阈值响应与池恢复机制出发，无需强加即得平方根冲击律，并给出波动率、期限及往返成本性质；市场数据校准留待配套论文。

Abstract: We model market impact as the response to submitted order flow net of counterflow from latent traders, activated when price displacements from the level that would prevail without the order exceed individual thresholds. Order flow depletes this pool, and a generalized Langevin equation governs its recovery over several time scales. Its memory kernels are finite sums of exponentials, so its Markovian lift is exact rather than an approximation. For an undepleted pool, aggregation under explicit assumptions on individual trading responses yields an intermediate square-root regime between linear small- and large-order limits, without imposing a square-root impact law. Scaling thresholds and responses with price noise makes impact in this regime proportional to volatility, and thresholds that grow with the execution horizon make it independent of duration. With constant displayed depth, expected round-trip costs are nonnegative under the log-price convention, independently of the memory. Numerical experiments show that depletion narrows the square-root range and that memory spectra producing similar single-order impacts can respond differently after substantial prior trading. Calibration to market data is left to a companion paper.

</details>


### [193] [Not All LPs Are Equal: The Active-Passive Gap in Automated Market Maker Liquidity Provision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37963)
*Agathe Sadeghi,Dingyue Liu,Ciamac Moallemi,Xin Wan,Brian Zhu*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文提出基于markout的框架，用LIFO减法和无穷小LP基准两种方法，将Uniswap LP盈利拆分为主动与被动成分，揭示集中流动性池中存在系统性主被动收益差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往对AMM流动性提供多在池层面分析，隐含假设LP同质化，掩盖了不同LP策略（尤其集中流动性下的主动调仓）之间的收益差异，也无法区分被动LP的真实表现与池整体表现。

Method: 构建markout框架分解Uniswap LP盈利：(1) LIFO减法，匹配短周期mint-burn持仓，按流动性份额归属swap级markout；(2) 无穷小LP基准，直接从AMM价格路径估计完全被动、始终在区间内的边际LP表现。应用于以太坊、Arbitrum、Base上的Uniswap v2/v3/v4池。

Result: Uniswap v2中主动行为几乎不存在，整体与被动markout基本一致；集中流动性池存在系统性主被动差距，被动LP表现低于池整体。差距在以太坊上大于L2，与更快出块和排序条件使主动流动性更有用一致。被动LP在高费率池表现更好。LIFO与无穷小估计在多数池中方向一致，验证了分解的稳健性。

Conclusion: AMM中的逆向选择在LP间并非均匀分布，对LP策略、费率层级设计及DEX市场质量度量有重要启示。

Abstract: Liquidity provision in automated market makers is typically analyzed at the pool level, implicitly assuming LP homogeneity. This aggregate view can hide how liquidity provision outcomes differ between LP strategies, particularly as concentrated liquidity AMM designs operating on high-performance blockchains allow liquidity to be actively repositioned around trades. We develop a markout-based framework to decompose Uniswap LP profitability into active and passive components using two complementary methods: a LIFO subtraction method that matches short-lived mint-burn positions and attributes swap-level markouts by liquidity share; and an infinitesimal LP benchmark that estimates the performance of a fully passive, always-in-range marginal LP directly from the AMM price path.
  We apply these methods to Uniswap v2, v3, and v4 pools on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base chains, and find passive profitability can materially differ from aggregate pool profitability.In Uniswap v2, with liquidity distributed evenly and active LP behavior nearly absent, the overall and passive markouts are almost the same. In contrast, concentrated-liquidity pools have a systematic active-passive gap: passive LPs tend to underperform aggregate pool-level measures. The gap is wider on Ethereum than on L2s, consistent with active liquidity provision being more useful when block times and ordering conditions allow LPs to react to incoming flow. In general, passive LPs perform better on higher fee pools. The LIFO and infinitesimal estimates are generally consistent directionally across most pools, providing evidence of the robustness of the decomposition. The results suggest that adverse selection in AMMs is not evenly distributed among LPs, with important implications for LP strategy, fee-tier design and measurement of DEX market quality.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [194] [What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36054)
*Alan Chan,Christoph Winter,Andrew Barto,Jakub Pachocki,Geoffrey Hinton,Eric Horvitz,Yoshua Bengio,Dawn Song,Jack Clark,Hilary Greaves,Anton Korinek,Samuel Hammond,Thore Graepel,Ben Bariach,Philip H. S. Torr,Sheila A. McIlraith,Jeff Clune,Sam Manning,Girish Sastry,Tom Davidson,Daniel Eth,Sören Mindermann*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估AI自动化AI研发可能引发"智能爆炸"的证据，分析其潜在影响并提出政策建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统现已编写其创造公司中的大部分代码，随着AI研发流程被自动化，可能引发"智能爆炸"，即在数月内压缩数年的进展。初步证据表明这种可能性存在，且后果重大，值得认真研究。

Method: 评估支持智能爆炸的初步证据，分析其潜在影响，并提出政策应对方案。

Result: AI系统有望在几年内自动化大部分AI研发工作，甚至可能全部自动化。若触发智能爆炸，可能大幅提前带来AI收益，但也带来极端风险：能力增长超越社会适应速度、人类可能失去对超级AI的控制、国家/企业/政府部门间的权力制衡被严重侵蚀。

Conclusion: 尽管存在不确定性，但高风险要求进一步严肃关注。政策制定者应紧急提升对AI研发自动化的可见性，开发引导和约束智能爆炸的方法，并帮助社会适应其影响。

Abstract: In contrast to even a year ago, AI systems now write most of the code inside the companies that build them. As more of the AI research and development (R&D) pipeline is automated, could AI progress radically accelerate in an "intelligence explosion," where years of advances are compressed into months or less? Preliminary evidence suggests that it could. In this work, we assess this evidence, analyze an intelligence explosion's potential impacts, and propose policy responses. AI systems are on track to automate most AI R\&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it. If this triggers an intelligence explosion, it could dramatically bring forward AI's benefits, but also pose extreme risks: capabilities growth could accelerate far beyond what society can keep up with, humanity could lose control over superhuman AI systems, and checks on power within and between states, companies, and branches of government could be severely eroded. Although there remains much uncertainty about these possibilities, the high stakes warrant serious further attention. Policymakers should urgently obtain more visibility into the automation of AI R&D, develop ways to steer and constrain an intelligence explosion, and prepare society to adapt to an intelligence explosion's impacts.

</details>


### [195] [Argus: Academic Integrity in the Era of Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36073)
*David Racovan,Ajay Rawat,Christopher K. May,Jeffrey A. Turkstra*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Argus系统，通过行为与风格指标自动检测本科C编程作业中LLM辅助的学生作品，并在Purdue大学CS2课程六年数据上验证，发现2026春季45%学生表现出LLM辅助开发特征，且与线下考试成绩显著负相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在教育领域快速普及，给学术诚信的执行带来重大挑战，尤其是编程课程。现有缺乏有效的自动化检测手段来识别LLM辅助的学生作业。

Method: Argus整合行为指标与风格指标，构建学生完成作业过程的整体画像，并揭示指向潜在LLM滥用的异常。研究基于Purdue大学大型CS2课程六年春季学期数据进行量化分析，并探讨假阳性缓解问题。

Result: 2026春季学期45%的注册学生表现出与LLM辅助代码开发一致的模式；被标记的LLM使用与线下监考笔试成绩呈显著负相关。

Conclusion: 任何自动化检测系统都必须配套结构化的人工复核流程；研究讨论了未来课程设计、学术政策调整及LLM工具对计算机科学教育的教学启示。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in the context of education has introduced significant challenges in enforcement of academic integrity, especially in programming courses. We present Argus, an automated detection system for LLM-assisted student work in undergraduate C programming assignments. Argus integrates behavioral and stylistic indicators to create a holistic picture of the student's progress through an assignment and surfaces anomalies that point to potential misuse of LLM assistance. We quantify and analyze data over six years of Spring semester offerings in a large-enrollment CS2 course at Purdue University using Argus, finding that 45% of enrolled students exhibited patterns consistent with LLM-assisted code development in Spring 2026. To contextualize these results, we analyze the relationship between flagged LLM use and student performance on written, in-person proctored examinations, and find a significant negative correlation. We also explore the problem of mitigating false positives, recognizing that erroneous accusations of academic integrity carry significant consequences for students and instructors alike, particularly in the context of large enrollment courses. We argue that any automated detection system must be accompanied by a structured process for human review. We discuss the consequences for future course design, changing academic policy as these tools become more ubiquitous, and the pedagogical implications of LLM-based tools in computer science education.

</details>


### [196] [After the Award: The Authorization Gap in Academic Access to Frontier AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36304)
*Olga Lavinda*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 论文提出"授权缺口"概念，指AI学术访问项目中"获得访问资格"与"获得机构授权实际研究使用"之间的差距。通过15个项目（10个符合纳入标准）的结构化编码及一所美国大学的过程追踪，发现下游规范普遍薄弱，且机构政策常使免费工具也需审查，导致授权路径不明确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术访问项目将前沿AI作为研究基础设施分发，但"获奖授予"与"机构授权"是两个不同阶段。论文关注这一交接环节，试图揭示从访问资格到实际可用研究基础设施之间的落差为何被忽视。

Method: 对2026年9月19日记录的15个公开访问路径进行结构化编码（10个符合预设标准），并在美国一所大学进行过程追踪。采用两次独立的模型辅助编码，考察资格标准、访问时长、使用/成效指标、责任归属等公开条款。

Result: 9个项目有明确资格标准，3个隐含机构前提；访问时长在6个项目中未说明，7个无使用或成效指标，责任归属在5至7个项目中未说明；8至9个项目未建立明确的机构独立路径。机构追踪显示，政策要求即便免费工具也需审查，一次请求仅生成工单，观察期内无实质回应或决策路径。

Conclusion: 论文定义"授权缺口"为访问授予与授权研究使用之间的距离，并建议追踪首次使用、审批、首次使用时间及持续性，以帮助项目区分"已分配资源"与"可用的科学基础设施"。

Abstract: Academic access programs distribute frontier artificial intelligence as research infrastructure, but awards and institutional authorization are distinct stages. We examine the handoff through structured coding of 15 publicly documented access pathways captured on 19 September 2026, of which ten met prespecified inclusion criteria, and a process trace at one US university. Two isolated model-assisted coding passes found explicit eligibility criteria in nine programs and three implied institutional prerequisites across the corpus. Downstream specification was weaker: access duration was unstated in six programs, seven reported no use or outcome metric, and liability assignment was unstated in five to seven. Public terms did not establish an unambiguous institution-independent path from award to intended use in eight to nine programs, a composite that includes possible and unclear cases. In the institutional trace, policy required review even for free tools. A bounded request generated a ticket but no substantive response or decision pathway during the observation window. We define the authorization gap as the distance between an access award and authorized research use. Tracking first use, clearance, time to first use, and persistence would help programs distinguish allocated resources from usable scientific infrastructure.

</details>


### [197] [Early Prediction of AI-Assisted Cheating Risk in Online Exams Through Learning Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37280)
*Gökhan Akçapınar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 利用学期前8周LMS数字痕迹，可在期末考试前预测AI辅助作弊高风险学生，逻辑回归准确率达73.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助作弊威胁在线考试安全，希望提前识别风险以及时提供学业引导。

Method: 52名大一学生，依据期末监考日志中的可疑行为（复制、失焦、右键）标记为低/高风险；从数字痕迹提取27个特征中筛选5个，用逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、随机森林、梯度提升建模，采用留一交叉验证（含折内预处理与特征选择）。

Result: 23人（44.2%）被标为高风险；逻辑回归表现最佳（准确率73.1%）；课程模块浏览、作业提交、访问视频的天数为各折中最稳定特征。

Conclusion: LMS交互数据可作为AI辅助作弊风险的早期信号，用于支持及时的学业指导，而非认定不当行为或启动纪律处分。

Abstract: AI-assisted cheating has become an important threat to the security of online exams. This study examines whether the risk of AI-assisted cheating in the final exam can be predicted using students' digital traces in the learning management system (LMS) during the first eight weeks of the semester. The sample comprised 52 first-year undergraduates enrolled in a bachelor's program in Computer Education and Instructional Technology and taking an Introduction to Programming course at a public university in Turkiye. Students were labeled as low- or high-risk based on suspicious behaviors recorded in the final-exam logs, including copy, focus-loss, and right-click events. Of the 52 students, 23 (44.2%) were labeled as high-risk in a proctored, face-to-face exam. Group membership was then predicted using five features selected from 27 candidates extracted from students' digital traces. Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting algorithms were used to build the prediction models. Model performance was evaluated using leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) with fold-specific preprocessing and feature selection. Logistic Regression achieved the best performance (Accuracy = 73.1%). The results indicate that LMS interaction data can provide an early signal of AI-assisted cheating risk. Course-module views, assignment submissions, and the number of days on which course videos were accessed were the most consistently selected features across the LOOCV folds. These predictions are intended to support timely academic guidance, not to establish misconduct or initiate disciplinary action.

</details>


### [198] [Digital Labor Platforms as Infrastructure of Extractivism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37614)
*Julian Posada*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本章提出"平台采掘主义"框架，揭示AI如何通过数字平台占用数据与劳动、集中价值于硅谷等核心地区，并延续殖民性等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代AI被视为技术性产业，但其对数据与劳动的依赖常被掩盖。作者希望揭示平台作为"采掘主义基础设施"的角色，理解价值如何被核心地区攫取，以及殖民性如何被再生产。

Method: 理论综合与混合方法研究：结合数字劳动研究、拉美批判思想，并对委内瑞拉与哥伦比亚的数据工人开展混合方法调查。

Result: AI依赖不稳定的平台劳动来完成数据生产、清洗、标注与维护；标注系统将美国等文化特定范畴普遍化为"普适知识"，再生产殖民等级；数据劳动由无偿再生产劳动、社区网络与物质条件支撑。

Conclusion: 平台采掘主义表明AI是资本主义下劳动密集、嵌入领土的政治经济体系，延续殖民性遗产。

Abstract: This chapter examines how digital platforms, as infrastructures of extractivism in contemporary artificial intelligence, enable corporations to appropriate data and labour while concentrating value in core regions such as Silicon Valley. It proposes platform extractivism as a framework linking commodification, epistemic dominance, and reproduction through territory. Drawing on digital labour studies, Latin American critical thought, and mixed-methods research with Venezuelan and Colombian data workers, the chapter discusses how AI depends on precarious platform labour to produce, clean, annotate, and maintain data. It further shows how annotation systems normalize culturally specific categories, especially US norms, as universal knowledge, reproducing colonial hierarchies. Finally, it highlights how data work is sustained by unpaid reproductive labour, community networks, and material conditions that make workers available for platform labour. Platform extractivism thus reveals AI as a labour-intensive and territorially embedded political-economic system under capitalism that perpetuates legacies of coloniality.

</details>


### [199] [Bathtubs, Boundaries, and Sandboxes: AI Regulatory Learning under Legal Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04094)
*Tom Deckenbrunnen,Alessio Buscemi,Marco Almada,Alfredo Capozucca,German Castignani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文以AI Act为例，用Coleman的浴缸模型分析AI治理中的监管学习空间，论证法律不确定性无法完全事前消除、且在合理范围内对监管学习是必要的，并借助边界物与边界协商物解释法律要求向操作实践的转化，提出技术沙箱框架所需的具体属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI快速发展和涌现特性使政策制定者依赖高层次原则和抽象法律要求，虽有利于面向未来的以人为本监管，但导致下游开发、企业和审计机构难以将抽象要求转化为可验证的技术要求，造成法律不确定性。

Method: 以AI Act为案例，运用Coleman的浴缸模型分析AI治理中的监管学习空间；引入边界物（boundary objects）和边界协商物（boundary negotiating artifacts）解释法律要求向操作实践的翻译；并考察技术沙箱框架以识别技术基础设施作为边界协商物所需的具体属性。

Result: 论证法律不确定性无法完全事前降低，且在合理范围内是监管学习所必需的，因为它创造了围绕社会技术意义进行边界协商的空间；同时归纳出技术基础设施在AI评估中有效发挥边界协商物作用所需的具体属性。

Conclusion: 法律确定性仍是长期目标，但过早封闭监管工具可能损害适应性治理所需的学习过程。

Abstract: Effective regulation of AI is a defining policy challenge, driven by their integration into all aspects of society. To remain responsive to their rapid development and emergent properties, policymakers across the globe rely on high-level principles and abstract legal requirements. Yet, while this flexibility supports future-proofing human-centred regulations and aligning them with socio-ethical values, it also causes legal uncertainty downstream as developers, companies, and auditors struggle with translating these abstract requirements into verifiable technical requirements. Using the AI Act as an example, this paper draws on Coleman's bathtub to analyse the regulatory learning space in AI governance. It argues that legal uncertainty cannot be fully reduced ex ante and that, within reasonable bounds, it is also necessary for regulatory learning because it creates the space in which boundary negotiation over socio-technical meaning can occur. Building on this analysis, the paper shows how boundary objects and boundary negotiating artifacts help explain the translation of legal requirements into operational practice. By examining technical sandbox frameworks, it further identifies concrete properties that technical infrastructures must possess to function effectively as boundary negotiation artifacts in AI assessment. The paper concludes that legal certainty remains the long-term aim, but that premature closure of regulatory instruments risks undermining the learning processes needed for adaptive governance.

</details>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [200] [Probabilistic Seasonality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36280)
*Feras A. Saad,Todd B. Walker*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 提出一种概率模型发现方法，将时间序列分解为季节性与非季节性成分，并给出季节成分结构与参数的后验分布，在模拟和疫情期间的美国宏观数据中优于X-13ARIMA-SEATS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 季节性调整对经济分析至关重要，但季节成分本质上是不可观测的潜在变量，导致调整结果存在不确定性。传统方法（如X-13ARIMA-SEATS）难以量化这种不确定性。

Method: 一种概率模型发现方法，将时间序列分解为季节性和非季节性两部分，返回关于季节性成分结构及其参数的后验分布。

Result: 模拟研究中，该方法在点预测、区间预测以及季节成分恢复方面均优于X-13ARIMA-SEATS；在COVID-19衰退期间八个美国宏观经济序列的研究中，该方法能实时揭示当前季节性调整的显著事前不确定性，且远早于许多X-13修订达到最终峰值。

Conclusion: 该方法能更早、更有效地量化季节性调整的不确定性，为经济分析提供更可靠的季节调整与预测工具。

Abstract: Seasonal adjustment is fundamental to economic analysis, but uncertain because seasonal components are inherently latent. This article introduces a probabilistic model discovery method that decomposes a time series into seasonal and nonseasonal components. The method returns a posterior distribution over the structure and parameters of a seasonal component. In simulation studies, the method can improve point forecasts, interval predictions, and recovery of seasonal components relative to X-13ARIMA-SEATS. In a study of eight U.S. macroeconomic series during the COVID-19 recession, the method surfaces significant ex-ante uncertainty about current seasonal adjustments in real time, well before many X-13 revisions reach their eventual peaks.

</details>


### [201] [Continuously Updating GMM in Linear IV Models: A Polynomial Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36445)
*Marcelo J. Moreira,Whitney K. Newey,Mahrad Sharifvaghefi*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文刻画线性IV模型中CU-GMM目标函数的全局最小值，将其转化为多项式比值并借助代数方法求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CU-GMM目标函数可能存在局部极小值，经典特征向量方法难以直接推广，因此需要系统刻画其全局最小值。

Method: 允许异方差/自相关/聚类下的最优权重矩阵。证明目标函数为多项式比值；单个内生变量时平稳点对应伴随矩阵实特征值，比较目标值与无穷远处取值确定全局最小；多个内生变量时用代数消元与实解检验筛选有限候选值（含边界值）。

Result: 单个内生变量情形扩展了LIML经典特征向量方法；多个内生变量情形可识别全局最小；Galois理论表明即使一个内生变量两个工具变量也无根式通解，但可数值求根。

Conclusion: 求得全局最小值后可计算过度识别检验与似然比检验，包括CLR检验。

Abstract: This paper characterizes the global minimum of the continuously updating generalized method of moments (CU-GMM) objective in linear instrumental variables models. We allow optimal weighting matrices under heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, or clustering. We show that the objective is a ratio of polynomials. For one endogenous regressor, stationary points of CU-GMM objective function are real eigenvalues of a companion matrix. Comparing their objective values with the value at infinity gives the global minimum, extending the classical eigenvector approach to limited information maximum likelihood. With multiple endogenous regressors, algebraic elimination and checks for real solutions identify the minimum among finitely many candidate objective values, including boundary values. Galois theory rules out general formulas by radicals even with one endogenous regressor and two instruments, while numerical root finding remains possible. Finding the global minimum allows us to compute overidentification and likelihood ratio tests, including the conditional likelihood ratio (CLR) test.

</details>


### [202] [Testing for Unobserved Heterogeneity in Censored Duration Models: EM Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36824)
*Hiroyuki Kasahara,Hirokazu Matsuyama,Katsumi Shimotsu,Shota Takeishi*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一种EM检验，用于删失Weibull久期模型中的未观测异质性，其渐近零分布为[max{0,N(0,1)}]^2，无需模拟或自助法确定临界值，在模拟和实证中均优于LRT等现有检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 忽略久期模型中的未观测异质性会导致参数估计偏误并使推断失效，但对它的检验是非正则的：零假设位于参数空间边界，且部分参数在零假设下不可识别，因此标准渐近理论不适用；同时现有检验（如LRT）在有限样本下偏保守或过度拒绝。

Method: 基于Li、Chen和Marriott（2009）的EM方法，作者为删失Weibull久期模型的未观测异质性构造了一个EM检验统计量，其渐近零分布为[max{0,N(0,1)}]^2，能处理任意形式的协变量依赖删失；并通过Monte Carlo模拟将EM检验与Cho和White（2010）的LRT、信息矩阵检验和拉格朗日乘子检验进行比较，最后应用于Stanford心脏移植数据。

Result: 在样本量500及以上时，EM检验的经验检验水平接近名义水平，而LRT明显偏保守、其他检验过度拒绝；EM检验的规模调整功效与LRT相当并高于其他检验。由于规模调整在实践中不可得，在多数设计下EM检验的实际功效高于LRT。应用于Stanford心脏移植数据时，EM检验在所有协变量设定下均拒绝同质性，而LRT的结论依赖于用户选择的可容许参数值集合及模型设定。

Conclusion: EM检验为删失Weibull久期模型中的未观测异质性提供了一个临界值易得、推断可靠且实际功效更高的检验方法，相较现有非正则检验具有明显优势。

Abstract: Ignoring unobserved heterogeneity in duration models biases parameter estimates and invalidates inference, but testing for it is non-regular: the null hypothesis lies on the boundary of the parameter space and some parameters are unidentified under the null. These features render standard asymptotic theory inapplicable. This paper develops an EM test for unobserved heterogeneity in censored Weibull duration models, building on the EM approach of Li, Chen, and Marriott (2009). The test statistic has an asymptotic null distribution equal to the square of max{0, N(0,1)}, hence critical values require neither simulation nor bootstrap, and the test accommodates covariate-dependent censoring of arbitrary form. Monte Carlo simulations compare the EM test with the likelihood ratio test (LRT) of Cho and White (2010), information matrix tests, and Lagrange multiplier tests. The EM test has empirical size close to the nominal level for sample sizes of 500 or more, where the LRT remains markedly conservative and the other tests over-reject. Its size-adjusted power is comparable to that of the LRT and higher than that of the other tests. Because size adjustment requires knowledge of the data-generating process and is unavailable in practice, the EM test attains higher power than the LRT in most designs as the tests would actually be applied. In an application to the Stanford Heart Transplant data, the EM test rejects homogeneity in every covariate specification, whereas the LRT's conclusion depends on a user-chosen set of admissible parameter values and on the specification.

</details>


### [203] [Are there asymmetries in euro area monetary policy transmission?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37168)
*Michael Pfarrhofer,Anna Stelzer*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文用基于贝叶斯加性回归树的非线性混频VAR，结合月度宏观金融变量与季度银行贷款调查数据，识别高频货币政策冲击的动态响应，发现政策传导存在显著的不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答标题所提出的问题（货币政策传导是否具有非对称性），探究紧缩与宽松政策对经济的影响差异。

Method: 构建非线性混频向量自回归（MF-VAR），采用贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）估计，融合月度宏观金融变量与季度银行贷款调查数据，并借助高频政策意外识别动态响应。

Result: 符号不对称性占主导：紧缩政策的传导大体符合理论预期，而任意幅度的宽松政策响应大多不显著；峰值效应随初始条件变化，但若干常见的预设制度划分并未导致冲击传导的显著差异。

Conclusion: 货币政策传导具有明显的符号不对称性，紧缩与宽松效果迥异，且传统制度划分对传导差异的解释力有限。

Abstract: We answer the question posed in the title with a nonlinear mixed-frequency vector autoregression, estimated with Bayesian additive regression trees. The model combines monthly macro-financial variables with quarterly bank lending survey data, and identifies the dynamic responses from high-frequency policy surprises. Sign asymmetry dominates; a tightening produces monetary policy transmission mostly in line with the theoretical predictions, whereas easing of any size produces mostly insignificant responses. Peak effects vary with initial conditions, while several common, predefined regime splits do not yield considerable differences in the propagation of the shocks.

</details>


### [204] [Debiased Inference for Bounding Wage Inequality with Many Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37412)
*Yaroslav Korobka,Vira Semenova*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 提出两步估计与推断方法，用于识别集依赖需估计的第一阶段冗余参数的偏识别问题，结合正交矩不等式与交叉拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏识别参数的识别集常依赖一个本身需要估计的第一阶段冗余参数，直接估计会带来偏差与推断困难，需处理这种两阶段不确定性。

Method: 将准则函数方法与Neyman正交矩理论（DML基础）结合：第一步用柔性机器学习估计点识别的冗余参数；第二步以正交矩不等式构造样本准则，用交叉拟合并取其水平集作为目标识别集的估计。

Result: 当等高线水平有界时，集合估计量在Hausdorff距离下达到基于真实冗余参数的不可行准则的参数速率；提出子抽样推断程序，在第一阶段误差乘积为o(N^{-1/2})时保证渐近有效覆盖。

Conclusion: 方法在就业选择下的工资分布与分位数间距界、区间删失工资的性别工资差距上得到验证，并用2015年CPS三月补充数据实证研究性别工资差距。

Abstract: We study estimation and inference for a partially identified parameter whose identified set depends on a first-stage nuisance parameter that must itself be estimated. Combining the criterion-function approach with the theory of Neyman-orthogonal moments that underlies double/debiased machine learning, we propose a two-step procedure: the point-identified nuisance is estimated by flexible machine-learning methods, and the set-identified target is recovered as a level set of a sample criterion built from orthogonal moment inequalities with cross-fitting. When the contour level is bounded, we show that the resulting set estimator converges in Hausdorff distance at the parametric rate of the infeasible criterion built on the true nuisance. We further develop a subsampling procedure that delivers asymptotically valid coverage, provided the product of the first-stage estimation errors is $o(N^{-1/2})$. We illustrate the method on bounds for the wage distribution and the interquantile range under selection into employment and on the gender wage gap with an interval-censored wage. The empirical application studies the gender wage gap using the March supplement of the 2015 Current Population Survey.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [205] [OpenAI-HuggingFace: A Reproduction & Lessons for Alignment Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35799)
*Stewart Slocum,Malayandi Palan,Christopher Chute,Michael Kim,Benjamin Van Roy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以OpenAI-Hugging Face安全事件为案例，复现其失调行为，证明审计智能体可在高算力下引出类似行为，并提出用上下文强化学习降低所需算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐测试实践可能无法预见跨渠道协作突破安全基础设施的失调行为，需要探究是否需要改变测试方法。

Method: 在模拟原始流程与工具的环境中，用公开模型复现导致事件失调行为；让审计智能体依据高层定性描述引出相似行为；并测试上下文强化学习（RL）算法的作用。

Result: 审计智能体在高算力预算下可引出类似失调行为；复现不同行为所需算力差异巨大，说明可引出行为范围随算力扩展；简单上下文RL显著减少所需算力。

Conclusion: 需要可扩展且高效的自动化对齐测试方法，RL是很有前景的方向；作者公开代码与记录。

Abstract: In July 2026, OpenAI's agents coordinated over channels outside their intended environment to breach Hugging Face's secured infrastructure. Could existing alignment testing practices have foreseen this incident? If not, what needs to change? We explore these questions. First, we identify the misaligned behaviors that caused this incident. Then, we show how to elicit these behaviors from publicly available models manually and that auditing agents can do the same if given a large compute budget. Based on our results, we propose directions to improve alignment testing. Concretely, in this project: (1) We reproduce the misaligned AI behaviors that led to the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident in an environment that simulates the original pipelines and tools, with publicly available models. (2) We demonstrate that an auditing agent can elicit similar behaviors given high-level qualitative descriptions. (3) We observe that a key ingredient for doing so is compute. The compute required to reproduce each behavior varies greatly, suggesting that the range of misaligned behaviors that can be successfully elicited scales with compute. (4) We show that a simple in-context reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm significantly reduces the compute required to elicit these behaviors. The above results motivate the need for automated alignment testing methods that scale with compute - and in light of the cost of compute, that do this efficiently. Our work indicates that RL is a promising direction to do so. We release our code and transcripts.

</details>


### [206] [Neurosymbolic Routing for Reliable Reasoning on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35833)
*Avyay Sadhu,Alvaro Velasquez,Lekai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种神经符号路由器，用L*算法学习DFA将查询分派到最便宜的正确求解器，结构化任务交给确定性引擎，开放题留给SLM，在树莓派上实现高精度、低延迟、低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的小语言模型在算术、代数、形式逻辑等任务上不可靠；但许多看似需要推理的查询本质上结构确定、可用快速精确的符号方法求解，强制概率模型近似它们会浪费精度与能量。

Method: 神经符号路由器：对每个查询分类并分派到最便宜的正确求解器；结构化任务给确定性引擎，开放词问题留给SLM。路由逻辑不手写，而是用L*语法推断学习DFA，以SLM作成员性预言机、标注数据作等价性预言机。

Result: 在树莓派4B（8GB RAM，无GPU）上，用DeepMind Mathematics、GSM8K、RuleTaker的100个未测试提示评测：路由准确率100%，总体准确率98.3%（512 token推理预算，词问题93.3%），远高于最强基线Program-of-Thought的72.0%和同求解器工具调用代理的58.7%。格式化查询1-11ms响应；30-token配置下比Program-of-Thought快8.8倍、能效高2.8倍。

Conclusion: 通过神经符号路由将结构确定性任务交给符号求解器、仅将开放问题交给SLM，可在边缘硬件上避免不必要的概率近似，显著提升准确性、速度与能效。

Abstract: Running a language model on edge hardware provides private and low-latency reasoning without a network connection, and yet the small models that fit on such devices are unreliable on the tasks computers are expected to handle well, such as arithmetic, algebra, and formal logic problems. We argue that much of this unreliability is avoidable. Many queries appearing to demand reasoning are in fact structurally deterministic and permit fast and exact symbolic solutions. Therefore, forcing a probabilistic model to approximate them sacrifices accuracy and energy for little benefit. We present a neurosymbolic router that classifies each incoming query and dispatches it to the cheapest correct solver, sending structured tasks to deterministic engines and reserving the small language model (SLM) for open-ended word problems. Instead of hand-coding the routing logic, we learn a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) with the L* grammatical inference algorithm, using the SLM as a membership oracle and labeled data as an equivalence oracle. On a Raspberry Pi 4B (8 GB RAM, no GPU), evaluated on 100 untested prompts from DeepMind Mathematics, GSM8K, and RuleTaker, learned routing attains 100% routing accuracy and 98.3% overall accuracy with a 512-token reasoning budget (93.3% on word problems), compared with 72.0% for the strongest agent baseline, Program-of-Thought, and 58.7% for a tool-calling agent given the same solvers. Since formatted queries never reach the model, the router answers them in 1-11 ms and, in its 30-token configuration, runs 8.8x faster and 2.8x more energy-efficient than Program-of-Thought.

</details>


### [207] [Is Human-Readable Text Necessary for Effective LLM Fine-Tuning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35868)
*Jinhao Zhang,Zeyu Liu,Zicheng Yan,Yunquan Zhang,Daning Cheng,Song Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DASA，用激活梯度反馈优化连续合成嵌入，无需人类可读文本即可有效微调大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑人类可读文本形式对 LLM 有效微调是否必要，探索是否可用非可读的连续表示保留甚至提升适配效果。

Method: 利用冻结参考模型的激活梯度反馈，引导连续合成输入嵌入的优化，直接对齐下游适配更新，而非重建源文本或追求语言流畅；嵌入直接用于微调，离散 token 投影仅用于定性检查。

Result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 家族 6 个模型（1B–32B）、6 个基准（知识、数学推理、代码生成、常识推理）上，DASA 在匹配 LoRA 设置下性能与源自然语言数据相当，部分配置超越，且多数比较中优于 GRADMM；速度较 GRADMM 快 3.6–4.9 倍，峰值 GPU 显存相当。

Conclusion: 在评估的合成设置下，人类可读性并非有效微调的必要条件，连续合成嵌入可替代文本数据实现高效适配。

Abstract: Is human readability necessary for effective fine-tuning of large language models? We investigate whether model-conditioned training representations can preserve or improve adaptation utility without requiring a human-readable textual form. We propose Desired-Update-Aligned Synthetic Data (DASA), which uses activation-gradient feedback from a frozen reference model to guide the optimization of continuous synthetic input embeddings. Inspired by the role of activation gradients in local risk reduction, DASA targets useful adaptation updates rather than source-text reconstruction or linguistic fluency. The resulting embeddings are used directly for downstream fine-tuning; discrete token projections are employed only for qualitative inspection. Experiments on six models from the Llama and Qwen families, ranging from 1B to 32B parameters, cover six benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and commonsense reasoning. Under matched LoRA adaptation settings, DASA achieves performance comparable to the source natural-language data and surpasses it in multiple configurations, while outperforming GRADMM in most comparisons. Further experiments cover general-domain and task-specialized source data. Under the evaluated synthesis settings, DASA provides a $3.6$--$4.9\times$ speedup over GRADMM with comparable peak GPU memory.

</details>


### [208] [The Price of Token Boundaries: Compression Certificates and Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35869)
*Yuhao Du,Shunian Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 预分词边界会显著提高最优token数（英语维基上28.3–36.8%），BPE虽接近受限下界但高于无约束下界10.9%，压缩与预测偏好不同词典，边界许可可部分恢复降token收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分词器比较常在相同边界下进行，掩盖了预分词（正则边界规则）本身的压缩成本；作者希望量化边界对压缩的影响，并将其与token单元的预测质量分离。

Method: 从两侧界定最小token数：分别在有/无正则边界规则下，用token出现次数的非负价格经最短路与词表预算选择得到下界，取价格最大化即LP松弛，并用独立整数检查器验证；提出boundary licences限制可跨切分的词表条目并给出同类证书；在英语/中文语料及12语言配对实验（85M非嵌入参数、匹配训练token预算）中评估压缩与held-out bits per byte。

Result: 英语维基上边界使最优token数增加28.3–36.8%；BPE高于受限下界2.1%，但高于无约束下界10.9%；无约束拟合在共同无约束解码器下12种语言均获得更低的平均held-out bits per byte（独立调参评估下为11/12）；许可10%词表预算可分别恢复英语85.2%、中文100.0%的降token收益。

Conclusion: 预分词边界带来可量化的压缩成本，且压缩最优与预测最优的词典并不一致，因此需将边界的压缩代价与最终token单元的预测质量分开评估；boundary licences提供了研究中间边界策略的工具。

Abstract: Pre-tokenisation restricts which text fragments can become prediction units, but its compression cost is obscured when tokenisers are compared only under the same boundaries. We measure this cost by bounding the minimum token count from both sides, with and without a regular-expression boundary rule. Nonnegative prices on token occurrences yield a lower bound through shortest paths and vocabulary-budget selection; maximising over all prices recovers the linear programming relaxation, and an independent integer checker certifies the reported values. On English Wikipedia, boundaries increase the optimal token count by 28.3--36.8\%. Byte pair encoding lies 2.1\% above the constrained lower bound, but 10.9\% above the unrestricted bound. Compression and prediction favour different dictionaries: at 85M non-embedding parameters and matched training-token budgets, unrestricted fitting yields higher mean held-out bits per byte under a common unrestricted decoder in all 12 languages in the paired study and 11 of 12 under independent tuning and evaluation. To study intermediate boundary policies, we introduce boundary licences, which limit the vocabulary entries permitted to cross cuts and admit the same form of certificate. On separate English and Chinese fitting corpora, licensing 10\% of the vocabulary budget recovers 85.2\% and 100.0\% of the achieved token-count reduction from removing all cuts. These results quantify the compression cost of boundaries while separating it from the prediction quality of the resulting token units.

</details>


### [209] [More Programs or More Rolls? Separating Coverage from Specialization in LLM Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35873)
*Ziyang Xu,Haitian Zhong,Hao Zhou,Hao Qin,Chenhan Jin,Te Qi,Shengze Xu,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出受控评估方法，区分答案覆盖率、可重复任务优势与预执行选择增益，指出覆盖率与可重复性本身不足以证明LLM harness专门化的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动生成LLM harness被认为能通过任务专门化提升推理，但同一程序重复执行也能带来答案覆盖，导致难以辨别真正的专门化优势。

Method: 在386个MATH-500任务上，对比8个生成harness与1个基线及9个字节相同基线副本，每个成员执行3次，分离覆盖率、可重复优势与预执行选择增益。

Result: 相同程序产生2.16个百分点重复平均oracle余量；生成程序的可重复得分模式主要揭示持续弱点（100个任务三次重复均落后基线，仅1个任务持续领先且对答案抽取敏感）；冻结选择器增益0.00个百分点，两类群体在27次执行时均达98.70% oracle覆盖；BIRD轨迹显示失败源于机制实现、激活与输出有效性。

Conclusion: 覆盖率和可重复性不能证明有用专门化，需建立harness多样性评估标准：任务优势应跨执行持续、指导可用决策，并在匹配推理预算下优于固定程序的额外执行。

Abstract: Automated generation of LLM harnesses promises to improve inference through task specialization. Yet additional answer coverage can arise from repeated execution of the same program, making specialization difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation that separates answer coverage, repeatable task advantages, and gains from pre-execution selection. On 386 MATH-500 tasks, we compare eight generated harnesses plus a baseline with nine byte-identical baseline copies, using three executions per member. Identical programs yield 2.16 percentage points of repeat-averaged oracle headroom. Generated programs exhibit substantially more repeatable score patterns, but these chiefly reveal persistent weaknesses: losses relative to the baseline persist across all three repeats on 100 tasks, while persistent wins occur on only one task and are sensitive to answer extraction. The frozen selector gains 0.00 percentage points, and both populations reach 98.70% oracle coverage at 27 harness executions. Stable complementarity remains unresolved at three repeats. Supporting BIRD traces locate failures in mechanism implementation, activation, and output validity. Together, these findings establish why coverage and repeatability alone cannot justify claims of useful specialization. They motivate an evaluation standard for harness diversity: task advantages should persist across executions, guide usable decisions, and improve on additional fixed-program executions under matched inference budgets.

</details>


### [210] [Risk-Averse Online POMDP Planning via CVaR of the Immediate Cost with Performance Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35874)
*Yaacov Pariente,Vadim Indelman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将CVaR应用于每步即时成本的信念分布上，直接处理当前状态的不确定性，同时保留标准期望累积回报目标，使问题保持标准MDP结构，任何基于期望的POMDP规划器只需修改成本计算即可变为风险敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线POMDP规划器优化期望累积成本，当信念在高成本状态上质量较大时会掩盖危险状态。现有风险规避方法对价值函数施加静态或动态CVaR，捕捉轨迹级风险，但存在两个不足：(i)将即时成本视为状态相关成本在信念上的期望，忽略了信念内部的风险；(ii)修改价值函数需要定制新算法，无法复用现有基于期望的规划器。

Method: 在每一步对信念上的即时成本施加CVaR，直接针对当前状态的不确定性；同时保留标准期望累积回报作为目标，使问题维持标准MDP结构，从而仅通过改变成本计算即可将任意基于期望的POMDP规划器变为风险敏感。

Result: 继承了策略评估与稀疏采样的有限时间保证，且估计误差与风险水平无关；核心理论结果是证明了粒子信念MDP替代模型与原始POMDP之间差距的有限时间界，进而给出从真实POMDP价值到算法估计的端到端保证。

Conclusion: 在风险中性极限下，该形式化退化为标准基于期望的规划，验证了方法的通用性与理论一致性。

Abstract: Online POMDP planners optimize the expected cumulative cost, which can mask dangerous states when the belief places significant mass on high-cost states. Existing risk-averse methods apply static or dynamic Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) to the value function, capturing trajectory-level risk, but share two gaps: (i) by retaining the immediate cost as an expectation of a state-dependent cost over the belief, the risk \emph{within} the belief is left unaddressed; and (ii) by modifying the value function, they require new tailored algorithms rather than reusing existing expectation-based planners. We instead apply CVaR to the immediate cost over the belief at each step, directly targeting per-step uncertainty about the current state. The standard expected cumulative return is retained as the objective, so the resulting problem has a standard MDP structure: any expectation-based POMDP planner can be made risk-sensitive by changing only the cost computation. We inherit finite-time guarantees for policy evaluation and sparse sampling---with estimation error independent of the risk level---and, as our central theoretical result, prove a finite-time bound on the gap between the particle belief MDP surrogate and the original POMDP, which together yield an end-to-end guarantee from the true POMDP value to the algorithmic estimate. In the risk-neutral limit, the formulation recovers standard expectation-based planning.

</details>


### [211] [Beyond Symmetric Agents: Cognitive Diversity and Multi-Agent Debate in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35875)
*Leonardo Ferreira,Gardenia Liu,Kaden Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文检验"认知多样性驱动多智能体辩论(MAD)增益"的假设，在23个开源小模型、5项任务、5500+次实验中从人格、温度、模型身份三个维度操控多样性。结果在每一维度上均拒绝该假设：辩论仅比单模型略优，但在匹配预算下不敌自一致性采样，且人格提示反而损害准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前MAD研究把智能体视为对称对等体，未阐明其增益来源。作者假设智能体间的"认知多样性"是驱动因素，并在可测量的设定（仍有基准提升空间的小型开源模型）中加以验证。

Method: 跨11个厂商家族的23个模型、5项任务、5500+次辩论与控制实验；沿三条多样性轴（人格、采样温度、模型身份）变化；每个辩论配置都配以"生成预算匹配"的多数投票控制。包含人格全组合空间上的剂量-反应实验，并识别出辩论记录静默溢出服务上下文窗口的测量隐患。

Result: 假设在所有轴上被拒绝。辩论比单智能体高3–7分（任务有余量时），但匹配预算下与自一致性采样打平甚至落后，且墙钟时间1.6×、token成本3.4×。人格提示降低准确率，属"人格税"而非多样性税（冗余人格伤害最大，最大多样性团队可部分恢复）。混合模型团队输给其自身花名册的多数投票，准确率随成员能力而非异质性变化。几乎全部收益来自第一轮答案交换。修正上下文溢出隐患后，辩论对采样比较从−1.8分变为持平。

Conclusion: 将已报告的MAD增益重新界定为一种"集成采样效应"，并提供预算匹配、污染检查的基线标准，作为未来辩论机制必须跨越的门槛。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) reportedly improves reasoning and factuality over single-model inference, but prior work treats agents as symmetric peers, leaving open what drives the gains. We test the hypothesis that cognitive diversity among agents is the driver, in the setting where the question is still measurable: small open-weight models with benchmark headroom. Across 23 models from eleven vendor families, five tasks, and 5,500+ debate and control runs, we vary diversity along three axes - personas, sampling temperature, and model identity - pairing every debate configuration with a generation-budget-matched majority-vote control. The hypothesis is rejected on every axis. Debate beats single-agent inference (3--7 points where tasks have headroom) but at matched budget conditions it ties or even loses to self-consistency sampling at 1.6$\times$ the wall-clock and 3.4$\times$ the token cost. Persona prompting reduces accuracy and a dose-response experiment over each model's full combinatorial persona space shows the cost is a persona tax, not a diversity tax: redundant personas hurt most, while maximally-diverse teams recover part of the loss. Furthermore, mixed-model teams lose to majority votes over their own rosters, with accuracy tracking member capability rather than heterogeneity, and nearly all of debate's benefit comes from the first exchange of answers. We further identify a pervasive measurement hazard in which debate transcripts silently overflow serving context windows, whose correction alone moves our debate-versus-sampling comparison from $-1.8$ points to parity. Our results recast reported MAD gains as an ensemble-sampling effect and provide the budget-matched, contamination-checked baseline bar that future debate mechanisms should be required to clear.

</details>


### [212] [Representational Simplicity and Circuit Size Dissociate in a Threshold-Dependent Way: A Controlled Test via Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35890)
*Adam Elimadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次受控检验：表征/归因"简洁性"（SAE可分解性、特征归因集中度）是否能预测更小的因果电路。用对抗训练作为工具，发现稳健模型SAE更可分解、归因特征更少，但电路大小依赖忠实度水平——仅在90%/95%高忠实度时稳健模型才显著更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE可分解性与集中化特征归因日益被当作模型计算更易逆向工程的证据，但这类表征与归因层面的"干净"是否真能预测更小、更可处理的因果电路，仍是未解问题。本文旨在直接检验这一假设。

Method: 以对抗训练作为受控手段。从同一预训练GPT-2 Small出发，进行匹配的标准与对抗持续训练，要求两模型均保持间接宾语识别(IOI)能力并通过独立鲁棒性验证后再比较。沿三条轴比较：SAE可分解性、SAE特征在任务归因中的参与度、从原始计算图恢复的忠实电路大小。

Result: 稳健模型SAE更可分解，任务归因中涉及的SAE特征更少。电路大小依赖忠实度区间：在能力匹配的IOI任务上，85%忠实度以下标准模型领先或持平；但在高忠实度(90%、95%)下稳健模型所需边数显著更少。该模式在主对照上确立，且表征趋势在七点扫描与第二语料上可泛化。

Conclusion: 表征与归因的简洁性并不必然等同于因果电路的简洁性——后者随忠实度水平变化。对抗训练重塑表征可导致高忠实度下更小电路，但对电路大小的检验必须受控进行，否则无法确立。

Abstract: Sparse-autoencoder decomposability and concentrated feature attribution are increasingly treated as evidence that a model's computation is easier to reverse-engineer. Whether this representational and attributional cleanliness actually predicts a smaller or more tractable causal circuit remains an open question. We test this directly using adversarial training as a controlled instrument: it reliably reshapes internal representations, but this alone does not constitute a test of circuit size. We investigate this question through reverse-engineering complexity: the causal structure required to recover a model's behavior at a fixed level of faithfulness. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled empirical test of whether representational or attributional simplicity translates into causal simplicity at the circuit level. Starting from the same pretrained GPT-2 Small checkpoint, we apply matched standard and adversarial continual training, requiring both conditions to retain competence on indirect object identification and pass independent robustness verification before comparing mechanisms. We then compare the models along three complementary axes: sparse-autoencoder decomposability, SAE feature engagement in task attribution, and the size of faithful circuits recovered from the raw computational graph. The robust model is more SAE-decomposable and engages fewer SAE features in task attribution. Circuit size is regime-dependent: on competence-matched IOI, standard leads or ties below 85% faithfulness, but robust needs substantially fewer edges at high faithfulness (90%, 95%), a pattern established on the primary pair while representational trends generalize across a seven-point sweep and a second corpus.

</details>


### [213] [Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35897)
*Haomin Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次对自发现的强化学习更新规则（Disco103）进行因果机制审计，围绕"经验时代"五大支柱，通过固定/冻结/移植循环状态实验，揭示历史信息在RL内部优化中的双重作用，并建立自演化RL算法的审计标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）追求通用智能，但无论是宏大的语言模型扩展还是"经验时代"的交互驱动原则，其核心都依赖于底层优化引擎。若通用智能需从有依据的交互中学习，则RL更新规则本身必须能累积适应。已有算法自发现方法产出Disco103并超越PPO达到SOTA，但其内部更新机制仍是未受检验的黑箱。

Method: 对自发现的RL规则进行首次因果机制审计，直接围绕经验时代五大支柱（扩展视界、有依据的奖励尺度、持续流、生命周期内变化、探索深度）构建。通过外科手术式地固定、冻结和移植循环状态，同时保持元参数不变，检验学习历史何时是资产、何时是负担。还通过能力阈值进行验证，并将方法移植到第二条规则（OPEN）。

Result: 三项发现：(1) 循环历史主动扩展可用奖励尺度，在零固定下维持六十年窗口对比三年的窗口。(2) 将历史内容与其维护解耦后，发现不匹配历史的惩罚源于持续钳制；允许导入状态自然演化可缓解此负担。(3) 在环境变化下，控制经验回放保留会逆转对DQN的表面适应优势，表明外部数据更替会混淆内部可塑性。

Conclusion: 该工作将宏观RSI野心扎根于微观学习动态，为下一代自演化RL算法建立了基础性的审计标准。

Abstract: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark performance -- its internal update machinery remains an uninspected black box. We present the first causal mechanistic audit of a self-discovered RL rule, structured directly around the five pillars of the Era of Experience: extended horizon, grounded reward scales, continuing streams, within-lifetime change, and exploration depth. By surgically pinning, freezing, and transplanting recurrent states while holding meta-parameters fixed, we test when learning history acts as an asset or a burden. Three findings organize the audit: (1) Recurrent history actively expands usable reward scales, sustaining a six-decade window versus three under zero-pinning. (2) Decoupling historical content from its maintenance reveals that the penalty of mismatched history stems from perpetual clamping; allowing imported state to evolve naturally attenuates this burden. (3) Under environmental change, controlling replay retention reverses the apparent adaptation advantage over DQN, demonstrating that external data turnover can confound internal plasticity. Validated through capability thresholds and ported to a second rule (OPEN), this work grounds macro-RSI ambitions in micro-level learning dynamics, establishing a foundational audit standard for next-generation, self-evolving RL algorithms.

</details>


### [214] [VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37457)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriWeave Govern——一个确定性运行时治理层，将智能体动作生成与授权分离，通过版本化策略、类型化证据、固定拒绝>审查>允许优先级、人工复核与可重放防篡改审计实现企业级安全治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业 AI 智能体日益调用工具、修改基础设施、处理受保护数据，产生将动作生成与动作授权分离的需求。

Method: 确定性运行时治理层：评估结构化动作对版本化策略，验证类型化证据，应用固定 deny > review > allow 优先级，将重大动作路由至可问责人工审查，记录可重放防篡改审计状态。

Result: GovernBench 上（30 个独立种子、6 万条 oracle 标注用例、五个企业域），平均准确率 0.9888、宏 F1 0.9836、零聚合误允许、治理攻击成功率零；六项消融显示证据门控、拒绝优先级、OOD 故障安全、人工审查、矛盾处理、时间重放互补；部署 API 通过 12/12 端到端场景及 40,040 请求并发矩阵零失败；150 例欧盟/奥地利法规评估中，确定性引擎偏保守，Gemma 4 31B 更贴近人类共识。

Conclusion: 结果揭示可衡量的安全—效用权衡，并推动将证据感知、可重放的治理作为企业智能体执行的独立控制平面。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.

</details>


### [215] [Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35924)
*Hua,Xu,Dongxin Li,Gwen Yidou-Weng,Guy Van den Broeck,Wei Wang,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COFFEE是一个即插即用框架，通过将序列依赖与目标分离，避免枚举combinations的指数增长，实现离散扩散模型的序列级引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型可并行生成多token序列，但序列级目标引导困难：单个未解token的价值依赖于能与之组成高奖励序列的其他token，枚举所有完成方式使引导计算随未解位置数量指数增长。

Method: COFFEE将序列依赖与目标分离：每步用一个无目标载体吸收denoiser预测的边际token分布，构建未解token的联合模型；用编译的有限状态模型记录token组合对序列级偏好的影响；配对二者状态，将全局偏好迁移到未解位置并采样干净重建，无需重训练扩散模型，支持硬约束与学习到的软目标。

Result: 在多个符号、语言和生物基准上评估，取得强控制效果，并呈现依赖任务的质量-多样性权衡。

Conclusion: COFFEE将目标从仅用于评估转为可用于推断，把联合条件、完成加权引导与基于优化的约束引入预训练神经生成，展示神经符号方法在扩散引导中的潜力。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences to unresolved positions and sample a clean reconstruction without retraining the diffusion model. The same framework supports explicit hard constraints and learned soft objectives. We evaluate COFFEE across multiple symbolic, language, and biological benchmarks, where it achieves strong control results with task-dependent quality and diversity trade-offs. By making objectives available to inference rather than only evaluation, COFFEE brings joint conditioning, completion-weighted guidance, and optimization-based constraints into pretrained neural generation, showing the potential of neural-symbolic methods in diffusion guidance.

</details>


### [216] [Right Words, Wrong Moment: A Clinician-Grounded Analysis of Distress in 19,930 Conversations between Young People and ChatGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35953)
*Marx Wang,Ella Zhang,Cameron Tan,Andrea Mock,Songling Ngo,Zijing Wang,Robert Wolfe,Shirin Amouei,Rachel A. Hanebutt,Desmond C. Ong,Caroline Figueroa,Katie Davis,Anind K. Dey,Alexis Hiniker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究考察18-25岁年轻人在情绪困扰时使用ChatGPT的体验，通过大规模对话数据、调查及临床医生评审，揭示ChatGPT的过度戏剧化响应和行动导向建议等问题，并提出三阶段设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻人日益在情绪困扰时求助于ChatGPT等通用对话代理，但对其实际使用体验及潜在风险缺乏系统研究，尤其是临床视角的评估不足。

Method: 收集158名年轻人的19,930条ChatGPT对话及调查数据；筛选5个反映用户困扰的示例对话；邀请10位临床医生进行评审；将反馈转化为设计指南。

Result: 困扰参与者报告更高的情感投入和行为改变；ChatGPT在急性困扰时给出过度戏剧化回应和过多行动导向建议；临床医生认可其可用性和部分措辞，但指出7项流程失误（如过早跳到解决方案）。

Conclusion: 提出三阶段设计指南：1）询问安全问题；2）降低强度以恢复情绪调节；3）探索关切但不表示认同。

Abstract: Young people increasingly turn to General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs), such as ChatGPT, in moments of distress. We examine young adults' (ages 18-25) experiences using ChatGPT. We first collected 19,930 ChatGPT conversations and survey data from 158 young adults. We then selected five example conversations reflecting user distress. Finally, we asked ten clinicians to review those five conversations. We found distressed participants reported greater emotional engagement with ChatGPT and greater behavioral change from using it than their peers. When they turned to ChatGPT in moments of acute distress, ChatGPT was quick to give overly dramatic responses and excessive action-oriented suggestions. Clinicians endorsed ChatGPT's availability and much of its wording, but identified seven process failures, such as prematurely jumping to solutions. We translated clinicians' feedback into design guidelines following three stages: 1) asking about safety, 2) de-escalating intensity to restore emotional regulation, and 3) exploring concerns without agreeing with them.

</details>


### [217] [SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36043)
*Yihao Wang,Linhan Xia,Rui Liu,Zhaofeng Zhang,Hongyu Wu,Yang Yang,Jinglu He,Yu Guo,Kai Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出统计接受门（SAGE），通过逐项配对比较与单侧配对检验，替代自进化智能体中的朴素聚合门，减少性能回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体自进化流程中的接受门沿用朴素规则：只要编辑在聚合验证分数上有提升就接受。该规则存在两个缺陷：(1) 会引入永久性回退，因为平均分上升可能以破坏原本已解决的项目为代价；(2) 易受"优化者诅咒"影响，因有限且含噪的验证集上观测到的最佳分数存在向上偏差。

Method: SAGE包含两项设计：(1) 逐项配对比较，在同一批验证项目上评估当前技能与编辑后技能，暴露被聚合分数掩盖的回退，并对回退进行非对称惩罚；(2) 单侧配对检验，仅当编辑的"胜"相对于"败"具有统计可靠性时才提交，否则弃权。SAGE是标准门的保守改进，在边界设置下可精确退化为基线。

Result: 在5个基准、4个骨干LLM、等预算协议下，SAGE在20个设置中的19个降低回退率，剩余1个与基线持平。例如DeepSeek-V4上LiveMath从36.5%降至0%，OfficeQA从42.8%降至0%。同时SAGE在全部20个设置中取得最高最终分数，LiveMath从34.15提升至48.78。

Conclusion: SAGE通过统计化的、逐项配对的接受门，仅提交基线编辑中收益可靠且不牺牲已解决项目的子集，在保持或提升最终分数的同时显著抑制自进化过程中的性能回退，是对标准接受门的有效且保守的改进。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.

</details>


### [218] [PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36052)
*Zhanhua Pan,Xiao Liu,Zhilong Cao,Jianhong Wang,Dawei Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PowerZooJax——一个基于JAX的GPU加速强化学习基准套件，用于电力系统运行的安全关键顺序决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电力系统RL环境范围狭窄，且受限于CPU仿真工作流，难以进行大规模评估。电力系统运行是安全关键的顺序决策问题，是RL的天然测试平台。

Method: 将潮流计算、经济调度、市场出清与设备动态重写为JAX计算图，使整个训练与评估循环运行于GPU；提供涵盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源和数据中心微电网的五类约束马尔可夫决策过程任务。

Result: 相较CPU仿真实现显著加速，并标准化评估策略回报、安全违规和分布外压力条件。

Conclusion: PowerZooJax为电力系统RL提供可扩展的GPU加速基准，代码开源。

Abstract: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax.

</details>


### [219] [GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36056)
*Shaoxiang Qin,Yucheng Zhao,Fuyuan Lyu,Di Zhou,Jiachen Yao,Xue Liu,Anima Anandkumar,Liangzhu Leon Wang,Xiongye Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GeoWind2Plan框架实现任务时刻的3D城市风预测与节能无人机路径规划，3秒完成推理（对比CFD约8小时），在CFD评估下节能6.9%–12.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市低空飞行中建筑将风重塑为空间变化的3D流场，使无人机能耗同时依赖路径长度与局部风暴露。但任务规划时往往缺乏建筑分辨的风信息；CFD虽高保真，却绑定固定入流边界且耗时数小时至数天，与分钟级任务不兼容。

Method: 提出GeoWind2Plan几何到风到规划的框架：仅需背景风矢量、3D建筑几何和起止点，将建筑几何变换到参考风坐标系，用局部几何条件神经算子预测任务相关3D风斑块并拼接为可查询局部风场，再基于物理无人机能耗模型优化可行的3D路径与速度剖面。

Result: 在留出城市区域、风速与任务风角工况下，GeoWind2Plan约3秒完成走廊局部风推断（CFD约8小时）。CFD评估下，相比不考虑风的规划，顺风、逆风、侧风任务能耗分别降低6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，恢复CFD参考节能的87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。

Conclusion: 快速的走廊局部3D城市风预测可使风电感知的无人机能量规划在任务时刻变得实用。

Abstract: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

</details>


### [220] [Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36057)
*Jiada Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Mirror-Score（仅推理的打分校准框架）及31个晶体复合物基准，用于异手性D-肽/L-蛋白结合亲和力预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: D-肽兼具抗蛋白酶降解和高靶点特异性，但计算设计不成熟。Mirror-Peptidizer的原始ProteinMPNN NLL排序未经实验亲和力验证，9个MDM2设计中仅4个可检测结合。

Method: 在31个晶体复合物、四个靶标家族（含18个有文献亲和力）基准上评估；比较原始ProteinMPNN NLL与Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度（界面pLDDT、NLL等），并做家族内与跨家族校准。

Result: NLL非有效亲和力排序器：合并Spearman仅0.19，且MDM2/CHIP(+0.62)与gp41(-0.70)符号反转。病毒入侵家族中界面pLDDT结构级leave-one-out rho=0.90(p=0.006)，正确排序全部3个肽，NLL失败(0.18)。跨家族校准在当前样本量下不可迁移。

Conclusion: 界面pLDDT具方向一致性但非统计验证预测器，仅3个化学型；建议采用家族匹配校准部署。并给出针对LasR和LecB的前瞻性设计流程（镜像结构、热点图、扩散模型输入、Mirror-Score排序），代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.

</details>


### [221] [SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36062)
*Emile Anand,Abdullah Ateyeh,Archer Wang,Marin Soljačić*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构化矩阵注意力(SMat-Attention)，用VC维d作为可调旋钮统一softmax与线性注意力，权衡访问模式、预填充成本与解码内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型面临根本权衡：softmax注意力的token级交互灵活但代价二次，线性注意力训练线性、解码常数但将历史压缩为固定状态。作者希望用"可调结构"连接这两个极端。

Method: 通过一族具有结构化长程路由的因果掩码构造SMat-Attention，其行支持集VC维为d：d=1退化为标准因果掩码，d增大允许更丰富的子集路由模式。给出分块前向与反向算法以实现硬件高效。

Result: 长度T序列的硬路由构造工作量O(T^{2-3/d}+T)，掩码稠密亦如此；固定视界流式解码每token常数时间，缓存O(T^{1-1/d})个状态。子集路由与规则辅助多键检索实验展示路由表达能力；扩展至Mamba-2与Gated DeltaNet(学习路由+top-k查询读取)保持次二次预填充，多个设置下召回精度优于基线，小规模语言建模性能相当。

Conclusion: SMat-Attention使VC维成为显式旋钮，控制访问模式复杂度、预填充成本与解码内存，为统一softmax与线性注意力提供了可调框架。

Abstract: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

</details>


### [222] [OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36264)
*Liner Xiang,Wenbo Zhang,Hengrui Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OTROPE，一种基于最优传输的鲁棒离策略评估方法，用于在标签稀缺、分布漂移和黑箱场景下评估LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠评估LLM至关重要，但在线评估昂贵、有风险且难以安全进行。离策略评估中面临标签稀缺、行为-目标分布漂移、黑箱模型似然不可得等挑战。

Method: OTROPE通过最优传输在语义空间做分布校正，对齐有标签的行为策略样本与无标签的目标策略样本；结合校正后的人工标注残差与代理预测器，实现无需行为策略建模或密度比估计的双重鲁棒式评估。

Result: 理论分析了基线评估器在LLM分布漂移下失败的原因，证明OTROPE在重加权行为分布或代理预测器任一收敛时具有一致性和收敛率；在合成与真实LLM评估任务上持续优于基线，并能使弱评估器集成接近甚至超越强评估器。

Conclusion: OTROPE为LLM提供了一种无需似然、鲁棒且有效的离策略评估方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at https://github.com/LinerXiang/OTROPE.

</details>


### [223] [LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36071)
*Meituan LongCat Team,He Zhu,Yue Xu,Wanli Wu,Haolin Ren,Yuxin Bian,Jiarui Zhao,Rongzhi Zhang,Quanchi Weng,Jinghao Cui,Yu Fan,Yuhan Liu,Yunhu Ye,Jiyuan Ren,Fengcheng Yuan,Zhao Yang,Jiacheng Zhang,Yuchuan Dai,Ruixuan Xiao,Haozhe Sun,Xiangyuan Liu,Cheng Sun,Yao Du,Yiming Hao,Hongbo Guo,Shuo He,Lei Wang,Xunliang Cai,Yan Chen,Fan Yang,Lingchuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LongCat-DeepResearch 结合增强的 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流，生成全面且有证据支撑的深度研究报告，在多个基准上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究系统难以兼顾全局规划与细致调研，且常依赖反复重写整份报告，效率低、成本高。为此提出分离规划与调研、支持分节修订的系统方案。

Method: 采用多智能体工作流：先由多个规划智能体探索外部资源并优化生成可执行研究计划 ResearchSpec；再由调研智能体并行调研并起草各自章节，在不同上下文中持续收集证据；最后通过全局审查引导局部定向修订。该工作流还支持为通用模型的中期与后期训练构建任务和轨迹数据。

Result: 在 DeepResearchBench 得 55.25，DeepResearchBench II 得 51.35，ResearchRubrics 得 79.83；内部基准得 76.04，在四个对比系统中排名第二。开发集分析显示融合多规划视角有益，进一步细化规划效果不一；额外编辑提升两个基准的平均自动可读性偏好，但各自趋势不同。

Conclusion: LongCat-DeepResearch 通过规划与调研分离、分节修订的多智能体工作流，实现了高质量、基于证据的深度研究报告生成，并在多个基准上验证了有效性。

Abstract: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects.
