A terminal-answer consistency judge rates all 20 sampled targeted answers consistent, although five have synthetic regret above 0.05; a separate question-coverage dimension flags their one-sided elicitation. A robust partial-preference certificate remains valid under the stipulated synthetic utility but certifies only 16 of 40 targeted cases and is not better than asking a neutral question directly. These results establish neither typical behavior under advertising incentives nor effects on actual consumers.

</details>


### [436] [Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35855)
*Yubin Lyu,Fu Li,Jiawei Fei,Yang Zhao,Weixing Mei,Yinan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Mara Chain，将被拒绝的候选配置当作可迭代精炼的"踏脚石"而非丢弃，在少量 rollout 下取得更优优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对已部署 AI 系统的优化（编辑 prompt、skill、harness、代码）多采用"提议-评估-选择"流程，只保留达标候选。但分析表明被丢弃的候选常含有后续优化所需的关键信息，丢弃它们会导致后续提议重复踩同样的失败模式。

Method: Mara Chain 是一种精炼流程：不丢弃被拒绝的候选，而是保留并利用此前累积的证据对其迭代精炼。每条精炼链限制固定深度，并用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择来约束候选池规模。

Result: 在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化与 MuSiQue 检索流水线优化上，以更少 rollout 取得更大性能增益。AppWorld 上相对性能超 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 最多 20.5%，达到目标分数所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 分别超 AHE、Meta-Harness 20.2 与 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上 test nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 分别比手写流水线提升 0.104 和 0.131。

Conclusion: 保留并精炼被拒绝候选可显著提升部署期 AI 系统优化的样本效率与最终性能，说明"失败信息"是优化过程中的宝贵资源。

Abstract: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

</details>


### [437] [Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35856)
*Paul Trust*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于公共部门经济监测，利用弱监督与生成式LLM提示生成合成标签，自动判断文章是否涉及经济政策不确定性（EPU）及其具体类型，并提出多标签和层次分类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EPU识别方法存在局限：基于关键词的方法误报率高；基于机器学习的方法需大量高质量人工标注数据，成本高、耗时长。

Method: 采用弱监督技术，使用生成式LLM通过提示（prompting）创建合成标签，实现经济高效且可扩展的分类；并提出多标签与层次分类方法。

Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或性能指标。

Conclusion: 该方法为公共部门EPU监测提供了一种成本低、可扩展的替代方案，并可支持EPU相关文章的多标签与层次分类。

Abstract: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

</details>


### [438] [ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35867)
*Junoh Kang,Kiseop Lee,Bohyung Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLOBGen生成"生而可回放"的限价订单簿(LOB)消息，在生成过程中即保证回放性，无需事后修正或重采样，实现100%回放性、更高市场真实性和2.7–3.6倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环市场仿真要求LOB消息可回放，但现有生成器可能产生与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息，需事后修正或拒绝重采样，导致分布改变或推理成本增加。

Method: 生成时即保证回放性：先从当前LOB挂单中选择被引用订单，再从学习到的合规挂单分布中采样（基于缓存订单表示与上下文查询高效计算），最后通过掩码屏蔽非法token以保证其余字段一致性。

Result: 500条消息回放中达到100%回放性，提升市场真实性（尤其订单簿顶部统计与LOB消息相对价格），相比LOBS5基线每条回放消息加速2.7–3.6倍。

Conclusion: ReLOBGen通过构造式生成消除事后修正与重采样的需求，兼顾真实性、回放性与效率，为闭环市场仿真提供有效方案。

Abstract: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

</details>


### [439] [FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35947)
*Yinuo Ren,Haoxuan Chen,Grant M. Rotskoff,Jiequn Han,Lexing Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FluxLite,一种无需训练的离散扩散提议控制框架,通过精确补偿跳率扰动降低 Feynman-Kac SMC 权重退化,大幅提升倾斜采样效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练离散/扩散语言模型的推理任务多归结为从倾斜分布采样;Feynman-Kac SMC 理论上可精确校正,但当提议动态与倾斜不匹配时权重退化,增加粒子收效有限。

Method: 在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上,证明任意稀疏跳率扰动可由 Feynman-Kac 势中的 q_t 加权图散度项精确补偿,保持目标路径不变,同时将残余重加权方差化为局部凸目标。实例化为 HEU(单跳局部重分配)与 D-VCG(基于预训练速率基的小型非负二次规划)。并证明标准 score-entropy 训练损失下的群体稳定性,给出决定分数误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子,以及固定受控 Feynman-Kac 递推的有限粒子收敛性。

Result: 在可解析有限状态 CTMC 基准上,终端 KL 较标准 Feynman-Kac SMC 提升最多两个数量级;2D Ising 采样中行相关 MSE 几何平均降低 5-7 倍,峰值降低达 55 倍。

Conclusion: FluxLite 以轻量、免训练方式提供了原理性的提议控制,显著缓解 SMC 权重退化,并具备稳定性与收敛性理论保证,在离散扩散推理任务中效果显著。

Abstract: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

</details>


### [440] [Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35876)
*Mason Dana,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种校准混合集成模型用于EEG癫痫发作预测，结合5个深度模型和3个经典机器学习模型，经逻辑回归堆叠，在CHB-MIT上LOPO验证达到74.2%敏感性、1.24次/小时误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癫痫发作预测需在发作前提供可操作预警，但患者独立泛化与误报控制仍是主要挑战。

Method: 融合五个深度学习模型与三个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器集成；流程含信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准及临床启发的后处理；在CHB-MIT上用严格LOPO交叉验证，阈值与后处理参数仅在有留出的元数据上选择。

Result: 过滤队列（排除癫痫前驱期比例低于1%或高于15%的异常患者）上，达74.2%发作级敏感性、每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟；限定目标误报预算的测试调优oracle达60.9%敏感性、每小时0.951次误报。

Conclusion: 结果强调应同时报告敏感性与实际误报率；代码已开源。https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

Abstract: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

</details>


### [441] [Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35948)
*Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Zhaoyang Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将联想记忆构建为黎曼流形上的Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索，证明曲率是决定记忆保留与创造的设计变量：测地记忆恒保留孤立模式，体积校正记忆服从Ricci曲率阈值，并给出容量缩放与重叠创造新记忆的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何不只是约束联想记忆，曲率实际上决定了记忆哪些状态、创造哪些状态。作者希望超越"几何仅作为约束"的传统视角，将曲率提升为可设计变量，理解不同几何能量（测地 vs 体积校正）如何影响记忆行为。

Method: 将记忆建模为黎曼流形上的Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索（mode seeking），发展内在稠密联想记忆。对比测地能量与体积校正能量，通过理论证明分析两者的分离行为，并推导容量缩放律；用黎曼均值漂移实现一步召回，最后在仿真与WordNet名词层级上验证。

Result: 测地记忆恒保留孤立模式；体积校正记忆服从尖锐的Ricci曲率阈值——正曲率在高维可抹除记忆，负曲率强化记忆。容量缩放为q_β^{-1/2}（保留全部模式）与q_β^{-1}（典型模式）。重叠可创造新记忆：设计的N模式配置可实现全部2^N-1个子集模式，而随机数据在存储阈值仅产生泊松数量。仿真复现了曲率转变与所有设计模式；在WordNet完整名词层级上，体积校正改善了低容量检索。

Conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量，而非仅仅是数据的属性。通过选择几何能量，可控制记忆的保留、擦除与创造，为流形上的联想记忆设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

</details>


### [442] [From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35880)
*Tianwei Ni,Vineet Jain,Akash Karthikeyan,Pierre-Luc Bacon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，主张离线RL的目标应从"直接部署"扩展为"学习自适应策略先验"，以支持后续在线交互中的持续改进，并正式提出AORL框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离线RL以保守目标学习可直接部署的策略，将数据分布外的不确定性悲观处理以保证稳健性。但当离线训练的策略随后经在线交互更新（如测试时自适应、在线微调）时，该范式变得不完整，忽视了策略未来可改进的潜力。

Method: 通过立场论文方式提出自适应离线强化学习（AORL）概念，将其与offline-to-online RL区分；通过形式化分析，从分布偏移、数据集覆盖有限、测试时条件变化三方面论证自适应性的重要性；并讨论以贝叶斯离线RL作为构造自适应策略先验的有原则方向（保留对可能环境的后验认知不确定性）。

Result: 论文并非给出实验结果的实证研究，而是概念性论证：界定了AORL的问题设定与边界，明确了自适应策略先验需具备记忆、探索与自我纠正能力，并指出贝叶斯离线RL是可行路径之一。

Conclusion: 应把离线RL视为"为未来经验做准备"而非静态部署问题；论文梳理了相关联系、开放挑战与研究方向，呼吁社区重新审视离线RL的目标设定。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

</details>


### [443] [Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36240)
*Akash Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Muon优化器在训练损失停滞时表征学习是否停止，发现在稳定性边缘，权值持续移动、特征继续与教师子空间对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨"训练损失不再改善时表征学习是否停止"这一问题，针对Muon优化器中极坐标归一化更新步长由梯度秩决定这一特性展开研究。

Method: 分析全批量Muon在教师-学生问题上的动力学；推导线性玩具模型的周期与对齐公式及平台/衰减界；对群体平均场ReLU模型证明损失平台期内AGOP主特征空间精确恢复教师子空间；在33种ReLU/GELU/SiLU配置及深层残差网络中做对齐度量与头部重拟合实验。

Result: Muon在稳定性边缘进入持续数千步的近似周期-2损失振荡，周期均值损失平或升，但权值持续移动、AGOP继续对齐教师子空间；对齐方向对预测有用；冻结下游层可重现近乎平坦的周期均值损失同时输入AGOP对齐改善。

Conclusion: 损失停滞并不意味表征学习停止；Muon在损失平台期仍在学习有用特征，且该现象对动量与正交化器选择敏感。

Abstract: Does representation learning stop when the training loss stops improving? We study this question for matrix Muon, whose polar-normalised updates have a step length set by the gradient's rank rather than its norm. Near the edge of stability, full-batch Muon on teacher-student problems enters approximately period-2 loss oscillations that persist for thousands of steps: the cycle-mean loss stays flat or rises, yet the weights keep moving and the learned features continue to align with the teacher subspace. For linear teacher-student learning toys, we derive explicit cycle and alignment formulas and conditional plateau and decay bounds. For a population mean-field ReLU model, we prove that, under stated dimension, initialisation and small-head conditions, the leading eigenspace of the average gradient outer product (AGOP) recovers the teacher subspace exactly during a loss plateau, before the loss later drops. In all 33 ReLU, GELU and SiLU teacher configurations we study, direction-only alignment metrics show the student AGOP aligned with, or still aligning to, the teacher subspace during the period-2 oscillations; projected head refitting on selected configurations shows that the learned directions are useful for prediction, and further measurements distinguish AGOP alignment from weight-mass concentration. In deep residual ReLU students, freezing the downstream layers while the first layer trains with full-batch exact polar updates recreates a nearly flat cycle-mean loss with improving input-AGOP alignment; freezing and unfreezing switch between this plateau and loss decrease, and the effect is sensitive to momentum and to the choice of orthogonaliser.

</details>


### [444] [Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35884)
*Yifei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无散度矢量场的最小表示，将 D 维无散度场编码为同域上的 (D-1) 分量场，用于算子学习，避免冗余参数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无散度矢量场是许多 PDE 的核心状态变量，但现有冗余参数化（如 NCL 势）存在多对一映射，虽然有利于静态拟合，却无法为算子学习提供唯一状态。

Method: 利用傅里叶空间中不可压性带来的横向结构，用 Householder 正交变换构造约化坐标；周期与封闭不可渗透场可直接可逆等距变换，开放非周期流通过傅里叶延拓与最小能量规则选取唯一表示，神经算子在约化空间学习时间演化。

Result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验显示任务相关的权衡：冗余利于静态优化，唯一可逆坐标更适合时间动态，所提方法预测误差更低、鲁棒性更强，且构造上保持无散度。

Conclusion: 去除学习状态空间中的无约束纵向或零方向，可建立明确定义的状态并提升时序预测性能，同时天然保证无散度。

Abstract: Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

</details>


### [445] [The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36252)
*Hazar Yueksel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究闭式"承诺距离"拒绝修复单步是否成功，核心由路径曲率κ决定，并分析额外查询、最优确定性单查询规则及非对称曲率惩罚的效果与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拒绝用户希望用一次沿梯度的闭式移动到达决策边界（分数归零），但该单步是否真能穿越边界、何时会过冲或不足，以及增加模型查询能否改善，此前缺乏系统性刻画。

Method: 用二阶展开给出主导条件：κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ≥0；在80个浅层模型上做相关性/差距统计；证明仅用分数值与梯度、且路径曲率有界K时不存在对所有分数有效的规则；在曲率Lipschitz且步长较短时，用承诺点处一次f评估构造达到极小极大率的确定性单查询规则，并用分裂共形校准控制达到首次穿越或弃权的概率≥1-δ；训练中加非对称曲率惩罚与对称惩罚对比，并做缩放/匹配有效性审计。

Result: 在80个浅层模型上，到达有利侧比例与κ≥0比例相关系数r=0.985，但Fashion-MNIST上前者平均低8.2个百分点；任何仅用分数与梯度的规则都无法避免过冲约Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖；非对称曲率惩罚使99–100%路径在承诺步内穿越，但过冲约为对称惩罚的4–22倍（Fashion-MNIST、COMPAS）；匹配有效性后的小型审计未发现对调优膨胀法的一致优势；κ与d_p依赖分数缩放，部分收益实为更长的承诺步。

Conclusion: 闭式单步成功与否主要由路径曲率符号决定；理论上单查询最优规则可逼近极小极大界并经共形校准保证成功率，但非对称曲率惩罚的收益有限且可能源于缩放/更长步长，在条件允许时沿射线的逐用户线搜索（格点精度内精确）更可取。

Abstract: Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|\nabla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^\top\nabla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|\nabla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.

</details>


### [446] [The Decision Value of Perception Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35910)
*Hoang Pham Cong,Ho Viet Duc Luong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"感知计算决策价值"概念并发布DEEP基准：以预算受限决策oracle评估升级式感知分配器，发现大量升级反而损害下游决策，且感知增益与决策价值常不一致，轻量路由器在计入自身开销后仍优于随机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应感知默认"感知更好=决策更好"，但当感知服务于下游决策系统时，更优感知输出未必带来更优决策，甚至可能有害；因此需要以决策价值而非感知增益来评判感知算力分配。

Method: 定义"感知计算的决策价值"为输入从廉价升级到昂贵感知模式时下游损失的变化；构造预算受限的决策oracle（以均匀全精度推理为基线而非上界），并提出DEEP基准，在选择性、延迟与能耗预算下，对升级前的分配器评分并计入各分配器自身计算开销。在KITTI/nuScenes上部署单目几何，并在nuPlan上对PDM-Closed规划器开环评估。

Result: 34–54%会改变下游损失的升级使损失变差；PDM-Closed规划器同样存在有害升级。nuScenes上感知级增益与决策价值符号常不一致：按漏检感知增益而非决策价值选择固定部署信号，会使实际测试决策增益平均下降相当全部廉价损失7.4%。学习型分配器能找回部分oracle价值，但选中伤害接近随机；在20%延迟预算并计入自身开销后，仅轻量路由器（约全检测器一轮的3.5%）仍优于随机。

Conclusion: 感知算力分配应以决策价值为准绳而非感知增益；现有学习型分配器在真实预算下收益有限，轻量路由是少数有效方案。DEEP为相关评估提供了基准与规范。

Abstract: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

</details>


### [447] [Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35911)
*Tong Zhao,Reed Li,Yuyang Hu,Yutao Zhu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Yu Lu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出StepLearn非参数框架，将单个transition转化为可立即使用的假设，但跨episode复用前需前瞻验证，无需更新模型参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署时LLM agent需及时将新观测转成指导，但现有test-time learning多从已完成episode获取知识，反馈滞后。以单transition粒度学习可减少延迟，却带来"单episode内有用的规则未必可靠"的难题：等待验证丧失即时收益，无限制复用又会传播错误指导。

Method: StepLearn分离即时使用与持久信任：将信息量大的transition转为假设指导下一步；跨episode复用需经过前瞻验证，其预测效果在源episode之外与后续观测比对，仅支持充分的假设才可用于持久指导；全程保持模型参数固定，仅更新外部知识。

Result: 在WebArena-Lite和ALFWorld五轮测试中，GPT-5-mini平均成功率59.9%和84.0%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B为57.8%和88.1%；四组设定均超过最强基线EvoTest 2.2–12.7个百分点。学习动态显示优势不限于最终轮，多数设定首次尝试即已显现。

Conclusion: 通过分离即时使用与持久信任并引入前瞻验证，StepLearn在不更新参数的前提下实现了更快、更可靠的经验复用，显著优于现有test-time learning基线。

Abstract: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

</details>


### [448] [Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36271)
*Thomas Dybdahl Ahle,Yaroslav Bulatov,Christopher De Sa,Christopher Ré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将幂律谱理论推广到SGD，并为各向同性高斯数据提供了数据洗牌的精确分析，证明单次洗牌优于Flip-Flop和IID采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典指数收敛界与实际观察到的幂律学习曲线存在冲突，已有工作用幂律谱条件解决了确定性梯度下降的问题，但尚未推广到高维机器学习中的随机情形。

Method: (1) 将幂律谱理论推广到随机梯度下降（SGD），表明相同的谱指数支配随机动力学；(2) 针对各向同性高斯数据这一基础情形，对数据洗牌进行精确分析，推导出精确常数。

Result: 证明单次洗牌（Single Shuffle）严格优于Flip-Flop和IID采样。

Conclusion: 研究弥合了抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择之间的差距，给出数据几何如何驱动优化速度的统一图景。

Abstract: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.

</details>


### [449] [Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35917)
*Maurya Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文独立复现一个不确定性感知的道路级事故预测模型，检验其11项设计决策，发现多数无法复现，且图神经网络相较历史基线的优势主要源于基线回溯期过短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在道路级事故预测中应用日益广泛，但其宣称的性能增益缺乏稳定性审查，尤其是基线比较与随机性影响未被充分检验。

Method: 重建数据管道，在伦敦三个行政区、扩展窗口协议下评估参照模型的11项设计决策；跨行政区复现；多随机种子评估；与无参数的历史累计事故计数基线对比，并扫描其回溯期。

Result: 11项决策仅4项在第二行政区复现，7项失败其中4项符号反转；单一行政区内某效应随种子变号，参照架构种子间波动最高35.7分对本模型4分。历史深度匹配时本模型与基线无统计差异（-0.90分，p=0.61），参照架构在18/18窗口上均败于基线（-17.37，p<10^-6）。基线精度随回溯期在22.71%–83.94%间波动，其1–5年回溯即可匹配该方向所有已发表数值。

Conclusion: 图网络相对历史基线的表面优势很大程度上是基线回溯期过短的假象；建议采用回溯期匹配基线和多随机种子报告作为最低标准。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

</details>


### [450] [GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36281)
*Vincent Uhse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GNA是一种双粒度检索增强层，通过整窗与逐变量邻居组装，配合学习门控提升多变量时间序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定回看窗口的预测器延长窗口收益递减、成本上升；检索增强可提供相似过去情景的延续，但整窗检索会让所有变量共享同一过去时刻的延续，忽略了多变量序列中各变量最佳匹配不同的问题。

Method: 提出GNA检索层，在两个粒度组装邻居：整窗（保持变量间一致性）与逐变量邻居（每个变量取自己最佳匹配过去的未来）。学习门控在每步每变量上权衡检索未来、持续预测与骨干自身预测。候选来自预测窗口未来的嵌入，检索严格因果（过去窗口的未来被观测后才可用）。

Result: 相同回看与检索常数下，GNA在96个数据集-预测步设置中85个提升两个Transformer骨干，12个标准基准中8个取得最低MSE，其中10个在每个随机种子均超越骨干。两种粒度均必要，错配查询的邻居比无邻居更差；回看信息最少处增益最大，门控在更远预测步转向信任检索未来。

Conclusion: 双粒度检索增强有效提升多变量预测，失败主要出现在长时程非平稳小时级序列，损失与检索未来的水平漂移一致。

Abstract: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost. Retrieval augmentation instead shows the model how similar past situations continued. Retrieving a whole past window gives every variate the continuation of the same past moment. In multivariate series, however, the best past match differs from variate to variate. We present GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly), a retrieval layer for forecasting backbones that assembles neighbors at two granularities: whole past windows, which keep the variates coherent, and per-variate neighbors, in which each variate takes its future from its own best-matching past. A learned gate decides, per forecast step and variate, how much to trust these futures against a persistence forecast, next to the backbone's own forecast. Candidates come from an embedding trained to predict each window's future, and retrieval is strictly causal: a past window is used only once its future has been observed. With the same lookback for every model and the same retrieval constants for all datasets, GNA improves two Transformer backbones in 85 of 96 dataset-horizon settings, gives the lowest MSE on 8 of 12 standard benchmarks and beats its backbone in every seed on 10 of them. Both granularities are needed, and neighbors of mismatched queries are worse than none. Retrieval helps most where the lookback says least: the gate shifts trust to retrieved futures further ahead. Where it fails, on hourly non-stationary series at long horizons, the loss is consistent with a drifting level of the retrieved futures.

</details>


### [451] [Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35926)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Luis Fernando Herbozo Contreras,Zhaojing Huang,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TMLN，将连续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，用对角经验 Fisher 矩阵构建局部黎曼流形，并借助参数历史轨迹动态调节预条件器，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续学习在非平稳数据分布上顺序训练时会出现灾难性遗忘。现有方法存在不足：基于预条件梯度的方法较为短视；标准正则化则使用刚性的标量欧氏惩罚，完全忽略参数空间的黎曼几何结构。

Method: TMLN 将连续学习建模为弯曲损失景观上的规范导航策略/最优控制问题。它使用内存高效的对角经验 Fisher 信息矩阵定义局部黎曼流形，并利用网络参数值的归一化历史轨迹动态调节预条件器，以弥补对角近似的空间局限。该基于轨迹的预条件被直接整合进梯度更新中，无需依赖加性惩罚即可保护历史上关键的参数方向。

Result: 在类别增量和领域增量基准上的实证评估表明，该方法显著降低了相邻任务之间的损失障碍。

Conclusion: TMLN 通过结合黎曼几何、对角 Fisher 预条件与历史轨迹调制，为连续学习提供了一种非加性惩罚的梯度更新方案，有效减少任务间损失障碍，缓解灾难性遗忘。

Abstract: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

</details>


### [452] [MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36301)
*Honam Wong,Surbhi Goel,Enric Boix-Adserà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoRE通过对MoE路由器权重矩阵进行低秩分解，将路由开销从Θ(Mh)降至O((h+M)r)，理论上证明对数秩足够，实验上在记忆任务和知识问答上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前MoE架构趋向于更多更小的专家，导致标准线性路由器的每token成本Θ(Mh)成为瓶颈。

Method: 将路由器权重矩阵按秩r进行分解（Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts），并设计融合的Triton推理内核以避免HBM上昂贵的访存操作。

Result: 证明日志级秩即可保证路由表达性且维持负载均衡；在同步活跃FLOPs下可增加Θ(h/r)倍专家数；在phonebook任务和知识密集型QA基准上提升记忆与性能，同时保持推理能力。

Conclusion: MoRE通过低秩路由分解有效缓解大专家数下的路由瓶颈，在理论上有保证、在实践中有加速与性能提升。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.

</details>


### [453] [CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35929)
*Onisa Mpaunda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CADENCE是一个CPU原生的双专家时序分类架构，通过拼接卷积线性专家与分布区间专家、并用置信自适应元路由融合，在109个UCR数据集上以17.53秒/数据集的成本达到仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0的精度（0.8864）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序分类存在精度与可扩展性的尖锐权衡：元集成（如HIVE-COTE 2.0）精度最高但算力需求大；超快随机卷积变换（MiniRocket、Hydra）虽秒级运行，但在相位无关分布、信号运动学和大量类别下的决策树碎片化问题上表现不佳。因此需要兼顾精度与效率的统一方案。

Method: 提出CADENCE双专家架构，将表示学习解耦为两条路径：(i)卷积线性专家，将10000个确定性膨胀特征与闭式L2正则化的Woodbury岭分类配对；(ii)分布区间专家，将竞争性膨胀核（Hydra）与信号运动学及FFT频带上的dyadic Cornish-Fisher矩近似配对，用ExtraTrees集成拟合。另设带稀有类保留的内部验证元路由器，动态选择纯专家路由或置信加权软融合，随后在100%训练数据上全量重拟合。

Result: 在全部109个等长UCR数据集、30次重采样（共3270次运行）上，CADENCE平均精度0.8864，排名第二，仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895，pHolm=0.295，无显著差异），优于Hydra+MultiRocket（0.8818）、MultiRocket（0.8797）和HIVE-COTE 1.0（0.8786，pHolm=0.048）。将差距缩小到0.31个百分点，同时双核CPU平均仅需17.53秒/数据集。

Conclusion: CADENCE以CPU原生、高效的统一双专家架构，在几乎不损失精度的情况下（与SOTA无统计显著差异）大幅降低计算成本，证明其在精度-效率权衡上的优越性。源代码与评估脚本已开源。

Abstract: Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

</details>


### [454] [Cheap and Powerful Tests for Supervised Subspaces: Per-Component Inference for PLS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36307)
*Paweł Lenartowicz,Hubert Plisiecki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为PLS回归（及PLS、监督PCA、线性探针等共享的监督子空间）的拟合结果提供了高效推断方案：通过对监督子空间做留出样本的OLS重拟合，并提出两种基于留出相关性的检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PLS回归广泛用于高维X中提取与结果对齐的方向，但现有推断要么昂贵、要么有偏且不被推荐、要么完全缺失。

Method: 将推断归约为监督子空间的留出OLS重拟合；提出两种基于留出相关性的检验：Nadeau-Bengio校正渐近t检验（快速近似）与置换检验（在结果-预测变量独立且行iid下有限样本有效，功效相当）。由于留出预测在监督张量的任意正交重基下不变，可解释基（如varimax）继承联合声明但无逐轴p值；逐成分声明用PLS提取顺序上的固定序列检验。提供n与X谱的预检判断近似是否安全。

Result: 在合成几何、两个NIR化学计量数据集、跨语言词嵌入回归上验证；精确检验也可迁移至监督PCA和岭探针；所提检验比CV-permutation-Q^2功效更高且成本仅为其中一小部分。

Conclusion: 发布了带Python、R、Julia绑定的Rust库及Python文本流程，为PLS类监督降维提供实用、低成本且有效的推断工具。

Abstract: Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression extracts a few outcome-aligned directions in a high-dimensional X and is widely used across applied science, but inference on the resulting fit is either expensive, biased and discouraged, or absent. We reduce inference to held-out OLS refits of the supervised subspace, a primitive shared by PLS, supervised PCA, and linear probes, and supply two tests using held-out correlations: a Nadeau-Bengio corrected asymptotic t-test as a fast approximation, and a permutation test with comparable power, finite-sample valid under outcome-predictor independence and iid rows. Held-out predictions are unchanged under any orthogonal rebasing of the supervised span, so an interpretable basis such as varimax inherits the joint claim but not a per-axis p-value; per-component claims come from a fixed-sequence test on the PLS extraction order. We validate on synthetic geometries, two NIR chemometric datasets, and cross-lingual word-embedding regressions; the exact test also transfers to supervised PCA and a ridge probe. The proposed tests have more power than CV-permutation-Q^2, at a fraction of its cost. A pre-run check on n and the spectrum of X says when the approximation is safe. We release a Rust library with Python, R, and Julia bindings, plus a Python text pipeline.

</details>


### [455] [Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35934)
*Martin Bauw,Santiago Velasco-Forero,Jesus Angulo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究面向组织化信号集（有序信号、网格距离单元信号、图节点信号）的神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集投影到固定维度的向量空间，以实现与采样无关的拓扑感知处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器网络和雷达产生的信号集内部各信号可能具有不同的采样参数（异构采样），这阻碍了信号集作为整体进行统一的后续处理。

Method: 设计神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集投影到固定大小的向量空间，构造一个消除采样差异的表征空间，从而支持任意拓扑感知处理而不受信号处理约束。

Result: 通过信号集区分能力（聚焦于波形分离）实验评估表征相关性；编码与嵌入区分实验仅使用合成复值射频信号。

Conclusion: 所提出的表征空间可降低异构采样参数的影响，使信号集能以向量形式被处理，实现无采样约束的拓扑感知处理。

Abstract: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

</details>


### [456] [Adapting Linear-Time Architectures for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36337)
*David Schnurr,Felix Sarnthein,Thomas Hofmann,Imanol Schlag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了因果线性序列混合器在表格上下文学习（ICL）中的表现，发现DeltaNet优于非因果线性注意力，但其长度泛化在预训练上下文2-4倍后退化，原因是深层因果模型中递归状态不稳定；通过时间依赖衰减调度干预写速率并由最终状态读出恢复非因果性，可在OpenML-CC18和TabArena上接近softmax注意力基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型依赖上下文中的标注样本进行预测，但softmax注意力在大型数据集上计算受限；现有线性时间替代方案多为因果模型，其在表格ICL中的潜力尚不清楚。

Method: (1) 重新审视因果训练设置；(2) 比较线性序列混合器；(3) 研究预训练上下文长度之外的ICL泛化；分析递归状态不稳定性；对DeltaNet的学习写速率施加时间依赖衰减调度以稳定长度泛化，并从最终状态读出以恢复非因果性。

Result: 因果模型最佳训练设置类似下一token预测；DeltaNet优于非因果线性注意力；但在预训练上下文长度2-4倍后退化，双向性等缓解策略仅推迟问题；隐藏状态oracle表明并非容量问题，而是深层因果模型递归状态漂移；所提干预可稳定长度泛化，并在OpenML-CC18和TabArena上接近受控softmax注意力基线。

Conclusion: 因果线性混合器（尤其DeltaNet）在表格ICL中具有潜力，但需解决递归状态漂移问题；时间依赖衰减调度和最终状态读出可有效改善长度泛化并接近softmax基线性能。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve strong performance by conditioning on labelled examples in context, but softmax attention limits their use on large datasets. Existing linear-time alternatives, however, are mostly causal, and their potential for tabular in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored. To address this, we (1) revisit causal training setups, (2) compare linear sequence mixers, and (3) investigate their ICL generalisation beyond the pretraining context length. First, we show that the best training setup for causal models resembles next-token prediction. Then, perhaps surprisingly, the most promising linear sequence mixer is causal: DeltaNet outperforms even non-causal linear attention. However, it degrades beyond $2$-$4\times$ the pretraining context length, and existing mitigation strategies such as bidirectionality defer the problem at best. A hidden-state oracle shows that this is not a capacity problem. Instead, our analysis points to an instability in the recurrent state, which drifts in deeper layers of causal models. Since DeltaNet's learned write rates overfit to the pretraining regime, we modulate them with a time-dependent decay schedule intervention to stabilise length generalisation. Finally, re-introducing non-causality by reading out from the final state allows us to closely match a controlled softmax attention baseline on OpenML-CC18 and TabArena.

</details>


### [457] [KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35938)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Qiang Xi,Timon Rabczuk,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可解释神经算子框架KernelOnet，将核函数显式嵌入网络架构，替代DeepONet的隐式基函数学习，在浅水波导等问题上更准且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）通过深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且在无界外域（如声学传播）等问题上表现不佳。

Method: 用显式核函数替换trunk网络，提供三种核：(1)数据驱动可学习核（神经网络参数化RBF，常系数线性问题下可视为非奇异基本解）；(2)物理信息核（嵌入解析基本解，满足控制方程，仅用边界条件无监督训练）；(3)混合核（将解分解为齐次部分+源部分，平衡物理先验与数据拟合）。

Result: 在三个基准和一个浅水波导工程问题上达到高精度；与DeepONet相比更准且可学习参数更少；无监督配置无需内部解标签；单次查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。

Conclusion: KernelOnet为通用神经算子难以处理的无界外域声学传播问题提供了一条有效途径。

Abstract: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

</details>


### [458] [Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36486)
*Zijun Chen,Zihan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究未知转移、已知一组奖励函数的有限时域MDP，提出高效算法以近最优样本复杂度同时为所有奖励输出ε-最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际场景中，转移未知但可能面对多个已知奖励函数，需要仅通过在线交互同时为每个奖励学习近优策略，降低样本复杂度并避免额外预热成本。

Method: 结合三个技术：将MVP适配到奖励切换学习以构造乐观值估计；使用新回放样本保守评估候选策略；基于gap的乘法权重更新，根据估计差异调整奖励采样分布。

Result: 证明极小极大样本复杂度为 O(SAH^3/ε^2 log M · polylog(...)) 回合，且无额外 burn-in 成本，与信息论下界在 polylog 因子内匹配。

Conclusion: 该算法在无额外预热下达到近最优样本复杂度，可同时为多个已知奖励获得ε-最优策略。

Abstract: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.

</details>


### [459] [EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35944)
*Julien Moreau,Marc Lelarge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散模型的数据同化算法，通过学习过去与未来联合状态的分布，动态平衡当前状态置信度与新观测的可信度，提升稀疏、非均匀观测下的重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Score的自回归扩散数据同化模型仅以过去状态为条件训练，未考虑过去预测的不确定性，导致在观测稀疏或非均匀时性能受限。

Method: 学习包含过去与未来状态的联合分布，并结合经典En4DVar算法的改进版本，利用粒子集合的协方差，动态平衡对当前状态的置信度与新观测的信任。

Result: 在流体和交通流仿真实验中取得更优的重建性能，尤其在观测稀疏且非均匀的场景下提升显著。

Conclusion: 通过建模联合状态分布并引入集合协方差，可有效处理预测不确定性，为数据同化提供更鲁棒的扩散式方案。

Abstract: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

</details>


### [460] [Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36678)
*Audra McMillan,Kunal Talwar,Felix Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将 Private Evolution (PE) 重新表述为"生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习"，并给出更好的理论界、指出标准变体在良聚类实例上可能不收敛，提出几何感知版本 PE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PE 作为差分隐私合成数据算法，实践中远优于最坏情况 Wasserstein 分析的预测，理论与实践的差距需要解释。

Method: 把 PE 重铸为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习；考虑生成模型捕捉真实分布信息的情形进行理论分析；提出几何感知(geometry-aware)的 PE 变体。

Result: 若生成器在与分布相同的低维空间给出样本，样本复杂度取决于内在维度而非环境维度；标准 PE 变体在简单的良聚类实例上可能无法收敛；新算法在此类实例上具有可证明的收敛性。

Conclusion: 新算法在实验中与标准基线具竞争力，并能提升 recall，同时具备更好的理论与收敛保证。

Abstract: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

</details>


### [461] [Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36030)
*Dario Paccagnan,Marius Tirlea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明偏好式样本压缩的最先进风险界是可证紧的，并给出更简短初等的证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严格的安全性与性能证书是学习类方法部署的关键瓶颈。样本压缩可导出此类证书，尤其对满足偏好性质（稳定性）的算法可给出锐利界，但这些界是否紧仍是开放问题。

Method: 通过基于均匀分布与顺序统计量的显式构造，证明该界在极限意义下可达；同时仅用初等计数论证给出更短、更易理解的界证明，避免无穷维对偶。

Result: 证明确认了偏好压缩的最先进界可证紧，且构造在极限中达到该界；并提供了无需无穷维对偶的简化证明。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了界的紧性开放问题，并简化了证明，适用于Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn与支持向量方法等场景。

Abstract: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

</details>


### [462] [When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36704)
*Jianyu Xu,Smriti Jha,Aarti Singh,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究成本感知的双分辨率学习：昂贵的细标签给出向量响应，便宜的粗标签给出未知权重聚合的标量，目标是恢复完整响应。作者刻画信息几何，提出估计-跟踪策略学习聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率混合，给出粗监督的盈亏平衡条件及最优风险系数与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习系统常在多种分辨率下获取监督，需在标注成本与信息量之间权衡；粗标签的聚合规则未知，使得其价值同时取决于成本、噪声与可识别性。

Method: 研究成本感知的双分辨率学习问题，其中细标签揭示向量响应、粗标签揭示未知权重形成的标量聚合；刻画该问题的信息几何，并提出估计-跟踪策略，在线学习聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率混合。

Result: 推导出粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件；证明在线策略达到最优的领先累积风险系数，并给出匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界；合成实验验证了全细/混合的相变、在线学习器接近理想分配基准，以及在粗监督足够有利时相对全细采集的有限预算增益。

Conclusion: 结果为跨监督分辨率平衡信息与标注成本提供了有原则的方法。

Abstract: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

</details>


### [463] [ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35954)
*Zhiwei Zhang,Huayu Deng,Fei Zhao,Jiayan Fu,Bin Liang,Kam-Fai Wong,Mu Chuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ROSS通过选择性监督复用历史自我rollout，将完整轨迹作为上下文但仅对选定片段计算损失，在多种训练场景下提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练产生的自我rollout在策略更新后常被视为过时而被丢弃，但历史rollout可保留兼容且可靠的行为经验，同时可能含错误、废弃尝试和冗余动作，因此需要细粒度选择性监督。

Method: ROSS保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，只对选定的模型生成续写部分施加损失，实现自生成rollout的选择性监督，无需额外策略rollout。

Result: 在领域特定RL、多教师on-policy蒸馏和agentic RL中，ROSS持续提升上游checkpoint，并在数学、代码生成、指令跟随、软件工程等任务上超过基线。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，六基准MOPD平均从58.40%提升至62.20%，SWE-bench Verified从64.20%提升至68.40%。

Conclusion: 自我rollout训练留下的可复用行为经验可通过离线SFT带来收益，无需额外策略rollout。

Abstract: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

</details>


### [464] [Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36762)
*Mitushi Goyal,Tarun S.,Riddhanya Senapathi,Arun Raman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两阶段联邦聚类框架，无需全局K和局部K_g，用ASM估计局部簇数后供FedGEM使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦聚类即便不需要全局簇数K，仍假设客户端知道本地簇数K_g，这在客户端与服务器信息对等的场景（如独立工业站点故障诊断）中不成立。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段ASM（Adaptive Split-Merge）从各客户端自数据估计K_g，通过BIC驱动分裂生长球形高斯混合，再合并多余分量；无需标签、仅在留出客户端数据上选超参、不假设簇的跨客户端共享方式。推导了闭式分裂准则，其临界簇大小随各向异性下降、随维度上升。第二阶段将估计的K_g替代真值输入FedGEM等需局部计数的聚合器。

Result: 八个数据集上，ASM+FedGEM平均ARI为0.333，优于次优无标签估计器的0.256，接近提供真实局部计数的0.361；同时给出最可靠的全局K估计，并在客户端规模与局部基数解耦时保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 无需任何簇数信息的两阶段联邦聚类框架，通过ASM估计局部簇数即可使FedGEM类方法接近使用真值的性能，且全局K估计更可靠、鲁棒性更强。

Abstract: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

</details>


### [465] [Encoder-Sharing Hierarchical Federated Multi-Task Learning for VANETs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36157)
*M. Saeid HaghighiFard,Sinem Coleri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EN-HMTFL，将基于聚类的分层联邦学习与全局共享编码器、车辆本地解码器结合，使执行异构任务的车辆能协同学习可迁移特征表示，同时保留各自任务模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有车联网联邦学习框架假设所有车辆协作训练同一任务的单一模型，限制了其在车辆执行异构但相关感知任务（输出空间不同）场景下的适用性。

Method: EN-HMTFL 集成基于聚类的分层联邦学习，采用全局共享编码器和车辆本地解码器；仅编码器通过层级结构交换与聚合，原始数据和本地解码器参数保留在车辆端。

Result: 在 MNIST 和 GTSRB 数据集的不同车辆场景中评估，相比表示共享基准，准确率最高提升 24.0%；在 EN-HMTFL 更早收敛的场景中，通信轮数最多减少 69 轮（28.8%）。

Conclusion: EN-HMTFL 有效支持车辆异构多任务联邦学习，在提升准确率的同时降低通信开销，具有更好的实际车联网适用性。

Abstract: Most federated learning frameworks for vehicular ad hoc networks assume that all vehicles collaboratively train a single model for a common task. This assumption limits their applicability to practical vehicular environments, where vehicles may perform heterogeneous but related perception tasks with different output spaces. This paper proposes encoder-sharing hierarchical multi-task federated learning (EN-HMTFL), which integrates cluster-based hierarchical federated learning with a globally shared encoder and vehicle-local decoders. EN-HMTFL enables vehicles performing different tasks to collaboratively learn a transferable feature representation while preserving their task-specific models locally. Only the encoder is exchanged and aggregated through the hierarchy, whereas raw data and local decoder parameters remain at the vehicles. The proposed framework is evaluated on the MNIST and GTSRB datasets in different vehicular scenarios. Across the evaluated scenarios, EN-HMTFL improves accuracy by up to 24.0% relative to the compared representation-sharing benchmark. In scenarios where EN-HMTFL converges earlier, the reduction reaches up to 69 communication rounds (28.8%).

</details>


### [466] [Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36001)
*Rafael Garcia-Dias,Alexandre Triay Bagur,Chayanin Tangwiriyasakul,Virginia Fernandez,Parhom Esmaeili,Piyalitt Ittichaiwong,Yang Li,Lawrence Adams,Wason Buncharoen,Martin Chapman,Benjamaporn Chayanond,Sadthavud Chunrod,Tanawat Fongsri,Kass Gibson,Supat Plungprasertkul,Supawit Tangpanithandee,Kanyakorn Veerakanjana,Vicky Goh,Michela Antonelli,Joe Zhang,Kongkiat Kespechara,Sebastien Ourselin,M. Jorge Cardoso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出开源多应用平台FLIP，使联邦学习的训练与评估可重复，并通过英泰两国两节点合成胸片队列验证其支持国际FL协作、提升可重复性、可审计性与站点治理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗联邦学习因每次合作都需重建治理保障、开销过大，多数项目止步于概念验证阶段，缺乏可复用、可重复的协作基础设施。

Method: FLIP将常见FL流程实现为可组合服务：针对各站点结构化数据库的队列查询、按需从机构PACS获取DICOM、逐站点项目审批及可复用FL作业类型；各机构独立审批参与并依本地IT安全流程运行自有节点，并在英、泰两节点合成胸片队列上运行联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例。

Result: 证明此类平台可支撑国际FL协作，并改善可重复性、可审计性与站点特定治理；同时提供现有平台的全面比较以辅助选型。研究为操作性而非算法性主张，不与中心化训练比较。

Conclusion: FLIP表明可组合、尊重本地治理的开源平台能突破医疗FL的概念验证瓶颈，推动可重复、可审计的国际协作实践。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.

</details>


### [467] [Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36771)
*Md Musfiqur Rahman,Kenneth Lee,Ziwei Jiang,Padmaja Jonnalagedda,Ruocheng Guo,Murat Kocaoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RCA-DCM，通过将系统建模为因果模型、异常建模为结构函数变化，并利用深度因果模型（DCM）框架处理潜在混杂因素，实现无需强无混杂假设的根因分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有根因分析（RCA）方法依赖启发式方法或条件独立性检验，且需要强无混杂假设，无法利用潜在变量存在下的复杂分布约束。

Method: 将底层系统建模为因果模型，异常系统建模为同一因果模型结构函数的变化；建立分布约束检验与根因分析之间的隐式联系以处理未观测混杂；采用深度因果模型（DCM）框架，用神经网络设计因果模型；并支持利用不同层次的局部图知识进行RCA。

Result: 在模拟数据集、基于物理的因果室和两个微服务应用上评估。RCA-DCM在Sock Shop上top-1准确率为0.880（对比最强基线0.752），在Online Boutique上为0.776（对比0.712）；当因果室中真实根因未观测并作为潜在混杂因素时，完美恢复率（PRR）为0.846（对比0.731）。

Conclusion: RCA-DCM通过深度因果模型与分布约束检验的结合，有效放松了传统RCA的无混杂假设，在处理潜在混杂因素的根因分析任务上优于现有最先进基线。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

</details>


### [468] [Scalable Diffusion SBI for Compositional Inference under Simulator Misspecification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36950)
*Vincent D. Zaballa,Elliot E. Hui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的模拟推断方法，含组合采样、层次块采样与路径正则微调，用于处理异构观测、层次隐变量及模型误设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟推断面临三大挑战：需组合大量异构观测、须保留层次隐变量结构、且模拟器相对观测数据存在误设。现有方法通常需重新训练或缺乏对误设的校正机制。

Method: 在design-conditional设定下扩展组合score-based推断，引入连续时间扩散系数以考虑观测数量，避免Jacobian与辅助协方差校正；提出Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS)，用单个预训练模型推断共享参数与分组隐状态，层次结构仅在采样时指定；并引入路径正则微调（path-regularized fine-tuning），用Girsanov定理量化预训练与微调模型间的路径散度以区分误设校正与不必要适应。

Result: 在exact-score Gaussian、SLCP等基准上验证组合采样；在受控层次模型上验证HBDS（解析与学习score）；在已知design-dependent差异的解析模型上验证微调与定位；应用于BMP信号模型940个测量、四个细胞系，微调提升后验预测精度并使后验边际向最小二乘参考移动同时保留分散度。

Conclusion: 所提方法支持可变观测集与分组而无需重训练，能有效校正模拟器误设并提升实际生物学模型的后验推断质量。

Abstract: Simulation-based inference is challenging when many heterogeneous observations must be composed, hierarchical latent structure must be preserved, and the simulator is misspecified relative to observed data. We develop sampling and fine-tuning methods for diffusion-based inference in design-conditional settings, where the same simulator is queried across different experimental conditions $ξ$. We extend compositional score-based inference with a continuous-time diffusion coefficient that accounts for the number of observations, avoiding Jacobian and auxiliary-covariance corrections. We introduce Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS), which infers shared parameters and group-specific latent states using a single pretrained model, with the hierarchy specified only at sampling time. Together, these methods support variable observation sets and groupings without retraining. To address misspecification, we introduce path-regularized fine-tuning that adapts the learned likelihood to observations and transfers corrections to posterior inference. Using Girsanov's theorem, we quantify path divergence between pretrained and fine-tuned models across experimental designs and interpret it alongside predictive errors to distinguish candidate misspecification correction from unnecessary adaptation. We evaluate compositional sampling on exact-score Gaussian and Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior benchmarks, HBDS with analytic and learned scores on a controlled hierarchical model, and fine-tuning and localization on a separate analytic model with known design-dependent discrepancy. Finally, we apply the framework to 940 measurements across four cell lines in a mechanistic Bone Morphogenetic Protein signaling model, where fine-tuning improves posterior-predictive accuracy relative to the pretrained model and shifts posterior marginals toward the least-squares reference while retaining spread.

</details>


### [469] [TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36032)
*Ran Ben Basat,Michael Mitzenmacher,Shay Vargaftik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TORQUE通过联合优化旋转前后保留的高精度坐标数量与选择，在固定比特预算下提升量化精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机旋转量化虽能使坐标分布近似高斯并支持离线码本，但旋转会将大的输入坐标值扩散到多个坐标，造成额外误差。

Method: 在旋转前按top-k保留大坐标以抑制扩散，旋转后保留小比例最大幅值坐标以更准确量化剩余截断高斯分布；推导量化误差上界并证明top-k最优，将子集搜索简化为对k的优化，采用离线码本与并行参数选择实现快速优化器。

Result: 在高斯模型数值评估及最近邻检索、KV-cache压缩、激活压缩实验中，展示了更优的重建精度与存储成本权衡。

Conclusion: 联合优化旋转前后高精度保留策略可有效改进基于随机旋转的量化方法。

Abstract: Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

</details>


### [470] [Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance for Energy-Based Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37043)
*Yuwen Qian,Yidong Ouyang,Zhengyan Wan,Hongyuan Zha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IEDG，一种基于退火轨迹的种群精确离散引导框架，用于从多模态无归一化离散分布中采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模离散状态空间上从无归一化分布采样困难，尤其当多模态目标远离易处理参考分布时，单步学习参考到目标的修正非常困难。

Method: IEDG沿退火轨迹引入全局Boltzmann倾斜，每个阶段学习当前源分布的增量倾斜的局部后验修正，并将其相对固定解析后验累积；用rESS选择阶段增量以控制Rényi-2位移并自适应步长；给出阶段级TV分析。

Result: 在4×4 Ising上所有分布级误差优于神经基线；在16×16 Ising/Potts上大幅降低one-shot误差，局部统计量与相覆盖指标达最佳；Max-Cut上best-of-512与平均样本比超过所有基线。

Conclusion: IEDG通过种群体精确的增量退火引导，有效提升无归一化离散目标采样质量，在多个基准上超越神经基线。

Abstract: Sampling from unnormalized distributions over large discrete state spaces becomes difficult when a multimodal target is far from a tractable reference. We introduce Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance (IEDG), a population-exact, trajectory-wise guidance framework for unnormalized discrete targets. Rather than learn the full reference-to-target correction in one step, IEDG introduces a global Boltzmann tilt along an annealing trajectory. Each stage learns a stage-local posterior correction for an incremental Boltzmann tilt of the current source, while the resulting corrections are accumulated relative to a fixed analytic posterior. At the population optimum, exact stage posteriors recover the correct reverse dynamics, whose exact simulation reproduces the target distribution. IEDG chooses stage increments by relative effective sample size (rESS), which controls Rényi-2 displacement and locally adapts the step size to the thermodynamic geometry of the annealing path. Our stagewise total-variation analysis shows that limited overlap amplifies Bregman fitting error by $1/\sqrt{\mathrm{rESS}}$, while posterior, simulation, and truncation errors enter additively. IEDG improves all distribution-level errors over the neural baselines on ordered, exactly enumerated Ising $4\times4$, while substantially reducing one-shot errors on Ising/Potts $16\times16$ across thermodynamic regimes and attaining the best neural-sampler result on several reported local-statistic and phase-coverage metrics. On Max-Cut, its best-of-512 and average-sample ratios exceed all the baselines. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/StillFantasy123/iterative-exact-discrete-guidance.

</details>


### [471] [Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36942)
*Simone Betteti,Morteza Lahijanian,Luca Laurenti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于能量型现代Hopfield网络的新型神经架构，将现代Hopfield网络与端口Hamilton神经ODE结合，实现"设计即安全"（safety-by-design）的动力学系统建模，并可构造障碍函数给出显式可行输入集与鲁棒半径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键场景部署学习型动力学系统模型时，安全性是基本要求。通常通过证明状态空间中某子集的不变性来保证安全，但现有框架要么依赖计算昂贵的后验验证，要么采用强制安全机制却缺乏形式化正确性保证。

Method: 将现代Hopfield网络（能量型）与端口Hamilton神经ODE相整合，使得障碍函数可在设计阶段直接被构造，从而给出显式的可行输入集和定量鲁棒半径，同时保持对复杂非线性动力学的表达能力，实现safety-by-design。

Result: 在多个基准上（包括一个12维纳米无人机模型）达到state-of-the-art性能，并产生经过认证的不变集，其对外部扰动的鲁棒性优于同类现有方法。

Conclusion: 该框架在保证形式化安全性的同时具备强表达能力和鲁棒性，为安全关键场景下神经动力学模型的部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.

</details>


### [472] [Neural networks for spectral optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36047)
*Alexis de Villeroché,Beniamin Bogosel,Stéphane Breuils,Dorin Bucur,Jacques-Olivier Lachaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两种神经网络代理模型，直接从区域几何预测微分算子谱，用于谱泛函的shape optimization。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用PDE求解器进行谱优化计算成本高昂，需快速可微的谱预测替代方法。

Method: 方法一：Fourier系数编码+轻量MLP，通过系数重缩放满足特征值缩放律，并对旋转/反射输出平均实现不变性；方法二：输入landscape function、指示函数及其梯度，用Gram-Schmidt生成正交特征函数及对应特征值。

Result: Fourier模型在星形几何上精度0.2%；landscape模型前十个特征值平均相对误差1%，优于FNO的4%；SDF替代landscape使预测与优化误差变差；模型可从合成形状泛化到图像数据集，并复现经典谱最优（第一特征值的圆盘等）。

Conclusion: 两种代理模型能提供精确可微的特征值估计，可用于涉及谱量的形状优化问题。

Abstract: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues.
