We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

</details>


### [473] [Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37083)
*Alessandro Trenta,Riccardo Massidda,Davide Bacciu,Sara Magliacane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPEED-AE结合预训练因果表示学习与逐分量自编码器，从高维图像观测中恢复控制性ODE，提升稀疏方程发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ODE发现方法假设直接测量变量或缺乏理论保证；CRL虽能从高维观测识别变量（至逐分量微分同胚），但这些变量通常无法直接用于假设稀疏方程的方程发现方法。

Method: 提出SPEED-AE框架：将预训练CRL方法与逐分量自编码器结合，学习适合稀疏ODE发现的变量变换；对多项式ODE，将每个变量的可识别性从多项式微分同胚限制到单项式微分同胚。

Result: 在Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz和双摆系统上，SPEED-AE优于CRL方法的解耦性，恢复最接近真值的ODE，并达到最先进的预测性能。

Conclusion: 该额外转换步骤有效衔接CRL与稀疏ODE发现，实现高维观测下可识别且稀疏的动力学方程恢复。

Abstract: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.

</details>


### [474] [Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36049)
*Joseph H. Rudoler,Kevin Tan,Benedict Tessler,Timothy Kong,Enric Boix Adserà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究通过协同训练监视器来避免工人规避监视的问题，涵盖监督与自监督两种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工人-监视器（worker-monitor）是AI监督的有前景方案，但针对固定监视器训练工人会激励其规避监视，需要研究协同训练是否可避免此失效模式。

Method: 监督设定下证明：当且仅当可能监视器函数类具有有限Littlestone维度时，可实现错误率与查询率趋于零的监视；自监督设定下提出基于测试时蒸馏的协同训练流程，监视器用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再训练其标准算力策略，并对多数投票标签在自适应工人分布与动作覆盖下给出有限样本锐化保证。

Result: 监督设定中得到有限Littlestone维度的精确刻画，将工人监视与对抗在线学习文献联系起来；多数投票标签下证明监视器判定收敛于初始众数判定；在代码安全场景中对抗性压力测试显示自适应监视器更能跟上工人策略演化，固定监视器更易被规避。

Conclusion: 协同训练监视器可缓解工人规避问题，自适应监视器优于固定监视器，为AI监督提供可行方向。

Abstract: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

</details>


### [475] [Interpretable intrinsic dimension estimation through componentwise calibration of distance and angle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37114)
*Chih-Hsuan Huang,Chih-Wei Chen,Szu-Chi Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将DANCo按距离与角度分量重新表述，分别校准并诊断噪声与幅度异质性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DANCo在干净的本征维度基准上精度领先，但实际数据中的邻域相对噪声和样本幅度异质性会扭曲其几何信号，且原方法混合了距离与角度信息，难以定位估计偏差来源。

Method: 对DANCo进行分量重构，保留独立的距离与角度差异曲线。距离分量上，为Gride的广义阶比推导闭式KL散度；角度分量上，针对两种采样机制提出对齐均值方向同时保留浓度匹配的Profiled策略。

Result: Full匹配下Gride将40%噪声下的平均百分比误差从27.7%降至17.6%；高斯尺度混合上Profiled将MiND从22.8提升至66.7，去除幅度后MiND-Full恢复至71.9；CIFAR-10和ImageNet上幅度归一化缩小Full-Profiled差距；四个CNN中Gride-Profiled、TWO-NN、MLE呈相似升降趋势。

Conclusion: 分量式重构能识别估计来源并可解释，幅度异质性是Full估计不足的主因，而Full-Profiled差异可用于定位对角度校准敏感的层。

Abstract: DANCo (Dimensionality from Angle and Norm Concentration) jointly calibrates nearest-neighbor distance and angular statistics and consistently reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on clean intrinsic-dimension (ID) benchmarks. Practical data, however, introduce neighborhood-relative noise and sample-amplitude heterogeneity that can distort these geometric signals. We reformulate DANCo componentwise, retaining separate distance and angular discrepancy curves so that the source of an estimate can be identified and interpreted. For the distance component, we derive a closed-form Kullback-Leibler divergence for the generic-order ratios of the generalized ratios ID estimator (Gride); when both angular parameters are matched (Full), Gride reduces mean percentage error from $27.7\%$ to $17.6\%$ at noise equal to $40\%$ of typical neighbor spacing on 24 manifolds. For the angular component, two sampling regimes motivate aligning mean direction while retaining concentration matching (Profiled). On a Gaussian scale mixture with generating dimension 70 embedded in 100 dimensions, profiling raises the Minimum Neighbor Distance (MiND) estimate from $22.8$ to $66.7$, while removing the known amplitudes restores MiND-Full to $71.9$; the control thus attributes the Full shortfall to amplitude heterogeneity. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, amplitude-reducing normalizations move angular location toward the references and narrow the Full-Profiled gap, an observational counterpart to the controlled mixture. Across four pretrained convolutional neural networks, Gride-Profiled, the two-nearest-neighbor estimator (TWO-NN), and the maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE) exhibit similar rise-and-fall profiles, while Full-Profiled differences identify the layers most sensitive to angular calibration.

</details>


### [476] [ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36058)
*Hsiao-Ru Pan,Florent Draye,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Adv-Based Control Variates (ABC)，将轨迹级控制变量通过优势-价值公式重构，与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 结合成单一 actor-critic 算法，在离线到在线的 RLVR 设置下，用更少的在线优化步数达到与 GRPO 竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 中无 critic 的 GRPO 等方法很有效，而 actor-critic 方法因价值函数近似误差，会通过 TD 误差等优势估计器引入偏差。作者希望重新审视轨迹级控制变量以减少这种偏差。

Method: 提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC) 的优势-价值公式，揭示其协方差结构与 DAE 的回报分解密切相关；将 ABC 与 DAE 结合为单一 actor-critic 算法，在离线到在线 RLVR 设置中先在历史轨迹上训练 critic，再在线适应。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，ABC 使用显著更少的在线优化步数即达到与 GRPO 竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 轨迹级控制变量与优势估计的结合可有效提升 actor-critic 在 RLVR 中的样本效率，ABC+DAE 是 GRPO 的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

</details>


### [477] [Pointwise or Pairwise: When Do Pairwise Losses Help Reward Learning, Provably?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37209)
*Junghyun Lee,Minsoo Ha,Sanghwa Kim,Yeongjong Kim,Eunjee Lee,Seiyun Shin,Kwang-Sung Jun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，比较逐点损失(VR)与成对损失(VDR)在奖励学习中的理论表现，揭示VDR的优势条件与偏差-方差权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对损失在奖励学习中日益流行，即使观测到的是逐点奖励，其经验效果好坏参半。作者想厘清成对损失何时、为何优于逐点损失。

Method: 在允许每个上下文有多个动作的分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，采用半参数模型（均值奖励=可学习的动作相关分量+任意上下文相关但动作无关的干扰项）。通过统一的局部化分析，为有限函数类和线性函数类证明有限样本回归保证，并转化为离线遗憾界。

Result: 对有限类，VDR消除了VR界中的误设项，并通过在同一上下文内跨动作平均，改善了依赖奖励尺度的误差项；该优势在VR中不存在。对线性类，两者无一致占优关系：上下文内差分去除干扰偏差，但当误设足够低时可能增大估计方差。由此产生依赖特征几何的偏差-方差权衡，数值实验予以印证。

Conclusion: VDR并非普遍优于VR：其优势取决于函数类与误设程度，存在特征几何依赖的偏差-方差权衡，需视具体情形选择损失形式。

Abstract: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.

</details>


### [478] [An Efficient Machine Learning Approach for Degradation Forecasting in AEM Water Electrolysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37941)
*Marco Veneriano,Ani Gjergji,Sebastiano Bellani,Andrea Riva,Vito Paolo Pastore,Matteo Santacesaria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对新型单电池阴离子交换膜水电解槽（AEMWE）数据集，在恒定电流负载、多异构实验批次条件下，用线性基线、LSTM、CNN等不同复杂度模型对电池电压退化曲线做中期预测，并采用为异构工业数据设计的训练评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AEMWE作为新兴制氢技术，其长期稳定性与电压退化是关键问题；而实际工业数据往往来自异构实验批次，缺乏数据驱动的退化预测方法及适配异构数据的严谨评估框架。

Method: 构建单电池AEMWE新型数据集（恒流运行、多实验批次）；训练并评估线性基线、LSTM、CNN等不同复杂度机器学习模型；采用专为异构工业数据设计的训练与评估框架进行中期电压退化曲线预测。

Result: 论文训练并对比了从简单线性到LSTM、CNN的多种模型用于中期电压退化预测，但摘要未给出具体量化性能结果。

Conclusion: 该工作为AEMWE退化预测提供了数据驱动方案，并强调了面向异构工业数据的评估框架的重要性。（摘要未给出明确结论性发现）

Abstract: This study provides a data-driven analysis of a novel dataset of single-cell Anion Exchange Membrane water electrolyzers (AEMWE), operated under constant current load across multiple heterogeneous experimental campaigns. We train and evaluate a range of machine learning models with different complexity, including linear baselines, LSTMs and CNNs, to perform medium-term forecasting of the cell voltage degradation curve. The models are assessed within a rigorous training and evaluation framework specifically designed for heterogeneous industrial data.

</details>


### [479] [Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37227)
*Adhithyan Kalaivanan,Zheng Zhao,Jens Sjölund,Fredrik Lindsten*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出交互粒子引导(IPG)，用传输代替重加权，从Feynman-Kac PDE导出额外漂移项实现无权重粒子采样，缓解SMC的权重退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流模型在推理时引导可实现条件生成或满足特定属性，形式化为从奖励倾斜的生成先验中采样。精确采样不可行：引导方法有偏差；SMC虽无偏但存在权重退化和粒子坍缩。

Method: IPG用粒子间的传输替代重加权。粒子通过由Feynman-Kac PDE导出、用于抵消重加权项的额外漂移相互作用，保持无权重。将漂移选在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中，得到闭式解，计算成本低，相比SMC开销可忽略。

Result: 在已知后验的高斯混合模型、以及高维图像修复和蛋白质结构推断任务上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: IPG避免了SMC的权重退化和粒子坍缩，提供廉价且近似无额外开销的引导采样方案，适用于从低维到高维的实际任务。

Abstract: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.

</details>


### [480] [Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36063)
*Fatemeh Askari,Mazdak Teymourian,Mohammad Izadi,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过行为分析、表征探测与因果干预，系统揭示了AM、POMO与LEHD三类自回归NCO模型的内部决策机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NCO模型虽实证成功，但其内部决策机制尚未被充分探索，缺乏可解释性分析。

Method: 针对AM、POMO（重编码器-轻解码器）与LEHD（轻编码器-重解码器）三种模型，采用行为分析、表征探测与因果干预手段，在TSP和CVRP任务上展开研究。

Result: AM与POMO在解构造过程中遵循持续的几何模式；LEHD则包含多个未来动作的线性可及信息，因果实验证明未来节点表征对其决策的作用。LEHD强依赖当前节点表征做局部决策，起始节点表征发挥导航作用；跨实例对齐分析显示LEHD将当前节点表征映射到共享潜在区域。

Conclusion: 架构不同的求解器呈现不同的决策模式，为NCO求解器的可解释性分析奠定了基础。

Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.

</details>


### [481] [A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37344)
*Max Cairney-Leeming,Simone Bombari,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究零集中DP模型下数据重构攻击的隐私预算阈值，证明在ρ≈d处存在尖锐相变，且该阈值随有效维度s变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据重构攻击可恢复训练样本，DP虽提供形式化保护但预算选择困难：小预算损失效用，大预算难以量化是否允许准确重构，需明确安全阈值。

Method: 研究知悉其余训练数据的知情攻击者，从ρ-零集中DP模型中重构单个d维样本。对任意私有机制推导基于熵的下界（刻画不可重构的目标先验集），并分析输出扰动私有线性回归上的简单攻击。

Result: 在ρ≈d处发现尖锐相变：ρ≪d时重构信息论上不可能，ρ≫d时重构实际可行；当数据位于s维子空间时阈值变为ρ≈s，并在合成数据及CIFAR-10、ImageNet上验证。

Conclusion: 保证充分保护的隐私预算须按数据有效维度评估，而非固定维度d，阈值随有效维度s迁移。

Abstract: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $ρ$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $ρ\asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $ρ\ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $ρ\gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $ρ\asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).

</details>


### [482] [FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36064)
*Sahand Rezaei-Shoshtari,Patryk Wozniczka,Shu Ishida,Gregg Streuber,Farnoosh Javadi,Jeffrey Landes,Angela Ju,Muhammad Azam,Bryan Lim,Johan Luttun,Indrajeet Haldar,Jonathan Shaw,Beatriz Guerra,Ivan Sosnovik,James Stoddart,Robert Giaquinto,Adam Gaier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLOORA 是一族面向建筑平面布局生成的小型领域专用 DSL 模型，0.6B 版本超越大型前沿模型，取得高胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用基础模型难以处理工程领域所需的结构化表示，需要领域专用方案。

Method: 采用高效的 DSL、定制分词、领域预训练、SFT 以及结合人类偏好与可验证奖励的 RL 对齐。

Result: VLM 评判胜率达 92.0%（真实分布外建筑）和 96.0%（合成建筑），人工评估中 89.3% 被评为最佳模型。

Conclusion: 该方法提升了建筑与几何有效性，并可推广到其他具有结构化、可验证输出的工程领域。

Abstract: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. This pipeline improves architectural and geometric validity, supported by extensive empirical evaluation and ablation studies. Although focused on architecture, our results suggest that similar domain-specific recipes may be useful in other engineering domains with structured, verifiable outputs. Datasets, models, and inference code are available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/floora.

</details>


### [483] [High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37381)
*Lars Kühmichel,Stefan T. Radev,Bhanu Prasanna Koppolu,Masoumeh Davoudi,Jerry M. Huang,Paul-Christian Bürkner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将模拟推断(SBI)与潜变量生成建模结合，学习模拟器参数的低维表示，并在潜空间直接进行后验推断，再映射回原参数空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SBI的表示学习几乎只关注压缩观测，但随着参数空间维度不断升高，是否应压缩推断目标本身成为新问题。

Method: 学习模拟器参数的低维潜表示，在潜空间执行后验推断，再将后验样本映射回原参数空间；并理论分析潜空间推断恢复目标后验的条件。

Result: 在4个案例研究和3类生成模型中，控制网络容量、正则化、优化与训练算力后，潜空间推断在同等训练算力下精度与边际校准接近直接目标空间推断，采样快一个数量级以上。

Conclusion: 将SBI与潜变量生成建模合并是实用的方案，能在保证推断质量的同时显著加速高维参数空间中的采样。

Abstract: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.

</details>


### [484] [GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36074)
*Peng Xu,Nihar Koganti,Volodymyr Kindratenko,Xiaohui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GEM-KMeans，一种谱归一化但数学等价的NLR公式，通过将梯度更新、非负投影和统计量归一化融合进矩阵乘法epilogue，实现IO感知的GPU实现。仅需在HBM中保留单个因子矩阵，大幅降低显存占用，同时在大规模合成和真实数据集上保持准确聚类并取得性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模数据分析和机器学习中，聚类问题的内存高效扩展与统计精度同等重要。非负低秩(NLR)矩阵分解用于K-means是一种可扩展方法，具有最优平均情况精确恢复保证，但其GPU直接实现需要多个大型因子缓冲区和大量数据移动，本质上是内存受限的。

Method: 提出GEM-KMeans，一种谱归一化但数学等价的NLR公式，将梯度更新、非负投影以及用于归一化和迭代移动的充分统计量融合进矩阵乘法epilogue。采用IO感知的GPU实现，只在HBM中物化单个因子矩阵及小的tile-reduction数组，而非保留三个大型因子数组。推导了显式内存开销和谱归一化平滑性边界。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现了大规模准确聚类。GEM-KMeans相对现有GPU加速Lloyd算法表现出数据依赖的运行时间权衡，并带来性能增益。

Conclusion: 通过将NLR重构成谱归一化且等价的单因子形式并融合到matmul epilogue，可在不牺牲统计精度的前提下显著降低GPU显存占用，实现大规模高效聚类。

Abstract: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. Instead of retaining three massive factor-sized arrays, our IO-aware GPU implementation materializes only one single factor with small tile-reduction arrays as additional storage in the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). We derive explicit memory costs and spectrally normalized smoothness bounds for optimizing the clustering objective function. Accurate clustering is demonstrated at massive scales on synthetic and real datasets, where performance gains of GEM-KMeans over existing GPU-accelerated Lloyd's algorithms involve data-dependent runtime tradeoffs.

</details>


### [485] [Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36081)
*Yuantao Deng,Jinnuo Liu,Kaizhen Tan,Yuchen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现神经网络早期表示漂移形成一个低维子空间（scaffold），后续学习会持续复用它，且这种复用依赖学习历史。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究早期表示变化是否自然形成几何结构，并持续影响后续任务学习。

Method: 在四种预训练视觉编码器和两个数据集上，识别早期表示漂移的低维子空间（scaffold），并与随机匹配的替代子空间比较，分析其在后续任务中的复用及历史依赖性。

Result: 后续表示变化持续偏好早期定义的子空间；复用具有历史依赖性；优化器单步更新也表现出相同偏好；限制scaffold内运动会更慢地学习新任务，而对旧任务保持影响不一致。

Conclusion: 早期经验在网络适应未来任务的方式上留下持久的几何印记。

Abstract: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.

</details>


### [486] [Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37470)
*Han Chen,Yingrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"概率契约"基准，连接有限世界后验、事件变换与失败感知决策评估，在1000个世界上评估四种模型接口配置，揭示准确率、一致性与决策损失之间的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一决策所用的概率在等价请求间应指向同一事件，但一致性常被误当作准确率、分数提升被误当作决策保证。需要一个可测量的基准来区分这些维度。

Method: 构建概率契约基准，涵盖精确的有限世界后验、经校验的事件变换和失败感知的决策评估；在1000个世界上比较四种模型-接口配置，并做动作区域刻画分析与事后分歧分析。

Result: Kev的总体规范后验误差低于Jev，但补集与粗化残差更大，准确率排序随分层变化；在延迟成本0.10时，Jev的事件与选择接口在32.8%的有效对上产生不同二元动作；分歧仅证实11-52%的平均二元对误差。平均化不会恶化随机选择单一接口基线的期望Brier分数，其决策效果取决于成本与越界情况，观察到的惩罚出现在本就不如始终延迟的配置中。

Conclusion: 该基准使一致性、准确率与决策损失之间的区别可被测量，强调不应将一致性等同于准确率，也不应将分数改善视为决策保证。

Abstract: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.

</details>


### [487] [PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36087)
*Yipeng Zhang,Chenda Duan,Yuanyi Ding,Tianyi Wang,Atsuro Daida,Masaki Izumi,Yuta Tanoue,Naoto Kuroda,Shaun A. Hussain,Nishant Sinha,Eishi Asano. Hiroki Nariai,Vwani Roychowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PHASE 是一种生理学引导的 iEEG 基础模型，通过将生理特征作为显式学习目标并配对掩码潜在预测，在多项临床任务上超越现有基础模型和任务专用模型，并展现出跨机构泛化与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 iEEG 基础模型多通过重建或预测输入进行学习，生理特征保留是隐式的；评估也主要局限于认知解码和狭窄的癫痫检测任务。在 Omni-iEEG 等临床基准上，冻结的基础模型仍不如任务专用模型。

Method: 提出 PHASE，将临床可识别的生理特征作为显式学习目标，与掩码潜在预测结合。包含两个阶段：通道内的时间阶段 PHASE-T，以及跨同步通道的时空阶段 PHASE-ST。在来自 9 个临床站点、222 名参与者的异质记录上预训练。

Result: 在 Omni-iEEG 全部五个临床任务上，冻结 PHASE-T 比所有评估的基础模型高出最多 31%，微调后超越任务专用模型达到新 SOTA。消融显示生理监督优于单独潜在预测或波形重建。PHASE-T 可泛化到未见机构，在少标签或无本地标签时表现更好。PHASE-ST 进一步提升癫痫起始区识别，并在 BrainTreebank 上冻结解码音量与音高优于已发表模型。

Conclusion: PHASE 学会了封装临床医生可识别的生理特征，从癫痫起始与传播到解剖区域身份，尽管预训练不含发作期记录或解剖标签，表明显式生理监督有助于构建可泛化、可解释的 iEEG 基础模型。

Abstract: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.

</details>


### [488] [Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37525)
*Yuren Hao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Physical Muon优化器，将Newton-Schulz正交化替换为连续时间流的平衡态，用随机探针以矩阵-向量乘、倒数读取和局部秩1写入近似，实现物理可实现的Transformer训练，性能接近原版。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理神经网络和模拟存内计算可降低训练能耗，但需要兼顾有效学习与物理可实现性的优化器。SGD适合局部模拟更新但在Transformer上表现差，Adam对模拟偏置不稳定，Muon性能强但依赖稠密矩阵乘法的Newton-Schulz正交化。

Method: 提出Physical Muon，将正交化视为连续时间流的平衡态；用随机探针通过矩阵-向量乘积、倒数读取和局部秩1写入来近似该流，从而避免稠密矩阵-矩阵乘法。

Result: 在10.95M参数Transformer上评估：稠密流的平均验证交叉熵比Newton-Schulz高0.0085（每方法9个种子）；探针实现比对照组高0.0188（2个种子）。电路仿真重现了流动态并产生可比的训练行为。

Conclusion: Physical Muon用物理可实现的局部操作近似正交化，在保持接近原方法训练性能的同时，适配模拟硬件约束，为节能训练提供可行方案。

Abstract: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.

</details>


### [489] [Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36099)
*Aleksei Leonov,Nikita Kornilov,Zhenhe Zhang,Evgeny Burnaev,Iaroslav Koshelev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IDU：首个统一框架，同时实现多步匹配模型（流匹配/扩散）的一步蒸馏与遗忘集去学习，仅需预训练教师模型和遗忘集数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步匹配模型（flow/diffusion）生成质量高，但推理成本大，且可能复现训练集中不希望出现的成分。现有工作通常将蒸馏与去学习分开处理。

Method: 将蒸馏形式化为数据分布上的min-max目标；把该分布表示为遗忘集与生成分布的混合，通过将混合与教师训练分布对比，在最优解处仅恢复保留数据。仅需预训练全数据教师和遗忘集数据，无需保留样本、特征提取器或分类器。

Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，flow-matching与score-based diffusion设置下，IDU显著降低遗忘类别的生成频率，同时保持保留类别的生成质量。

Conclusion: IDU是无条件flow-matching与score-based模型中首个同时进行去学习与蒸馏的统一框架。

Abstract: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.

</details>


### [490] [Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37535)
*Sangsidhya Kar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: \u672c\u6587\u5206\u6790\u9002\u5e94\u6027\u4f18\u5316\u5668\uff08Adam/RMSProp/Lion/sign descent\uff09\u5bf9\u7a00\u6709 token \u7684\u8bad\u7ec3\u504f\u7f6e\uff0c\u4ece\u8f93\u51fa\u5c42\u5747\u503c\u4e0e\u5355 token \u4e24\u4e2a\u5c42\u9762\u63a8\u5bfc\u504f\u7f6e\u516c\u5f0f\uff0c\u5e76\u5728 unigram \u4e0e\u5c0f\u578b\u8bed\u8a00\u6a21\u578b\u4e0a\u9a8c\u8bc1\u3002


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: \u7a00\u6709 token \u5728\u5927\u591a\u6570\u6b65\u4e0a\u53ea\u6536\u5230\u5c0f\u7684\u6b63 logit \u68af\u5ea6\uff0c\u800c\u5728\u5b83\u4f5c\u4e3a\u76ee\u6807\u7684\u5c11\u6570\u6b65\u4e0a\u6536\u5230\u5927\u7684\u8d1f\u68af\u5ea6\u3002SGD \u76f4\u63a5\u76f8\u52a0\uff0c\u4f46 Adam/RMSProp/sign descent \u7b49\u5750\u6807\u81ea\u9002\u5e94\u65b9\u6cd5\u4f1a\u7528\u8fd0\u884c\u4f30\u8ba1\u503c\u5bf9\u6bcf\u4e2a\u66f4\u65b0\u91cf\u505a\u5f52\u4e00\u5316\uff0c\u800c\u8be5\u4f30\u8ba1\u503c\u5728 token \u521a\u51fa\u73b0\u540e\u6700\u5927\uff0c\u5bfc\u81f4\u66f4\u65b0\u5931\u8861\uff0c\u8fdb\u800c\u5f15\u5165\u8bad\u7ec3\u504f\u7f6e\u3002

Method: \u5206\u4e24\u4e2a\u5c42\u9762\u5206\u6790\uff1a\uff081\uff09\u8f93\u51fa\u5c42\u6574\u4f53\uff1a\u523b\u753b\u54ea\u4e9b\u4f18\u5316\u5668\u4fdd\u6301\u5e73\u5747\u8f93\u51fa\u5d4c\u5165\uff08\u5bf9\u8fc7\u53bb\u68af\u5ea6\u7ebf\u6027\u7684\u65b9\u6cd5\u3001Shampoo\u3001Muon \u4fdd\u6301\uff1bAdam/Adafactor/Lion/sign descent \u4e0d\u4fdd\u6301\uff0c\u5e76\u7ed9\u51fa\u9010\u6b65\u53d8\u5316\u7684\u7cbe\u786e\u8868\u8fbe\u5f0f\uff09\uff1b\uff082\uff09\u5355\u4e2a\u7a00\u6709 token\uff1a\u5728 unigram \u6a21\u578b\u4e2d\u63a8\u5bfc\u8bad\u7ec3\u4e0d\u52a8\u70b9\u7684\u504f\u79fb\uff0csign descent \u5bf9\u51fa\u73b0\u4e8e\u5c11\u4e8e\u4e00\u534a minibatch \u7684 token \u4ee5\u6052\u5b9a\u901f\u7387\u964d\u4f4e logit\uff1b\u5bf9\u5468\u671f\u5230\u8fbe\u7684 RMSProp \u7ed9\u51fa\u95ed\u5f0f\u4e0d\u52a8\u70b9\u89e3\uff08token \u7f3a\u5e2d\u81f3\u5c11\u4e24\u4e2a\u8fde\u7eed minibatch \u65f6\u5e73\u8861\u6982\u7387\u4e25\u683c\u4f4e\u4e8e\u6570\u636e\u9891\u7387\uff0c\u6bd4\u503c\u8d8b\u4e8e \u03ba/(2(e^{\u03ba/2}-1))\uff09\uff1bSG D \u4e0e AMSGrad \u4fdd\u6301\u65e0\u504f\u4e0d\u52a8\u70b9\u3002

Result: \u5728 unigram \u6a21\u578b\u548c\u4ece\u5df2\u77e5\u751f\u6210\u5206\u5e03\u8bad\u7ec3\u7684\u5c0f\u578b\u8bed\u8a00\u6a21\u578b\u4e0a\u9a8c\u8bc1\u4e86\u9884\u6d4b\uff1a\u968f\u673a\u5230\u8fbe\u65f6\u504f\u7f6e\u6bd4\u5468\u671f\u516c\u5f0f\u9884\u6d4b\u66f4\u5927\uff1b\u8bed\u8a00\u6a21\u578b\u4e2d\u5e26\u504f\u7f6e\u4e0d\u52a8\u70b9\u7684\u4f18\u5316\u5668\u5bf9\u751f\u6210\u5206\u5e03\u62df\u5408\u5f97\u66f4\u5dee\u3002

Conclusion: \u5750\u6807\u81ea\u9002\u5e94\u4f18\u5316\u5668\u7684\u5f52\u4e00\u5316\u4f1a\u5728\u8bad\u7ec3\u4e2d\u5f15\u5165\u7cfb\u7edf\u6027\u504f\u7f6e\uff1a\u538b\u4f4e\u7a00\u6709 token \u7684\u6982\u7387\uff0c\u4f7f\u6a21\u578b\u504f\u79bb\u771f\u5b9e\u6570\u636e\u5206\u5e03\uff0c\u800c SGD/AMSGrad \u7b49\u4fdd\u6301\u65e0\u504f\u3002

Abstract: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))$. Here $κ$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-β_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.

</details>


### [491] [LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36108)
*Amir Rezaei Balef,Katharina Eggensperger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LoopICL，一种循环式Transformer表格基础模型，通过单块循环设计将参数量与计算深度解耦，在同等计算量下以少近90%参数达到与TabICLv2相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于上下文学习的表格基础模型虽超越了梯度提升树，但其参数被证明大体冗余，存在参数效率低的问题。

Method: LoopICL采用单一块，处理两个耦合流：捕捉逐单元格特征表示的cell stream和捕捉上下文样例表示的row stream，通过列内与跨列注意力联合精炼。预训练时变化循环次数，测试时可展开不同迭代次数并用学习到的exit-gate自动退出。

Result: 标准设置下，在相同计算成本(FLOPs)下，LoopICL在TabArena和TALENT上与TabICLv2性能相当，同时参数减少近90%。

Conclusion: 其循环设计使用户可在推理成本与性能间权衡，提供了资源感知的表格基础模型。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer parameters. Furthermore, its recurrent design enables users to also trade off inference cost and performance, providing a resource-aware TFM.

</details>


### [492] [Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36115)
*Shenghong Dai,Shiva Kumar Pentyala,Yingchi Liu,Shubham Mehrotra,Suman Banerjee,James Zhu,Bin Bi,Sitaram Asur,Phil Mui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Koa-action 将分类等原子任务形式化为单 token 约束生成，通过引入原子标签 token 与监督微调，实现低延迟高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业应用需要低延迟分类，但 LLM 生成冗长、逐 token 解码慢，而编码器模型虽快却缺乏任务灵活性。

Method: 提出 Koa-action 框架，将分类、语义端点检测、布尔判断、评分等原子动作建模为单 token 输出的约束生成；引入原子标签 token 并做监督微调，把分类简化为确定性的单步解码。

Result: 标准基准上精度有竞争力且延迟低而稳定；生产意图路由基准达 85.5% 精度，与最强前沿模型相当，优于 GPT-5 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro，中位延迟快达约 7.5 倍；相较单 token 系统 Jev/TypeSafe 精度相当、中位更快，且支持多模态与多标签输出。

Conclusion: Koa-action 证明单步单 token 解码可在保持竞争力的同时大幅降低延迟，兼顾灵活性与速度，适用于延迟敏感的工业场景。

Abstract: Industry applications often demand low-latency classification, yet current large language model (LLM) approaches remain poorly suited for latency-critical applications. Existing prompting and constrained decoding produce verbose, multi-token outputs that require expensive token-by-token generation, while encoder-based models achieve faster inference but sacrifice task flexibility. We propose Koa-action, a framework for low-latency atomic actions -- fast, single-step decisions such as classification, semantic endpointing, Boolean checks, and scoring -- formulated as constrained generation with single-token outputs. By introducing atomic label tokens and applying supervised fine-tuning, our method reduces classification to a deterministic one-step decoding problem. Across standard benchmarks, Koa-action delivers competitive accuracy with consistently low and stable latency. On a production intent-routing benchmark, Koa-action reaches 85.5% accuracy -- competitive with the strongest frontier models (Claude-4.8-Opus, Gemini-Pro-3.1) and ahead of GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro -- while answering in about half a second, several-fold faster than every frontier model (up to ~7.5x at the median) under identical serving conditions. Against the dedicated single-token system Jev/TypeSafe, Koa-action is competitive on accuracy and faster at the median, while also handling multimodal inputs and multi-label outputs that single-label text systems do not.

</details>


### [493] [Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36660)
*Leonardo F. Toso,James Anderson,Rafael Pinot,Nirupam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在联邦学习中采用表示学习（个性化线性头+拜占庭鲁棒聚合的共享非线性表示），以消除模型异质性偏差并提升对抗鲁棒性，并给出无不可约偏差的非渐近误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在客户端异质且存在对抗（Byzantine）客户端时，单一共享模型无法刻画各客户端不同的数据生成过程，产生不可约的模型异质性偏差，严重削弱鲁棒性。

Method: 表示学习框架：每个客户端学习个性化线性头，协作估计共享非线性表示，并用拜占庭鲁棒聚合；分析诚实客户端表示梯度的异质性，推广到多分类。

Result: 非渐近参数恢复误差界含三项：依赖初始化的误差（随T消失）、随样本数和诚实客户端数下降的有限样本噪声项、随T下降的随机梯度方差项；无不可约模型异质性偏差，并在CIFAR-10、FEMNIST、School Exam Score上验证。

Conclusion: 表示学习能消除模型异质性偏差，实现可随数据量与迭代数收敛的拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习。

Abstract: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

</details>


### [494] [RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37633)
*Michael Kirchhof,Eleonora Gualdoni,Andrew Szot,Khashayar Gatmiry,Aryo Lotfi,Abbas Kazerouni,Omar Attia,Sanjoy Chowdhury,Alexander Toshev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RLTL;DR：让策略在失败后根据验证器输出自写TL;DR洞察，将洞察加入上下文并回传来内化"任务→洞察"映射，在Pass@128=0的困难任务上突破学习瓶颈，并可用SFTL;DR以极少数据复现效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RLVR依赖多次尝试中成功样本做优化，但在自我改进场景下任务极难、成功率近乎为零，且没有教师模型或示例解可蒸馏，导致训练信号缺失、学习停滞。

Method: RLTL;DR：每次失败后将验证器输出展示给策略，令其自写一条TL;DR洞察；后续rollout以所有历史洞察为条件，顺序采样直到找到解；同时对上下文中的洞察做反向传播以内化任务到洞察的直接映射。进一步简化为SFTL;DR，仅用(task, insight)元组做监督训练，不展示也不回传rollout。

Result: 在工具调用与编程难数据集（Pass@128=0）上，Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking用标准GRPO训练Pass@1停在0%–1%；RLTL;DR训练时带洞察达14–31%，评测时无洞察上下文仍达12–13%。仅用4k条(task, insight)元组的SFTL;DR几乎恢复RLTL;DR与全rollout SFT的性能。

Conclusion: 关键在于"任务到洞察"的内化；本文提出一种紧凑训练范式——"面对这类任务，记住这类要点"，为未来自我改进研究提供新方向。

Abstract: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

</details>


### [495] [Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36116)
*Yundaichuan Zhan,Weishi Wang,Wenbiao Liu,Daniel Dahlmeier,Chengwei Qin,Juncheng Li,Fredrik D. Johansson,Zhongqi Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Dyad 架构，通过为预训练 LLM 增加类型化决策能力构建通用智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让 LLM 具备原生类型化决策能力，以构建更强的通用智能体。

Method: 在预训练 LLM 上加入环境条件化的动作编码器，将候选动作描述并行嵌入，并与 LLM 内部状态打分得到类型化动作分布；分解决策为交互状态表示与环境动作语义，保持动作空间扩展下的高效评分；研究冻结 LLM 仅训练编码器与联合优化两种 RL 设置。

Result: 冻结 LLM 仅训练动作编码器即可在四个未见环境稳定提升；联合优化在多种交互任务和模型规模上超过常规 RL 后训练，9B 模型在 ALFWorld 上平均绝对提升 3.80%，并改善通用知识、推理与编程能力。

Conclusion: Dyad 通过类型化动作决策与模块化/联合 RL 训练，有效提升 LLM 作为通用智能体的交互能力且兼具迁移与效率优势。

Abstract: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. With the LLM frozen, training the action encoder alone achieves consistent gains across four unseen environments, enabling modular adaptation without modifying any LLM parameters. Jointly optimizing both components outperforms conventional RL post-training across diverse interactive tasks and model scales, including a 3.80% average absolute gain on ALFWorld with a 9B model, while improving general knowledge, reasoning, and coding.

</details>


### [496] [Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36668)
*Jiawei Zhang,Qitan Shi,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为随机重球法(SHB)搭配Polyak步长(PS)与Armijo线搜索(ALS)建立了统一的收敛性分析，弱化了现有理论条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PS与ALS在随机优化中表现优异，但针对随机重球法(SHB)的收敛理论仍很有限，缺乏统一且条件宽松的分析。

Method: 提出与Polyak步长紧密对应的改进Armijo规则，并引入解耦分析以隔离动量带来的历史依赖；对标准PS与ALS下的SHB进行收敛分析。

Result: 在强凸、凸、非凸目标下（无需插值或对动量参数的限制）建立期望收敛；在插值或强增长条件下强化为几乎必然速率与最后迭代收敛；对递减变体证明几乎必然收敛到精确最优或稳定点。

Conclusion: 为SHB的Polyak步长与Armijo线搜索提供了更全面的理论视角。

Abstract: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

</details>


### [497] [Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37841)
*Ryotaro Kawata,Satoshi Hayakawa,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在隐藏森林依赖结构下，掩码生成模型能否以总评估数亚线性（关于序列长度 N）完成精确并行采样，并提出达到该目标的采样器及下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码生成模型可并行预测 token，但准确并行采样需处理 token 间依赖；依赖未知时，寻找安全批次本身也消耗模型评估。论文关注总评估数（含依赖发现）能否关于 N 亚线性。

Method: 针对具有隐藏森林结构的离散分布，通过固定近似条件 oracle 访问；在显式正则条件与一致 Hellinger 误差界下设计采样器，跨依赖测试共享"假设揭示"评估以识别安全并行批次，无需完整恢复隐藏森林；并用可调参数权衡探测成本与不可逆提交轮数。

Result: 对任意固定目标精度 ε∈(0,1/8] 且 N 足够大，采样器实现种子平均 TV 误差 ≤ ε，总掩码状态提交数与顺序深度均为 O(N^C ε^a)（0<C<1, a>0）。同时在同类问题中，任何可采纳的不可逆乘积提交采样器要达到相同精度，最坏情况下需 Ω(N^c ε^b) 次反事实提交或提交轮数（c,b>0）。

Conclusion: 证明在隐藏森林依赖下，总评估可关于 N 亚线性（顺序深度亦亚线性），并给出匹配下界，表明不可逆并行提交采样存在固有代价。

Abstract: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.

</details>


### [498] [Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36117)
*Issam Seddik,Mohamed El Amine Seddik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对二次神经元在高斯混合数据上的投毒后门攻击进行精确闭式分析，揭示了特征学习动态如何使神经网络更易受后门攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要对抗后门攻击的对抗预算（投毒比例π与触发器强度α）的原理性估计；并解释大模型投毒所需恶意样本近乎恒定的经验现象。

Method: 对在高斯混合数据上训练的二次神经元进行精确闭式分析，比较懒惰学习与特征学习两种机制下的攻击需求。

Result: 保持干净精度至一阶O(π)时：懒惰学习要求α∝π^{-1/2}；特征学习产生二次检测器，损失间隔为O(α^4)，将攻击预算改善为α∝π^{-1/4}。非线性特征学习显著降低小投毒比例下所需触发器强度。

Conclusion: 特征学习在某种意义上使网络更易受后门攻击；基于线性启发式的安全审计会系统性低估特征学习机制下的后门脆弱性。

Abstract: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.

</details>


### [499] [Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37917)
*Rares Dimitrie Grozavescu,Mark Girolami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 投影追踪在高斯补空间下会被无信号方向"欺骗"，样本分裂不能修复；限制搜索空间到已知前向算子列空间可精确消除该失效，主成分估计则呈现不同收缩速率，实验阈值比约为 n/p² 的 0.156 次幂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影追踪寻找最非高斯方向，但当观测空间含大高斯补集时，经验目标可由无信号方向最小化，其经验峰度可低至真值水平，导致方法失效，需要理解并修正这一问题。

Method: 分析样本分裂失效机制；将搜索限制在已知前向算子的列空间；并与基于数据估计主子空间的方法对比。在受控双分量模型中比较协方差尖峰估计与四阶矩搜索的充分缩放增益，并用实验测量阈值比与指数。

Result: 负峰度分支上限制搜索空间可精确消除失效；样本分裂无效。缩放增益中协方差尖峰估计为 ς⁻⁴，四阶矩搜索为 ς⁻⁸。固定搜索维度下阈值比随 n/p² 幂律变化，实测指数 0.156，接近预测 1/8；搜索维度变化时实测指数 0.325，远大于 1/8；下游超额误差准则下缩放基本消失。

Conclusion: 该缩放关系由充分性界启发并经实验支持，并非已证明的渐近紧致律；交叉位置依赖校准与模型配置，搜索维度变化时函数形式尚不明确。

Abstract: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged. Restricting the search to the column space of a known forward operator removes the failure exactly on the negative-kurtosis branch. Estimating a principal subspace from the data is the alternative. In a controlled two-component model, the leading sufficient scalings differ in the gain with which the operator transmits the discriminant: $ς^{-4}$ for covariance-spike estimation and $ς^{-8}$ for fourth-moment search. At fixed search dimension, the measured threshold ratio collapses onto $n/p^2$ with exponent $0.156$, close to the predicted $1/8$. This is an empirically supported scaling motivated by sufficient bounds, not a proved asymptotically tight law. When the search dimension is varied, the measured exponent is $0.325$, substantially larger than $1/8$, and the tested range does not identify its functional form. The crossing location also depends on calibration and model configuration. Under a downstream excess-error criterion, the scaling largely disappears.

</details>


### [500] [ThinQuant: Scalable Rotation Learning for Weight and Activation Quantization of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36120)
*Mehdi Makni,Ryan Lucas,Rahul Mazumder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ThinQuant通过数据选择与降维优化，显著提升低比特量化中旋转学习的效率，实现大模型快速校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有旋转学习方法（如SpinQuant、DartQuant）难以扩展到超大规模模型，计算瓶颈严重。

Method: 基于激活凸包几何结构选择少量校准数据；将d×d旋转优化等价为d×r矩阵的Stiefel流形优化，并用高效ADMM算法求解。

Result: Llama-3-70B W4A4KV4校准<12分钟，WikiText-2困惑度5.63（DartQuant为7.55/111分钟）；Llama-3.1-405B单H200 GPU上<2小时，W4A4困惑度2.97（GPTAQ+QuaRoT为3.48）。

Conclusion: ThinQuant在极低数据量下匹配或超越SOTA，并大幅降低计算成本，可扩展至最大模型。

Abstract: Learned rotations play an important role in enabling low-bit weight and activation quantization of large language models by smoothing outliers in the activation distribution. State-of-the-art approaches include gradient-based procedures such as SpinQuant and computationally friendlier gradient-free approaches such as DartQuant, but both remain hard to scale to the largest architectures. To address the computational bottlenecks in gradient-free rotation learning, we introduce two ideas for efficiency, (i) a data selection procedure which reduces the required number of calibration data points, and (ii) an exact reduction of the associated optimization on this reduced calibration set. Our data selection procedure exploits the geometric structure of the convex hull of the activations. Using this idea, we show that a carefully selected calibration set with several orders of magnitude fewer activations than state-of-the-art rotation-based methods can match their performance in low-bit quantization settings. Under this extreme data efficiency, the selected activations span an $r$-dimensional subspace with $r<d$, making optimization over a $d\times d$ rotation equivalent to optimizing a $d\times r$ matrix on the Stiefel manifold. We solve this reduced problem using an efficient ADMM algorithm that iteratively employs thin matrix updates at every step, hence the name ThinQuant. For Llama-3-70B with W4A4KV4 quantization, ThinQuant completes the entire rotation calibration in under 12 minutes and achieves a WikiText-2 perplexity of 5.63, compared with 7.55 for DartQuant, which requires 111 minutes. Unlike SpinQuant and DartQuant, ThinQuant also scales to Llama-3.1-405B on a single H200 GPU, completing rotation calibration in just over 2 hours and achieving WikiText-2 perplexity of 2.97 at W4A4, compared with 3.48 for GPTAQ+QuaRoT.

</details>


### [501] [Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36945)
*Zhiwei Wang,Yanxi Chen,Yaliang Li,Bolin Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为"每隔S步更新一次rollout分布"的RE(S)方法建立统一理论，揭示其对S≥1全谱系的收敛性质，并发现off-policy性在某些情况下反而有利。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: policy gradient理论通常强调on-policy采样（小S）对成功至关重要，但在大语言模型后训练等应用中，即使rollout分布更新不频繁（大S）的reward-guided self-training依然有效，这种off-policy方法的收敛性质缺乏理论理解。

Method: 作者为RE(S)建立统一理论，将其解释为分阶段优化过程：每个阶段固定一个reward-weighted rollout分布，执行S步梯度以最小化到该分布的KL距离。针对softmax策略的多臂老虎机进行深入分析与数值实验。

Result: (1) 对任意固定S，当rollout更新次数B=⌊T/S⌋→∞时RE(S)全局收敛到最优策略；(2) 证明紧的两侧界，次优间隙达到渐近Θ(1/T)收敛率，而S仅影响burn-in阶段长度；(3) 当以弱策略初始化（最优动作概率小）时，RE(1)会长时间陷入次优策略，而合适S的RE(S)可避开该绕路并显著更快收敛到全局最优。

Conclusion: off-policy性（较大的S）在弱策略初始化等情况下具有明确优势，RE(S)在S≥1全谱系上均能全局收敛且保持Θ(1/T)的速度，S只影响burn-in长度。

Abstract: We study the learning dynamics of fine-tuning a policy model on self-generated and reward-weighted data, with particular focus on a generalized version of REINFORCE -- referred to as RE(S) -- that updates the rollout distribution once every $S \ge 1$ gradient steps. Prior work in bandits and reinforcement learning has developed rich theory for policy gradient methods, and on-policy sampling (i.e., a small $S$, ideally $1$) is often viewed as crucial to their success; yet in prominent application like post-training large language models, reward-guided self-training has proved to be effective even when the rollout distribution is updated infrequently, but theoretical understanding remains limited for the convergence properties of these off-policy methods. To bridge these gaps, we develop a unified theory for RE(S) that covers the full spectrum of $S \ge 1$: it can be interpreted as a stage-wise optimization process, where each stage takes $S$ gradient steps for minimizing the Kullback-Leibler distance to a fixed reward-weighted rollout distribution. For multi-arm bandits with softmax policies, our in-depth analysis and numerical experiments reveal three key findings: (1) for any fixed $S$, RE(S) enjoys global convergence to the optimal policy as the number of rollout distribution updates $B = \lfloor T / S \rfloor \rightarrow \infty$, where $T$ denotes the number of gradient steps; (2) we prove tight two-sided bounds showing that the suboptimality gap of RE(S) achieves an asymptotic $Θ(1 / T)$ convergence rate, while $S$ only affects the length of a burn-in phase; (3) when initialized at a weak policy with a small optimal-action probability, RE(1) gets trapped around suboptimal policies for a long period, whereas RE(S) with a suitable $S$ avoids the detour and achieves significantly faster convergence to the global optimum, highlighting the benefits of off-policyness in this case.

</details>


### [502] [When do data mixtures improve scaling laws? Insights from high-dimensional regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38011)
*Diyuan Wu,Lehan Chen,Theodor Misiakiewicz,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究混合数据回归的极小极大风险与岭回归测试误差，刻画何时辅助数据能真正改善缩放律而非仅增加样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代ML系统在不同领域数据混合上训练，数据混合可提升性能，但现有工作多为经验性，不清楚辅助数据何时能改善缩放律而非仅提供更多样本。

Method: 研究高维混合数据回归模型：共享回归函数、异质协方差与噪声、数据集大小可不同速率增长。在椭球参数约束下建立一般协方差的极小极大风险，对可交换协方差导出岭回归测试误差的确定性等价，并特化到具有对齐幂律协方差谱的目标域与辅助域。

Result: 得到显式缩放律，揭示在特定谱衰减、目标正则性与两数据集相对增长条件下，混合数据可证明地获得比单用任一数据集更快的缩放率；改善缩放律需要谱与相对样本量的特定配合。LM数值实验呈现相同定性现象。

Conclusion: 混合数据改善缩放律并非普遍成立，而取决于谱结构与相对样本量的交互；理论预测与语言模型实验一致。

Abstract: Modern machine learning systems are trained on mixtures of data from different domains, and choosing the right mixture can substantially improve downstream performance. Despite an extensive literature on data mixing and reweighting, existing work is largely empirical and it remains unclear when auxiliary data genuinely improves scaling laws rather than merely providing more samples. To gain insight into this question, we study a high-dimensional mixed-data regression model with a shared regression function, heterogeneous covariances and noise levels, and dataset sizes that may grow at different rates. We establish the minimax risk under an ellipsoidal parameter constraint for the general covariance structure and derive deterministic equivalents for the test error of ridge regression under commutative covariances. We then specialize to a target domain and an auxiliary domain with aligned power-law covariance spectra, where the theory yields explicit scaling laws in terms of spectral decay, target regularity, and the relative growth of the two datasets. These laws identify regimes in which combining data mixtures provably yields a faster scaling rate than using either dataset alone. In particular, improving the scaling law requires a specific interplay between spectra and relative sample sizes of the domains. Our numerical experiments on language models exhibit the same qualitative phenomenon: appropriate data mixtures yield a faster decrease in target-domain test loss than training on either domain alone.

</details>


### [503] [Reasoning with Neural Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36126)
*Mayalen Etcheverry,Pietro Miotti,Aidan Sirbu,Konstantin Schürholt,Mariia Drozdova,Arna Ghosh,Blaise Agüera y Arcas,James Manyika,Blake Richards,Eyvind Niklasson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明神经细胞自动机(NCA)——仅用局部连接和异步更新的循环单元网络——能够在迷宫、数独和ARC-AGI-1等复杂视觉推理任务中产生有效的时空动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI视觉推理架构依赖全局连接与同步，而生物系统表明复杂计算可在更分散的方式下完成。NCA虽在人工生命中被广泛研究，但其能否进行复杂多步推理尚不清楚。

Method: 采用严格局部连接、异步更新的神经细胞自动机(NCA)进行多步视觉推理；结合样本回放与随机扰动进行训练，并在测试时保留随机性。

Result: NCA成功求解大迷宫、数独及ARC-AGI-1任务；在更大网格、更长rollout或并行试验下实现分布外泛化，且并行试验可经轨迹剪枝提高效率；具备动态调节计算以从损伤中恢复的鲁棒性，并可扩展到原始像素空间的推理。

Conclusion: NCA是具备鲁棒推理能力的分散式架构，其泛化能力依赖样本回放与随机扰动，测试时随机性仍有收益，并可扩展至原始像素推理。

Abstract: Modern AI architectures used to solve visual reasoning tasks typically rely heavily on global connectivity and synchronization. As biological systems demonstrate, though, sophisticated computation can be performed in a more decentralized fashion. In this work, we test the reasoning capabilities of Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), networks of recurrent cells that use strictly local connectivity and asynchronous updates. NCAs have been extensively studied in artificial life experiments, but it is unclear whether they can perform complex multi-step reasoning. We show that NCAs produce spatio-temporal dynamics capable of solving challenging visual reasoning tasks, including large mazes, Sudoku, and ARC-AGI-1. Furthermore, we provide evidence that NCAs generalize out-of-distribution when running with larger grids, longer rollouts, or parallel trials; and that the latter can be made more efficient via pruning of redundant trajectories. We find that these generalization capabilities depend on training with sample replay and stochastic perturbations, and that stochasticity remains beneficial at test time. Finally, we show that NCAs are robust reasoners capable of dynamically modulating compute to recover efficiently from damage, and that they can scale to solve reasoning in raw pixel space.

</details>


### [504] [Traversing the solution space of neural networks with Hessian Null Space Continuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38081)
*Ann Huang,Mitchell Ostrow,Zhouyang Lu,William T. Redman,Leo Kozachkov,Kanaka Rajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC) 方法，首次证明单个 mode-connected 区域内可存在大量不同的内部表征与计算机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两个子领域此前割裂：一是权重空间中解由低损失区域连通（mode connectivity），二是神经网络存在表征简并（不同内部结构达到相似损失）。但表征多样性如何分布于权重空间局部区域尚不清楚，本文旨在统一二者。

Method: HNC 利用局部曲率（Hessian 零空间）在保持网络功能不变的权重空间区域中导航，并可被导向具有指定属性的解，具备可扩展性。

Result: 在记忆任务 RNN 中找到行为一致但表征与动力学迥异的解；在 ImageNet ViT 中找到比任何独立训练模型差异更大的表征；在 RL 智能体中发现可比回报下的不同导航策略并暴露奖励黑客行为；并量化了模型规模与任务复杂度对解集维度及功能敏感性的影响。

Conclusion: 单个已训练解附近存在远超梯度优化所能触及的巨大表征多样性，HNC 可识别与量化该多样性，为解空间的机制理解及模型合并、编辑、微调提供新途径。

Abstract: On a single task, deep networks can learn many solutions, depending on their optimizer, training data, architecture, and hyperparameters. Many of these solutions are mode-connected: rather than isolated points in weight space, they are connected by low-loss regions. Yet how their internal computation varies within these regions is unknown. A parallel line of work has identified the degeneracy of neural representations: many networks reach similar training loss with distinct internal structures. However, it is unclear how these solutions are related in weight space. We unify these subfields and show for the first time that many different internal mechanisms exist within a local mode-connected region in weight space. To do so, we introduce Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC), a scalable method that uses local curvature to traverse regions of weight space that preserve network function, and can be steered toward solutions with specified properties. In RNNs trained on a memory task, HNC reaches drastically different representations and dynamics with maintained behavior. In ImageNet-trained Vision Transformers, HNC finds representations that differ more from the original network than any independently trained model with a different architecture or objective. In reinforcement-learning agents, HNC uncovers a distinct navigation strategy at comparable return and exposes reward hacking in an AI Safety Gridworld. Finally, HNC measures the local geometry of the solution set, showing how model size and task complexity shape its dimension and functional sensitivity. Our results show that a surprisingly large amount of representational diversity exists near a single trained solution, unseen by standard gradient-based optimization. HNC identifies and quantifies this diversity, opening new possibilities for mechanistic understanding of solution spaces and for model merging, editing, and fine-tuning.

</details>


### [505] [Learning Continuous Patient Trajectories from Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36144)
*Silas Ruhrberg Estévez,Kara Liu,Christopher Chiu,Benjamin Atta Owusu,Umesh Kadam,Russ B. Altman,Mihaela van der Schaar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EHRFlow 是一个基于多边际流匹配（multi-marginal flow matching）的连续时间生成框架，通过编码患者历史进行条件化，实现不规则时间观测下任意时间跨度的临床事件预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）是对随时间连续演变的潜在患者状态的不规则观测。现有自回归模型将病史作为条件来预测未来离散事件序列，但受离散观测限制；多边际流匹配提供了连续时间建模方式，但仅用多个观测监督训练路径，并不能让学习到的动力学访问患者既往病史。因此需要一个既能连续建模、又能利用患者历史的条件化框架。

Method: 提出 EHRFlow：在多边际流匹配框架上引入对编码患者历史的条件化，使未来动力学依赖患者既往临床轨迹。框架支持不规则观测时间，并可在任意时间跨度进行预测。

Result: 在受控合成基准上，EHRFlow 提升了临床编码预测与潜在状态恢复效果；在超过一百万患者的真实临床数据集（含独立外部验证队列）上，其跨度平均 top-5 临床编码准确率优于自回归与不依赖历史的流匹配基线；在受控反事实仿真中，条件引导可近似抗高血压干预的已知效应，且无需训练任务专属结果模型。

Conclusion: EHRFlow 通过将患者历史条件化融入多边际流匹配，兼顾连续时间建模与历史依赖性，在不规则观测场景下实现了更优的临床事件预测与反事实推断能力。

Abstract: Electronic health records provide irregular observations of latent patient states that evolve continuously over time. Recent autoregressive models condition on clinical histories to forecast future events as sequences of discrete observations. Conversely, multi-marginal flow matching provides a continuous-time formulation, but using multiple observations to supervise training paths does not itself give the learned dynamics access to preceding patient history. We introduce EHRFlow, a multi-marginal flow-matching framework that conditions on encoded patient history, thereby allowing future dynamics to depend on the patient's prior clinical trajectory. Our proposed framework accommodates irregular observation times and supports forecasting at arbitrary horizons. Across controlled synthetic benchmarks, EHRFlow improves clinical-code forecasting and latent-state recovery. On real-world clinical datasets comprising more than one million patients, including an independent external validation cohort, EHRFlow improves horizon-averaged top-5 clinical-code accuracy over autoregressive and history-independent flow-matching baselines. Finally, in a controlled counterfactual simulation, conditional guidance approximates the known effect of an antihypertensive intervention without training a task-specific outcome model.

</details>


### [506] [Strict-Saddle Landscapes and Multi-Rank Geometry in Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37865)
*Eugene Agyei-Kodie,Longxiu Huang,Shuang Li,Xiao Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究低管秩张量感知在平衡因子分解下的优化景观，证明在管状RIP条件下不存在虚假局部极小，并揭示局部几何由傅里叶切片秩决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低管秩张量感知常通过因子分解求解，但其非凸优化景观和局部几何尚不清楚，尤其是管秩与傅里叶分支秩对景观的影响需深入刻画。

Method: 在管状受限等距条件（tubal RIP）下，采用平衡因子分解分析任意傅里叶多秩情形的优化景观，建立无虚假局部极小、具有严格鞍点的定量景观，并分析局部增长率。

Result: 证明景观无虚假局部极小；局部几何取决于傅里叶切片秩而非仅管秩。均匀秩沿解轨道的横向呈二次增长，非均匀秩因隐藏的频率级过参数化产生四次平坦方向，即使因子宽度等于精确管秩。

Conclusion: 傅里叶切片秩是刻画低管秩张量感知非凸优化局部几何的关键因素；非均匀秩会导致隐含过参数化和平坦方向，数值实验验证了全局优化行为与局部几何差异。

Abstract: We study the optimization landscape of low-tubal-rank tensor sensing through a balanced factorization. Under a tubal restricted isometry condition, we establish a quantitative strict-saddle landscape with no spurious local minima for arbitrary Fourier multi-rank profiles. We further show that the local geometry depends on the Fourier-slice ranks rather than the tubal rank alone. Uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, whereas nonuniform ranks produce quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization, even when the factor width equals the exact tubal rank. Numerical experiments illustrate the global optimization behavior and the contrasting local geometries.

</details>


### [507] [Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38025)
*Zhenyu Wang,Tianze Wang,Linjun Zhang,Yifan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Dr. OPD，将on-policy distillation建模为双层优化，通过为不同token学习权重以最大化学生期望奖励，实验显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始OPD对所有token的教师监督一视同仁，但不同token的教师信号影响差异很大：有的能纠正关键推理错误，有的几乎不影响最终答案。因此应给不同token分配不同权重。

Method: 将最优加权OPD形式化为双层优化：内层学生按加权教师监督学习，外层选择权重以最大化学生期望奖励。提出迭代求解器，交替更新token权重（闭式解）与学生策略（对加权OPD目标做一步梯度更新）。

Result: 在正则条件下证明该加权更新比vanilla OPD更新获得更高期望奖励。在数学和代码的强到弱及同尺寸蒸馏中均优于所有基线；强到弱蒸馏下数学平均性能比vanilla OPD提升9.7分，并使学生超过更大的教师。

Conclusion: 通过双层优化学习token级监督权重，Dr. OPD能更有效地利用教师信号，显著提升蒸馏性能并实现学生超越教师。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Dr. OPD (OPD Done Right), which defines the optimal weighted OPD to maximize the student's performance. We formulate Dr. OPD as a bilevel optimization problem in which the student learns from weighted teacher supervision, while the weights are selected to maximize the expected reward of the resulting student. To solve Dr. OPD, we develop an efficient iterative solver that updates the token weights and student policy alternatively. At each round, it updates weights in closed form and then takes one gradient step on the resulting weighted OPD objective. Under regularity conditions, we show that this weighted update achieves a higher expected reward than a vanilla OPD update. Empirically, across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines. In particular, in the strong-to-weak distillation setting, Dr. OPD improves average math performance by $9.7$ points over vanilla OPD, and enables the smaller student to surpass its larger teacher.

</details>


### [508] [Draft in Parallel, Condition Through Depth: Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36173)
*Haohui Zhang,Keyu Chen,Haocheng Sun,Weibo Gu,Ruizhi Qiao,Xing Sun,Bo Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DSpine，通过在骨干网络每层进行门控相邻注入（因果条件注入），解决并行投机草稿中独立选词导致连读不一致、缩短接受前缀的问题，并配合统一迁移空间、逐层输出嵌入监督、融合内核与转换缓存，在多项基准上取得更长接受长度与更高吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行投机草稿一次骨干前向生成多个候选，但独立选词会产生不一致的续写，缩短可接受前缀。现有方法多把条件解码放在骨干之后的轻量模块，限制了前驱信息向后继的流动。对 DFlash 的分析表明：浅层早期位置已形成可恢复预测，且准确的相邻前驱在更早进入时对后继帮助更大。

Method: 提出 DSpine：在全骨干进行因果条件注入。每层用门控相邻注入把每个前驱的预测特征写入其后继，使因果条件链随网络深度展开，同时所有位置并行更新；用目标模型输出嵌入构建统一迁移空间，统一逐层注入与前驱条件解码；用逐层输出嵌入监督促进浅层预测特征形成；并用融合内核与转换缓存在 SGLang 内高效并行执行。

Result: 在七个数学、代码和聊天基准上，DSpine 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 的两种温度下均取得最长接受长度。在 Qwen3-8B 温度 0 时，七基准均值从 DFlash 的 3.77 提升到 4.82（+27.8%）；在 SGLang 服务测试中，平均吞吐比 DFlash 高 23.3%。

Conclusion: DSpine 通过贯穿骨干的因果条件注入，有效提升并行投机草稿的一致性、接受长度与服务吞吐。
