Abstract: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie in the speciation window. This hypothesis postulates that semantic labels explain a fraction of the correlations between distant tokens, a condition that is natural for many real datasets. We further give conditions under which both windows shrink to a single limiting time as system size grows, defining a "phase transition", and verify this behavior analytically in Gaussian mixtures. Together, these results identify conditions under which semantic information explains the concurrence of speciation and nonlocality, connecting two complementary perspectives on the emergence of semantic structure in generative modeling.

</details>

### [722] [Control and Estimation Co-Design via Envelope-Theorem Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36090)
*Mohammad S. Ramadan,Philip Dinenis,Mihai Anitescu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出Control and Estimation Co-Design (ContEst)框架，将控制器与被估计器设计统一为两阶段优化问题，利用包络定理从内层求解器返回的对偶变量直接获取设计梯度，无需对优化器求导，覆盖LQG、H∞、约束与非线性系统，实现显著设计改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统"被控对象—控制器—估计器"顺序设计流程通常并非最优，需要一种能同时优化控制与估计的联合设计方法。

Method: 将整个系统设计建模为单一两阶段问题，用一阶方法求解；关键工具是包络定理：在温和正则条件下（唯一内层解）可精确得到内层控制/估计最优代价对设计参数的梯度，更宽松条件下可视作次梯度，无需对优化器或其最优性条件求导。先在LQG框架下将控制与估计代价表示为两个SDP，梯度从Lyapunov约束的对偶中读取；再扩展到鲁棒H∞形式；进一步扩展至约束与非线性系统，用EKF与信息状态动力学的局部线性化得到近似凸MPC问题，梯度直接从协态读取。

Result: 在来自不同领域的多个实际设计示例上应用该方法，报告了显著的设计改进。

Conclusion: ContEst框架通过包络定理高效获取设计梯度，统一并优化控制与估计的联合设计，适用于LQG、H∞、约束及非线性系统。

Abstract: Instead of the sequential plant--control--estimator design pipeline, which is in general not optimal, we propose the Control and Estimation Co-Design (ContEst) framework, which poses the entire system design as a single two-stage problem solved by first-order methods. A key enabler is that the gradient of each inner control/estimation optimal cost with respect to the design parameters is available from the dual variables the inner solver already returns, by the envelope theorem: exactly under mild regularity (a unique inner minimizer), and as a subgradient under more relaxed conditions. That is, no differentiation through the optimizer or its optimality conditions is needed. We first present the framework in a linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) regime, where the control and estimation costs become two semidefinite programs (SDPs) whose design gradients are read from the duals of the Lyapunov constraints. We extend the results to robust ($H_\infty$) formulation to cover worst-case control and filtering problems. We also present an extension to constrained and nonlinear systems, using an extended Kalman filter (eKF) and a local linearization of the information-state dynamics to yield an approximate but convex model predictive control (MPC) problem whose design gradients are read directly from the costates. We apply our methods to a variety of realistic design examples from different fields and report significant design improvements.

</details>


### [723] [Emergency Control of Transmission Voltages by Coordinating DERs From Multiple Substations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36094)
*Francisco Escobar,Gustavo Valverde*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种协调DER聚合与变电站变压器有载调压开关的控制方案，通过轻量通信按所属变电站分配功率贡献，仿真验证可增强长期电压稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高应力输电网络及发电机与负荷间距大时电压稳定性受威胁；紧急电压失稳时，控制中低压网中大量DER是颇具前景的支撑手段，但需应对与传统电压调节器的交互、跨变电站协调及与DER少量信息交换等挑战。

Method: 提出协调DER聚合与变电站变压器有载调压开关（LTC）的控制方案：按DER所连变电站分配功率贡献，并依赖轻量级通信。

Result: 仿真表明所提控制能成功协调DER与有载调压开关，增强长期电压稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过协调DER聚合与LTC并结合轻量通信，可有效提升长期电压稳定性，为电压失稳紧急情况提供支撑对策。

Abstract: Voltage stability can be endangered in transmission networks that operate under high strain and exhibit a large separation between generators and loads. During emergencies associated to voltage instability, one promising supporting countermeasure is to control large populations of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) connected to medium- and low-voltage networks, so that they locally reduce the net load by modifying their power generation or consumption. However, it is challenging to achieve this control while anticipating interactions with legacy voltage regulators, coordinating efforts across substations, and exchanging small amounts of information with DERs. In this paper, we propose a control scheme that coordinates DER aggregations with the load tap changers of substation transformers, asks them to contribute power depending on the substation they are connected to, and relies on lightweight communication. Our simulations show that the proposed control can successfully coordinate DERs and load tap changers to enhance long-term voltage stability.

</details>


### [724] [Beyond Tomorrow -- Electrification of Hard-to-Abate Sectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36155)
*Jonas Huber,Johann W. Kolar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文综述了难以减排行业（钢铁、水泥、化工、航空、航运）直接电气化的路径，强调电力电子在工业过程电气化中的新兴机遇与挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现净零温室气体排放需要超越地面交通、建筑和常规工业自动化的深度电气化。难以减排行业占全球温室气体排放的30%，其电气化是关键缺口。虽然氢和合成燃料等间接电气化对部分应用仍不可或缺，但从效率角度直接使用电力通常更优。

Method: 本文梳理并评述了工业过程电气化中电力电子的新兴机会，涵盖氢等离子体熔融还原或熔融氧化物电解炼钢、电气化水泥生产、高温过程热、等离子体辅助化学以及电化学合成等案例。

Result: 这些应用中，功率变换器必须与高度专用的负载接口，从低压大电流电解槽到动态等离子体反应器和兆瓦级感应加热系统。此外，高功率电网接口以及厂内能源管理与缓冲方案也需明确。

Conclusion: 未来电气化工业过程为电力电子开辟了新的"超越明日"研究挑战，需要与相邻学科的科学家密切跨学科合作。

Abstract: Reaching net-zero greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions requires deep electrification beyond ground transportation, buildings, and conventional industry automation. This article discusses direct electrification pathways for hard-to-abate sectors, which today account for 30% of global GHG emissions and include steel, cement, chemicals, aviation, and shipping. Whereas indirect electrification via hydrogen and synthetic fuels will remain indispensable for some applications, direct use of electricity is generally preferable from an efficiency perspective. We review selected emerging opportunities for power electronics in industrial process electrification, including steelmaking through hydrogen plasma smelting reduction or molten-oxide electrolysis, electrified cement production, high-temperature process heat, plasma-assisted chemistry, and electrochemical synthesis. Across these examples, power converters must interface with highly application-specific loads, ranging from low-voltage high-current electrolysis cells to dynamic plasma reactors and megawatt-scale induction heating systems. In addition, high-power grid interfaces and in-plant energy management/buffering solutions must be clarified. Thus, future electrified industrial processes open new "beyond-tomorrow" research challenges for power electronics in close interdisciplinary collaboration with scientists from neighboring disciplines.

</details>


### [725] [Benefits of Dynamic Thermal Rating for Distribution Transformers Under Accelerated Load Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36223)
*Wenbo Wang,Killian McKenna,Francisco de Leon,Haowei Lu,Xin Fang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文评估动态热定额(DTR)作为配电网变压器非线网替代方案，用于推迟升级并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DTR在输电线路上广泛用于拥堵管理，但在配电变压器上潜力探索不足；面对负荷加速增长，传统静态额定值保守且升级成本高。

Method: 基于SMART-DS数据集的示例馈线，将传统变压器更换策略与采用环境调整额定值的DTR运行进行对比。

Result: DTR可推迟大量变压器升级并降低年度升级成本；在天气多样性显著、峰值需求出现在较凉时段或持续负荷增长的地区最有效。

Conclusion: DTR是实用且具成本效益的公用事业选项，提供运行灵活性与投资推迟机会，为配电网级DTR项目奠定基础。

Abstract: Dynamic Thermal Rating (DTR) has been widely applied to transmission lines for congestion management, but its potential for distribution transformers is less explored. By adjusting equipment ratings based on real ambient and operating conditions, DTR allows transformers to operate above conservative static nameplate values without compromising asset health. This paper evaluates how DTR can serve as a non-wires alternative to traditional upgrades in distribution systems facing accelerated load growth. Using an example feeder from the SMART-DS dataset, we compare conventional transformer replacement strategies against DTR-enabled operation with ambient-adjusted ratings. The results demonstrate that DTR can defer a significant number of transformer upgrades and reduce annual upgrade costs. More broadly, DTR is most effective in regions with pronounced weather diversity, peak demand occurring during cooler periods, or sustained load growth that would otherwise trigger costly reinforcements. These findings show that DTR is a practical and cost-effective option for utilities, provides both operational flexibility and investment deferral opportunities, and offers a foundation for developing distribution-level DTR programs.

</details>


### [726] [Fully Decentralized and Safety-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Control on Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36292)
*Theodore Rogalski,Shirantha Welikala*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种安全且完全去中心化的多智能体强化学习算法，用于解决网络上的离散时间控制问题（如持续监控），通过图编码器、状态估计器与控制屏障启发式相结合，实现优于集中式策略的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完全去中心化的智能体控制虽优点众多，但面临样本复杂度指数增长、缺乏全局系统信息、智能体间协作困难等问题，因此需要一种兼具去中心化与安全性的方法。

Method: 将网络状态的局部观测历史输入两个并行神经网络分支：图编码器（引入节点间结构信息与相关性）和状态估计器（预测各节点不确定性）；然后将actor-critic网络的输出通过离散时间控制屏障启发式，以降低任何节点被忽略的可能性。

Result: 在自定义仿真环境中，所提算法的平均不确定性比集中式控制策略低26.3%，且与计算更复杂、带注意力层算法的性能差距在1%以内。

Conclusion: 该方法使完全去中心化的智能体团队通过提升系统感知能力和内置安全机制，避免有害控制策略，从而有效解决挑战性控制问题。

Abstract: This paper develops a safe and fully decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm to solve a class of discrete-time control problems on networks, including the persistent monitoring problem. Fully decentralized control of agents, while offering numerous benefits, faces issues such as exponentially increasing sample complexity, lack of global information about the system, and challenges in coordinating between agents. To address these issues, this paper introduces a fully decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm that integrates deep reinforcement learning with safety considerations. This method feeds a history of local observations of the network's state into two parallel neural-network branches: the graph encoder, which adds structural information and correlations among nodes, and a state estimator, which predicts the uncertainty at each node in the graph. Additionally, the result of feeding that input into an actor-critic network is passed through a discrete-time control barrier heuristic to reduce the likelihood that any node will be neglected. This approach enables teams of fully decentralized agents to solve challenging problems by increasing system awareness and incorporating built-in safety measures to prevent the adoption of potentially harmful control policies. Numerical results from a custom simulation environment demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves 26.3 percent lower average uncertainty than a centralized control policy and is within 1 percent of the uncertainty performance of a more computationally complex algorithm with added attention layers.

</details>


### [727] [Discrete-time polynomial systems with inputs and outputs: structure, reachability, observability, and minimal realizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36423)
*Eduardo D. Sontag*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究离散时间输入/输出多项式系统的实现问题，证明每个多项式响应映射都有唯一的规范实现（准可达且代数可观测），并刻画其有限维性与多项式性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为离散时间输入/输出多项式系统建立实现理论，用交换代数与代数几何工具形式化状态空间为代数簇（或仿射k-概型的k-点集），并更新作者1976年博士论文的成果。

Method: 用交换代数与代数几何形式化系统；通过"对偶"系统（状态为定义在状态上的函数）将动态线性化；利用可观测量空间、代数与域，以及代数输入/输出差分方程和Jacobian秩判据进行刻画。

Result: 每个多项式响应映射都有唯一的规范（准可达、代数可观测）实现；给出有限维性与多项式性的多种刻画；对有界映射证明其有限可实现当且仅当可由有限维状态仿射系统实现，进而归结为有理形式幂级数理论；并研究准可达实现的格结构（含正规实现）。

Conclusion: 多项式响应映射具有唯一的规范实现，且有界映射与有限维状态仿射系统及有理形式幂级数等价；工作更新1976年博士论文，最后一节讨论与近期工作的联系。

Abstract: We study the realization problem for discrete-time input/output polynomial systems. These are formalized using tools from commutative algebra and algebraic geometry as systems whose state spaces are algebraic varieties, or more abstractly the set of k-points of an affine k-scheme, where k is an arbitrary infinite field. The input/output behaviors of such systems are described by "polynomial response maps" in which outputs are polynomial functions of past inputs. The main results show that every polynomial response map admits a canonical (quasi-reachable and algebraically observable) realization, which is unique up to isomorphism. The key to the approach is to linearize dynamics by considering a "dual" system in which states are functions defined on states. Finite dimensionality of the canonical realization, and its polynomiality, are characterized in terms of the space, algebra, and field of observables of the map, as well as in terms of algebraic input/output difference equations, and by a Jacobian rank criterion. A particular subclass consists of the maps that we call "bounded," defined by the property that their degree in the past inputs is uniformly bounded. Bounded maps are shown to be finitely realizable if and only if they are realizable by finite-dimensional state-affine systems, whose theory in turn reduces to that of rational formal power series. We also study the lattice of quasi-reachable realizations of a given map, including normal realizations. This work is an update of the PhD thesis written by the author in 1976; connections to recent work are briefly discussed in the last section.

</details>


### [728] [Massachusetts' 2026 Clean Peak Standard Recalibration: Adaptation and Storage Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36468)
*Yuhan Dai,Boyu Yao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 马萨诸塞州2026年重新校准清洁峰值标准，降低最低标准并扩大储能近期资源乘数；用三区小时级容量扩展模型评估发现系统成本下降但清洁峰值实际表现减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估2026年CPS重新校准（降低最低标准、扩大储能近期资源乘数）对2026–2030年储能部署、系统成本、合规、清洁峰值表现及排放的影响。

Method: 构建2026–2030年三区域小时级容量扩展模型，比较校准前后两种情景，并考察CPS合规、电池新增、系统成本、CPS合格放电、清洁峰值能源证书产量、CPS时段化石发电及排放。

Result: 两情景均完全合规；校准后新增电池减少53.1%，系统成本降低3.7%；CPS合格放电下降30.4%，而CPEC产量仅下降9.5%；CPS时段化石发电增加11.7%，但因RGGI总量上限约束，模型排放几乎不变。

Conclusion: CPS重新校准降低了模型所需储能容量并降低成本，但削弱了物理层面的清洁峰值表现，且排放削减受RGGI上限约束而不明显。

Abstract: Massachusetts recalibrated its Clean Peak Standard (CPS) in 2026 by lowering the minimum standards and expanding the Near-Term Resource Multiplier for qualifying storage. This paper evaluates the change using a three-zone, hourly capacity expansion model for 2026--2030. Both scenarios achieve full CPS compliance, but the post-May scenario reduces new battery additions by 53.1% and modeled system cost by 3.7%. CPS-eligible discharge declines by 30.4%, while Clean Peak Energy Certificate production declines by only 9.5%. Fossil generation during CPS hours increases by 11.7%, whereas modeled emissions remain nearly unchanged because the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative cap binds. The recalibration therefore lowers the modeled storage capacity requirement while weakening physical clean-peak performance.

</details>


### [729] [Expediting AC Contingency Analysis using a Basecase Machine Learning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36510)
*Md Obaidur Rahman,Vassilis Kekatos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种定点框架，仅用基态拓扑数据训练的单一ML模型即可预测任意非关键单线路故障后的AC潮流状态，显著降低离线数据生成与训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电网规划与运行需对大量线路故障进行快速准确的AC潮流（AC-PF）故障分析。现有ML方法要么对每种故障单独训练模型，要么用多拓扑数据训练单一模型，两者都带来高昂的离线数据生成与训练开销。因此需要一种复用基态模型的方法来降低成本。

Method: 提出固定点（fixed-point）框架：复用仅在基态拓扑数据上训练的单一ML模型，通过固定点迭代预测任意非关键单线路开断后的AC-PF状态。在DC模型近似下分析收敛性，推导以网络参数表示的收敛率；给出PTDF（非关键线路）幅值小于1的结论；刻画ML训练区域以覆盖迭代中出现的潮流规格，并推导故障后状态估计的ML预测误差界。

Result: 在6,717节点合成德州系统上测试，所有非关键单线路故障均收敛，预测误差接近基态水平。该方法在DC求解器速度与Newton-Raphson精度之间取得良好折中。

Conclusion: 所提固定点框架通过复用单一基态ML模型，实现了对任意非关键单线路故障的快速、准确AC-PF分析，降低了训练成本，并在速度和精度间提供了有利权衡。

Abstract: Grid planning and operation under increasingly variable operating conditions require fast and accurate AC power flow (AC-PF) contingency analysis for numerous line outages. While ML models can accelerate these computations, existing approaches often require either training separate models for different contingencies or a single model using data from multiple topologies. Both approaches incur substantial offline data generation and training costs. To address this gap, this work proposes a fixed-point framework that reuses a single ML model trained exclusively on basecase topology data to predict post-contingency AC-PF states under any non-critical single-line outage. We analyze the proposed method's convergence under the DC model approximation and derive its convergence rate in terms of network parameters. As a side result, we show that power transfer distribution factors (PTDFs) for non-critical lines have magnitudes less than one. We further characterize the ML training region to accommodate PF specifications encountered during fixed-point iterations and derive bounds on ML prediction errors for post-contingency state estimates. Numerical tests on a 6,717-bus synthetic Texas system demonstrate convergence across all non-critical single-line outages, with prediction errors remaining close to those of basecase. The proposed framework offers a favorable tradeoff between the speed of DC solvers and Newton-Raphson accuracy.

</details>


### [730] [Invariance is Compositional for Continuous-time Systems: From Sleekness to Lebesgue Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36539)
*Othman Cherkaoui Dekkaki,Sadek Belamfedel Alaoui,Olayo Reynaud,Mohamed Maghenem,Alessio Iovine,Adnane Saoud*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文首次建立双向复合不变性结果：全局笛卡尔积集合的鲁棒前向不变性等价于各局部子系统在邻居耦合输入下的鲁棒前向不变性，并引入切向勒贝格密度概念降低验证维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维全局系统的鲁棒前向不变性验证面临维度灾难，需要将高维全局验证分解为局部子检验。

Method: 提出切向勒贝格密度（tangential Lebesgue-density）新条件，弱于经典光滑性（sleekness），用以保证个体切锥之积等于积集切锥，从而证明双向复合不变性等价。

Result: 通过直流微电网数值算例验证框架可扩展性，确认验证复杂度仅随子系统数量线性增长。

Conclusion: 该等价性实现了高维全局系统验证的局部化分解，有效缓解维度灾难并具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: This work establishes the first bidirectional compositional invariance result: robust forward invariance of a global Cartesian product set is shown to be equivalent to robust forward invariance of each local subsystem under coupling inputs from its neighbors. To facilitate this, we introduce the notion of tangential Lebesgue-density, a new condition that is weaker than classical sleekness but sufficient to ensure that the product of individual tangent cones equals the tangent cone of the product set. This equivalence reduces the curse of dimensionality by allowing the verification of a high-dimensional global system to be decomposed into a series of local sub-checks. The framework's scalability is demonstrated through a DC microgrid numerical example, confirming that the verification complexity grows only linearly with the number of subsystems.

</details>


### [731] [Attack-Resiliency Analytics for Wide-Area Control Systems in Smart Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36583)
*Mohammad Zakaria Haider,Prabin Mali,Nur Imtiazul Haque,Muhammad Nadeem,Sumit Paudyal,Mohammad Ashiqur Rahman*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出WAMPAC系统攻击弹性分析框架，用MILP建模最优隐蔽FDI攻击，评估静态BDD与学习边界检测的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAMPAC依赖广域网络传输同步PMU数据，易受FDI攻击，需形式化建模其攻击弹性与检测局限。

Method: 耦合建模广域阻尼环、AGC及调速励磁动态，将最优隐蔽FDI攻击表述为MILP；ADM作为可替换约束集（静态BDD或按共同误报率标定的学习边界）。

Result: 在IEEE 39/118节点系统（OPAL-RT HIL验证动态）上，广域访问攻击目标达良性3.3/8.1倍，0.5Hz频率偏移速度超AGC攻击两倍；学习边界使攻击目标降15.5–55.0%，防止过频继电器跳闸，隐蔽攻击仍可行，残余风险随边界宽度而非检测器类型变化。

Conclusion: 广域访问显著增强攻击危害；学习边界检测可降低攻击效果但无法消除隐蔽攻击，残余风险主要取决于边界宽度。

Abstract: Wide-area monitoring, protection, and control (WAMPAC) systems damp inter-area oscillations in large interconnected grids, but their reliance on synchronized PMU measurements carried over wide-area networks exposes them to false data injection (FDI) attacks. This paper presents an attack-resiliency analytics framework that formally models the coupled dynamics of the wide-area damping loop, automatic generation control, and the governor and excitation systems, and formulates the optimal stealthy FDI attack as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP). The anomaly detection model (ADM) enters as a replaceable constraint set: either a static bad-data detection (BDD) rule or a boundary learned from benign operation calibrated to a common false-positive rate. On the IEEE 39 and 118 bus systems, with reference dynamics validated on an OPAL-RT hardware-in-the-loop testbed, the optimal attack with wide-area access attains 3.3 and 8.1 times the benign objective and reaches a 0.5Hz frequency excursion more than twice as fast as an attack confined to automatic generation control. Learned boundaries reduce the attack objective by 15.5 55.0% and prevent over-frequency relay trips in all configurations, with feasible stealthy attacks remaining in every case, and residual risk tracks the width of the learned boundary rather than the detector family.

</details>


### [732] [Information-theoretic receding-horizon active learning of nonlinear dynamical systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36712)
*Juncal Arbelaiz,Anushri Arora,Jonathan W. Pillow*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于贝叶斯非线性特征估计与信息导向自适应设计的方法，从单条有限时长轨迹高效学习随机受控非线性动力学，提升重构精度并降低预测不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限时长实验中准确学习非线性动力学，需要高效采集有信息量的数据；本文针对状态沿单条轨迹观测的随机受控非线性动力学系统，目标是在指定的状态-输入紧子集上重构未知的受控状态增量映射。

Method: 用固定非线性特征构造参数化估计器（对状态/输入非线性、对参数线性）；对参数设高斯先验，实现递推贝叶斯后验在线更新并量化目标集上的预测不确定性；在信息状态上建立最优自适应设计问题，采用基于候选未来轨迹与重构动力学在目标集上的平均边缘互信息的预测导向采集准则；用非短视滚动时域近似，结合场景样本平均与交叉熵方法并行求解。

Result: 在噪声多稳系统上的数值实验表明，在相当实验约束下，所提自适应信息寻求策略比常见激励基线更有效地降低预测不确定性与重构误差。

Conclusion: 该框架为单轨迹受控非线性随机系统提供了具备不确定性量化的在线学习与自适应数据采集方案，能更高效地利用有限实验数据完成动力学重构。

Abstract: Accurately learning nonlinear dynamics from a finite-duration experiment requires the efficient collection of informative data. We address this challenge for stochastic controlled nonlinear dynamical systems whose state is observed along a single trajectory. Our goal is to reconstruct the unknown controlled state-increment map over a prescribed compact subset of state-input space. We construct a parametric estimator of the map using fixed nonlinear features, so that the model is nonlinear in the state and input, but linear in the unknown parameters. A Gaussian prior over the parameters yields recursive Bayesian posterior updates as data stream in, enabling online quantification of predictive uncertainty in the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We formulate an optimal adaptive-design problem over an information state, using a prediction-oriented acquisition criterion based on the mean marginal mutual information between candidate future trajectories and the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We then approximate the resulting adaptive-design problem by a non-myopic receding-horizon formulation, evaluate its remaining expectation using a scenario-based sample average, and solve the resulting deterministic program with the cross-entropy method, leveraging parallel candidate-scenario evaluations. Numerical experiments on a noisy multistable system demonstrate that the proposed adaptive information-seeking strategy reduces predictive uncertainty and reconstruction error more efficiently than common excitation baselines under comparable experimental constraints.

</details>


### [733] [On a Class of Decentralized Feedback Controllers for the Networked Bivirus SIS Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36799)
*Sebin Gracy,Mengbin Ye,Brian D. O. Anderson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究双病毒竞争传播系统中引入非线性分散反馈控制对地方性平衡感染比例的影响，发现控制可能引发新的平衡类型（跨临界分岔），并揭示受控系统的强单调性及不可稳定化性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作已刻画双竞争病毒传播系统及多连通种群网络的性质，但缺乏对通过分散反馈控制降低地方性平衡感染比例的系统性分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 引入一类非线性分散反馈控制，降低种群在地方性平衡下的感染比例；通过平衡点分析与分岔理论（跨临界分岔）研究受控系统动力学，并利用强单调性证明稳定性结论。

Result: 在某些情形下，控制会引发受控系统独有的新型平衡点，其来源是未受控系统中不存在的跨临界分岔；同时证明受控系统具有强单调性。

Conclusion: 未受控系统的不稳定边界平衡点无法通过本文所考虑的一类分散状态反馈控制器实现稳定化。

Abstract: Recent work has established many properties of systems modeling the spread of two competing viruses in a population, and for networks with multiple connected populations with different spreading properties (e.g. men and women). This work considers the introduction of a class of nonlinear decentralized feedback controls aimed at reducing the fractions of populations infected at an endemic equilibrium. One surprising conclusion is that in some circumstances, new types of equilibria can arise. They can be viewed as an outcome of a transcritical bifurcation which is never observed for uncontrolled systems. In addition, we show that the controlled system is strongly monotone, and an unstable boundary equilibrium of the uncontrolled system cannot be stabilized using the class of decentralized state feedback controllers considered in this paper.

</details>


### [734] [Receding Horizon Control and Dissipativity - Optimal Control, Games and Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36858)
*Sophie Hall,Jonas Schießl,Sergio Grammatico,Timm Faulwasser*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文回顾了确定性、随机、多智能体及博弈论设置下的滚动时域控制（RHC/MPC），指出耗散性理论与转辙性质（turnpike property）是统一主线，并首次系统综述经济、博弈与随机场景中耗散性与转辙分析的异同、数值方法趋势及开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体与博弈场景下的MPC与传统最优控制存在本质差异（最优解 vs. 博弈均衡），在成本与约束处理上不同，亟需统一视角梳理相关理论，厘清耗散性与转辙性质在不同设置下的作用与联系。

Method: 采用教程式综述方法：对比最优控制问题的最优解与博弈的均衡（在成本与约束处理方面）；以耗散性理论和转辙性质为统一线索，系统归纳确定性、随机、经济、博弈论与多智能体各设置下的基本结论，并比较其技术差异；同时梳理博弈数值方法的最新进展。

Result: 揭示了耗散性理论与转辙性质构成贯穿各类滚动时域控制方案的系统论主线和统一线索；总结了各设置下的基础性洞见，明确了经济、博弈论与随机场景中耗散性/转辙分析的共性与技术差异，并给出博弈数值方法的新趋势。

Conclusion: 该文是首个跨经济、博弈论与随机设置统一综述耗散性与转辙分析的工作，为多智能体RHC/MPC提供了系统论框架，并指出一系列待解决的开放挑战。

Abstract: We provide a tutorial overview of receding horizon control across deterministic, stochastic, multi-agent, and game-theoretic settings. We contrast the minimizer of an optimal control problem with the equilibrium of a game in terms of cost and constraint handling to motivate the difference of MPC schemes involving multiple agents/players. Interestingly, dissipativity theory and the turnpike property have turned out to be a unifying thread and system-theoretic backbone across all these schemes. This paper is the first to give an overview of results, summarizing fundamental insights, drawing parallels, and highlighting technical differences in dissipativity and turnpike analysis across economic, game theoretic, and stochastic settings. We also explore recent trends in numerical methods for games. We conclude by pointing to a list of open challenges.

</details>


### [735] [An Energy-Based Framework for Transient Stability of Grid-Forming Converter Networks With Current Limiting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36978)
*Wei Zhou,Yunjie Gu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出一种含限流环节且保持耗散性的网络能量构造方法，用于多机（网络级）构网型变流器暂态稳定分析，无需按模式切换能量函数，并以双GFM系统仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有构网型（GFM）变流器限流下的暂态稳定分析多局限于单机系统，网络级暂态稳定分析仍是难题。

Method: 构造一种计及限流的网络能量函数，并保证其可证明的耗散性质；据此建立与同步机系统经典直接法一致的Lyapunov分析框架，无需在依赖运行模式的多个能量函数之间切换。以采用无功环流限流器与阻抗插入的双GFM系统为例说明。

Result: 以双GFM系统为算例展示框架的可行性，电磁暂态仿真结果支持理论结论。

Conclusion: 所提网络能量构造可将限流纳入统一的Lyapunov直接法框架，实现网络级GFM暂态稳定分析，方法有效且获仿真验证。

Abstract: Existing analyses for the transient stability of grid-forming (GFM) converters under current limiting mainly address single-converter systems, while network-level transient stability analysis remains challenging. This paper develops a network energy construction that incorporates current limiting while retaining a provable dissipation property. This structure enables Lyapunov-based analysis consistent with classical direct method for synchronous-machine based systems, without switching between mode-dependent energy functions. A two-GFM example using a reactive circular current limiter and impedance insertion illustrates the proposed framework. Electromagnetic transient simulations support the theoretical results.

</details>


### [736] [Decentralized Continuous-Time Power Dispatch for Integrated Heat and Power Systems via Bernstein-Galerkin Equivalent Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37173)
*Jie Deng,Zhigang Li,J. H. Zheng,Yue Chen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于Bernstein-Galerkin等效投影的分散式连续时间调度框架，实现变流量变温（VF-VT）下综合热电系统的隐私保护协同优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分散式调度方法多依赖离散时间热网模型和恒定流量运行，无法充分利用热灵活性；而VF-VT运行需同时处理热-水耦合与连续时间热动态，导致模型非凸，传统分解方法难以适用。

Method: 对给定质量流量轨迹，将热网热动态在Bernstein空间建模并投影到边界变量，得到不泄露内部拓扑与状态的等效可行域模型；等效模型与热网子问题源自统一的Bernstein-Galerkin公式，保证热状态表示一致；并引入带保护的Anderson预测方案，利用历史更新与不动点残差加速交替协调。

Result: 数值结果验证该方法保持热状态一致性、利用VF-VT灵活性，并提升经济性与计算性能。

Conclusion: 所提框架可在保护隐私前提下实现连续时间VF-VT分散调度，优于传统离散恒定流方法。

Abstract: Decentralized power dispatch for integrated heat and power systems (IHPSs) involves coordinating electric power systems (EPSs) and district heating networks (DHNs) while preserving privacy. The existing methods rely mainly on discretetime DHN models and constant-flow operations, limiting the ability to exploit thermal flexibility. Enabling variable-flow and variable-temperature (VF-VT) operations requires thermal-hydraulic coupling to be addressed together with continuous-time thermal dynamics. However, the simultaneous variations in mass flows and temperature lead to a nonconvex IHPS model, for which conventional decomposition methods are difficult to apply. This paper proposes a decentralized continuous-time dispatch framework using Bernstein-Galerkin equivalent projection. For a prescribed mass flow trajectory, DHN thermal dynamics are formulated in the Bernstein space and projected onto boundary variables, yielding an equivalent feasible-region model without disclosing the internal DHN topology or states. The equivalent model and DHN subproblem are derived from a unified Bernstein-Galerkin formulation, ensuring a consistent thermal state representation throughout the EPS-DHN coordination procedure. A safeguarded Anderson prediction scheme further accelerates the alternating coordination process by using historical updates and fixed-point residuals to predict the next input without additional subproblem solving steps. Numerical results show the proposed method preserves thermal state consistency, exploits VF-VT flexibility, and improves economic and computational performance.

</details>


### [737] [Ancillary Services in High-Renewable Power Systems: Comparing Market Design, Emerging Trends, and Future Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37214)
*Andreas Makrides,Andrey Churkin,Fei Teng,Pierre Pinson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文比较英国、德国、丹麦、意大利、加州、德州和澳大利亚七地的辅助服务市场设计，提出一致的产品级分类与时间可视化，揭示四大趋势与多重挑战，结论是并不收敛于单一设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源快速扩张改变电力系统运行方式，逆变器资源替代同步发电机削弱了传统安全与可靠性支撑，系统运营商需采购涵盖五类的更广泛辅助服务，因此有必要系统比较各地市场设计以理解其应对高比例可变可再生能源的差异。

Method: 对上述七个电力系统进行对比研究，考察其在可变可再生能源增长下如何定义、采购、补偿与协调辅助服务；建立统一的产品级分类体系，绘制可比的频率控制与备用产品时序可视化图，并映射各服务在各地市场中的实现方式。

Result: 识别出四大趋势：更快更精细的频率响应产品、对稳定性能力（惯量、系统强度、动态电压支撑）的更明确采购、储能与需求侧及逆变器资源的更广泛参与、以及更多采用位置性、定向性和技术中立的采购。主要挑战包括协调不足、对依赖位置与运行条件的灵活性与稳定性能力估值不完整、分布式与新兴资源参与壁垒、市场与运行安排间协调不够。

Conclusion: 辅助服务市场设计并未收敛于单一样式，应支持差异化但相互协调的框架，以反映各项服务在技术、时间与位置上的特性。

Abstract: Rapid growth in renewable generation is changing power-system operation and increasing the importance of ancillary services for security and reliability. As inverter-based resources displace conventional synchronous generation, system operators must procure a broader set of services spanning five categories: frequency control and reserves, voltage and reactive power support, system stability, restoration, and congestion management. This paper compares ancillary-service market design in Great Britain, Germany, Denmark, Italy, California, Texas, and Australia. It examines how these systems define, procure, remunerate, and coordinate services as variable renewable generation increases. The review develops a consistent product-level classification, provides comparable timing visualisations of frequency-control and reserve products, and maps implementation modalities across services and systems. Four trends emerge: faster and more granular frequency-response products, more explicit procurement of stability capabilities including inertia, system strength, and dynamic voltage support, broader participation by storage, demand-side resources, and other inverter-based resources, and greater use of locational, targeted, and technology-neutral procurement. Challenges include limited harmonisation, incomplete valuation of flexibility and stability capabilities whose value depends on location and operating conditions, barriers to participation by distributed and emerging resources, and insufficient coordination between market and operational arrangements. The comparison finds no convergence towards a single market design and supports differentiated but coordinated ancillary-service frameworks reflecting each service's technical, temporal, and locational characteristics.

</details>


### [738] [Vertiport Design Methodology and Capacity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37288)
*Emin Burak Onat,Jean-Luc Lupien,Raja Sengupta*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文用随机排队网络模型分析垂直起降场(vertiport)的设计与容量，揭示容量受起降与周转活动交互、参数方差及排队延迟置信度的显著约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为支持可扩展、高效的UAM(城市空中交通)部署，需要科学的垂直起降场设计与容量分析方法。

Method: 构建带有限缓冲区的双节点排队网络模型，解析推导单TLOF垂直起降场的平均队列长度与延迟，并用仿真模型在多工况下验证；容量定义为在大概率满足最大排队延迟约束下的最大稳态小时吞吐量。

Result: 容量受起降与周转活动交互显著限制，并随运行参数方差下降，确定性时间可大幅提升容量；马尔可夫模型中吞吐量通常约为理论最大离场容量的50%，随最大排队延迟置信度提高而急剧下降；非马尔可夫模型在停车位充足时可达满TLOF容量；方法还能确定单位面积吞吐量最大化的最优停车位数。

Conclusion: 该研究为垂直起降场基础设施设计提供洞见，有助于支撑可扩展、高效的UAM部署。

Abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive methodology for vertiport design and capacity analysis using stochastic queueing models. Vertiport capacity is defined as the maximum steady-state throughput of aircraft per hour while maintaining a specified maximum queuing delay with high probability. We introduce a two-node queueing network model with a finite buffer to analytically derive mean queue lengths and delays at singleTLOF vertiports, supported by a simulation model that validates these findings under various operational conditions. Our analyses reveal that vertiport capacity is significantly constrained by the interactions between takeoff/landing operations and turnaround activities. Capacity is further reduced by the variance in these operational parameters, with deterministic times substantially enhancing capacity. The study shows that vertiport throughput is typically around 50% of the theoretical maximum departure capacity in a Markovian model, decreasing sharply as confidence in maximum queuing delay increases. Non-Markovian models with adequate parking pads achieve full TLOF capacity. Additionally, our methodology identifies the optimal number of parking pads required to maximize throughput per unit area. The findings provide insights for designing vertiport infrastructure to support scalable and efficient UAM deployment.

</details>


### [739] [From Demand to System Co-Shaping: A Review of User Roles in Transportation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37295)
*Fangting Zhou,Balazs Kulcsar,Jelena Andric*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，提出以用户角色为核心的概念化分类框架，梳理交通决策中用户信息如何被表征与利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通建模将用户简化为需求输入（出行流、配送请求、充电负荷），但数字化、电动化、平台化服务使用户与系统产生更直接交互，用户对价格、激励、服务可用性和信息的响应会影响运营和规划决策，因此需要重新审视用户信息的表征与使用方式。

Method: 采用以概念为导向、基于分类法的综述方法，不按交通领域而是按三种用户角色分类：被动需求、运营参与者、系统共同塑造者；综合交通电动化、城市物流、共享出行、多式联运和MaaS等研究，考察用户偏好、灵活性、支付意愿、接受度、参与和反馈如何被纳入建模与决策框架。

Result: 在用户行为的测量与预测方面已有进展，但用户相关变量多用于行为分析，而非作为系统决策的可操作输入；其融入运营决策仍不完整，运营层用户响应与结果向长期规划的系统性反馈更为有限。

Conclusion: 关键挑战包括打通运营与规划闭环、建模异质性与策略性用户、将优化与用户接受度结合、以及保障隐私、公平与可部署性；研究指向从用户行为分析转向用户知情与用户驱动的交通系统设计。

Abstract: Users are central to transportation systems, yet their roles are often simplified in transportation modeling and decision-making. Conventional approaches primarily represent users through demand-related inputs, such as trip flows, delivery requests, and charging loads. However, digital, electrified, and platform-based services create more direct user-system interactions, with users responding to prices, incentives, service availability, and information in ways that can influence operational and planning decisions. This review develops a concept-oriented, taxonomy-based synthesis of how user-related information is represented and used in transportation decision-making. Rather than organizing the literature primarily by transport domain, we distinguish three user roles: passive demand, operational agents, and system co-shapers. Drawing on studies across transportation electrification, urban logistics, shared mobility, multimodal transport, and Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS), the review examines how user preferences, flexibility, willingness to pay, acceptance, participation, and feedback are incorporated into modeling and decision frameworks. The synthesis shows that progress has been made in measuring and predicting user behavior, but user-related variables are still often used mainly for behavioral analysis rather than as actionable inputs to system decisions. Their integration into operational decision-making remains incomplete, and systematic feedback from operational user responses and outcomes to long-term planning is even more limited. Key challenges include closing the loop between operation and planning, modeling heterogeneous and strategic users, integrating optimization with user acceptance, and ensuring privacy, equity, and deployability. Together, these findings point toward a shift from user-behavior analysis to user-informed and user-driven transportation system design.

</details>


### [740] [Reduced-Order Model Characterization of Nonlinear Sustained Oscillations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37505)
*Kaiyang Huang,Dan Wilson,Kai Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出受控相位-等稳定模型，用于逆变器资源引发的非线性持续振荡的阻尼控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆变器资源与电网交互可能在不稳定平衡点周围产生吸引极限环，导致非线性持续振荡；此时仅靠局部平衡点线性化不足以描述两不变集之间的非线性动态，需要新的阻尼控制方法。

Method: 在连接平衡点与极限环的二维不变流形上建立受控相位-等稳定模型，用相位和等稳定坐标表示流形动态，并通过非线性重构与响应函数将物理状态和控制输入映射到这些坐标；所需函数由连接轨迹和周期轨道数据计算。随后设计控制策略以提供额外阻尼并限制相位失真。

Result: 在双区域系统和IEEE 39节点系统上的案例研究表明，在相同条件下，该方法比基于平衡点线性化的设计具有更有效的振荡阻尼效果。

Conclusion: 所提相位-等稳定控制框架能有效抑制非线性持续振荡，优于传统平衡点线性化方法。

Abstract: Nonlinear sustained oscillations involving inverter-based resources can happen when device and network interactions produce an attracting limit cycle around an unstable equilibrium. A damping controller must then describe nonlinear dynamics over the region between the two invariant sets, where a local equilibrium linearization can be insufficient. In this paper, a controlled phase--isostable model is first developed on a two-dimensional invariant manifold connecting the equilibrium and the limit cycle. Dynamics on this surface are represented by phase and isostable coordinates, while physical states and control inputs are related to these coordinates through nonlinear reconstruction and response functions. The required functions are computed from connecting trajectories and periodic-orbit data. A control strategy is then designed to provide extra damping while limiting phase distortion. Case studies on a two-area system and an IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate more effective oscillation damping than the compared equilibrium-linearized designs under the same conditions.

</details>


### [741] [Isostable-Based Nonlinear Model Reduction for Power System Oscillations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37506)
*Kaiyang Huang,Dan Wilson,Kai Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出基于等稳定坐标的模型降维方法，用于电力系统非线性模态分析与阻尼控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统高维动态模型使非线性控制计算昂贵，实际中多依赖线性化模型，但线性模型无法捕捉大扰动引起的非线性振荡行为。

Method: 构建与选定振荡模态相关的不变流形，用等稳定坐标以两个实状态变量描述该模态；等稳定表述给出线性自治模态动力学，非线性状态重构与输入响应在模态流形上计算，并直接在降维坐标中建立最优阻尼控制问题。

Result: 在IEEE 39节点系统上的案例研究表明，所提模型能准确描述非线性振荡，且相比基于线性降维模型设计的控制具有更好的阻尼效果。

Conclusion: 等稳定坐标降维可有效实现电力系统非线性模态分析与阻尼控制，优于线性降维模型方法。

Abstract: Power systems are often represented by high-dimensional dynamic models, making nonlinear control design computationally expensive and limiting its practical application. Oscillation analysis and damping control therefore commonly rely on linearized models, which do not capture the nonlinear oscillatory behavior induced by large disturbances. This paper proposes an isostable-based model reduction method for nonlinear modal analysis of power systems. The method constructs an invariant manifold associated with a selected oscillatory mode and uses isostable coordinates to describe the mode with only two real state variables. The isostable formulation gives linear autonomous modal dynamics, with nonlinear state reconstruction and input response computed on the modal manifold. An optimal damping control problem is then formulated directly in the reduced coordinates. Case studies on the IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed model in describing nonlinear oscillations and show improved damping compared with control designed using a linear reduced model.

</details>


### [742] [Quantifying EnergyNet performance: a simulation-based framework for decentralized energy networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37600)
*Max Collins,Jonas Birgersson,Marc A. Weiss,Jimmy Chen,Marc Z. Jacobson,Newsha K. Ajami,Daniel Kammen,Tomas Kåberger,Franklin Carrero-Martínez,Joakim Wernberg,Michael Menser,Henrik Ny,Lou Riordan,Jill G. Ferguson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出 EnergyNet——一种由电力电子 Energy Router 互联的去中心化能源系统架构，并建立定量建模与评估框架，通过多案例验证其供电可靠性与能量共享能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端天气、基础设施故障和地缘冲突日益威胁输配电网络，导致大规模停电。本地发电、储能与可控负荷虽带来挑战，也为重构能源系统组织方式提供了可能。

Method: 提出 EnergyNet 架构：由互联的 Energy Router 组成，每个路由器协调本地负荷、发电、储能与电网连接，通过双向 Energy Link 交换能量、以 Energy Protocol 通信。建立定量框架，建模拓扑、优先级负荷、发电、储能、电网接口、链路及组件约束，采用滚动时域优化计算能量分配与交换，并支持扰动与可靠性分析。

Result: 三路由器案例展示了能量共享与孤岛运行；斯坦福校园微电网与 Half Moon Bay 离网微电网中，低日照时电动公交访问支持离网运行且不中断交通服务；Lund 在建 EnergyNet（10 栋建筑、278 套公寓）在夏冬及失去一个电网接口或 Energy Link 时仍维持全服务。失去两条链路会分割网络，孤岛服务取决于本地资源与修复时间。可靠性筛查显示分区罕见但可信；蒙特卡洛分析表明夏季样本条件下关键服务全满足，冬季关键服务中位连续率达约 92%。

Conclusion: EnergyNet 框架可量化评估去中心化能源系统的能量共享与可靠性，能在并网或离网条件下维持关键服务，为提升电力系统韧性提供可行路径。

Abstract: Power transmission and distribution infrastructure connects generation with consumers. Extreme weather, infrastructure failures, and geopolitical conflicts increasingly disrupt these connections, leaving large groups without electricity until service is restored. Local generation, storage, and controllable loads pose challenges but also enable new ways to organize energy systems. EnergyNet is a decentralized architecture of interconnected power electronic Energy Routers. Each coordinates local loads, generation, storage, and grid connections. Bidirectional Energy Links enable exchange between routers, while the Energy Protocol communicates needs and availability to coordinate transfers. EnergyNet can operate with or without the public grid. This paper develops a quantitative framework for modeling and evaluating EnergyNet. It represents topology, prioritized loads, generation, storage, grid connections, links, and component limits. Receding-horizon optimization calculates energy allocation and exchange, supporting also disturbance and reliability analysis. A three-router case illustrates energy sharing and islanded operation. The framework then models a Stanford University campus microgrid and an off-grid microgrid in Half Moon Bay. Under low-solar conditions, electric bus visits support the off-grid microgrid while preserving transport service. Finally, the paper models an EnergyNet under construction in Lund, Sweden, comprising ten buildings and 278 apartments. Full service is maintained in summer and winter and after the loss of one grid interface or Energy Link. Losing two links partitions the network; service in the island depends on local resources and repair time. Reliability screening identifies partitioning as rare but credible. Monte Carlo analysis shows full critical service in sampled summer conditions and median continuous critical service of approximately 92% in winter.

</details>


### [743] [Active Informativity: Online Input Design for Data-Driven Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37683)
*Yishu Wang,Paolo Rapisarda,Jianquan Lu,Yang Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一个面向噪声数据的在线输入设计统一框架，通过性能度量与增量数据分析，实现在线选输入并保证数据质量不随时间下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动控制依赖数据质量，但噪声数据下输入如何在线设计以持续保证质量缺乏统一方法。

Method: 引入数据质量性能度量，分析加入新数据时该度量的变化；据此提出在线选择输入的策略，确保数据质量不下降。用该框架刻画六类常见噪声数据驱动控制问题。

Result: 六个常见问题被纳入框架，其中三个通过数值算例求解，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 统一的在线输入设计框架可行且有效，能保证数据质量随时间不退化，适用多种噪声数据驱动控制问题。

Abstract: We develop a unified framework for online input design in data-driven control from noisy data. We introduce a performance measure and analyze how such quality measure changes as new data are added. Based on such analysis we propose an online method for selecting inputs that ensures that data quality does not decrease over time. We demonstrate the validity of our approach by formulating six common noisy data-driven control problems in our framework, and by solving numerical examples for three of them.

</details>


### [744] [Complete Characterization of Minimum-Order Functional Observers from Darouach to Luenberger](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37992)
*Tyrone Fernando*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文对线性泛函观测器（functional observer）的阶数进行了逐一刻画，给出了从代数最小阶到泛函可观测性决定的上界的完整阶数谱，并得到最小谱可行阶数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 泛函观测器的阶数选择具有重要的理论与实践意义：经典结果（如Darouach阶、Luenberger阶）只是特例，缺少对两个端点之间各阶观测器存在性的统一刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 利用泛函可观测性指标定义代数最小允许阶 q0 = Ση_j；计算可观测矩阵秩 n0，并确定阶数上界 n0 - p。通过原始状态空间中的零空间表示，给出代数条件（秩刻画）与谱条件（矩阵束刻画），从而在每个给定阶数上刻画观测器条件。

Result: 得到了完整的泛函观测器阶数谱：最小阶为谱可行的最小阶；两个端点分别可退化为经典Darouach阶（当 q0 = r 时）和Luenberger阶（在完全可观测下为 n - p）。

Conclusion: 本文统一并推广了经典观测器阶数结果，为线性泛函观测器的阶数设计提供了系统的理论框架。

Abstract: This paper gives an order-by-order characterization of linear functional
  observers between the minimum dimension permitted by the algebraic observer
  condition and the upper endpoint determined by functional observability.
  Functional observability indices determine the minimum algebraically
  admissible order
  $$
  q_0=\sum_{j=1}^rη_j,
  $$
  where $r$ is the number of independent functionals to be estimated and
  $η_j$ is the functional observability index associated with the $j$th
  functional. For an $n$-dimensional system with $p$ independent measured outputs, let
  $n_0$ denote the rank of the observability matrix. Under functional
  observability, the upper endpoint of the functional-observer order range
  is $n_0-p$. The algebraic
  and spectral observer conditions are characterized at each prescribed
  order between these two endpoints. A nullspace representation in the
  original state space yields rank and matrix-pencil characterizations of
  the algebraic and spectral conditions, respectively. The minimum observer
  order is obtained as the smallest spectrally feasible order in the
  resulting order spectrum. The two endpoints include the classical
  Darouach and Luenberger orders as special cases: the lower endpoint
  reduces to the Darouach order when $q_0=r$, while, under complete
  observability, the upper endpoint reduces to the Luenberger order $n-p$.

</details>


### [745] [Grid Demand Flexibility Assessment of AI Data Centers via Batch Workload Temporal Shifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38020)
*Suntao Su,Liang Du,Shengyi Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一套评估AI数据中心电网兼容需求灵活性的框架，通过批处理负载时间平移实现需求响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心快速增长且功率需求大、波动性强，其异构负载特性与资源需求使得需求灵活性难以直接刻画，而定量描述对电网协调至关重要。

Method: 提出基于资源使用平均化的处理方法，将细粒度CPU、GPU和内存使用映射到与电力系统兼容的统一时间间隔；构建批处理负载时间调度模型，保持执行连续性、时延约束和服务器资源容量，并耦合利用率相关的服务器功耗模型，将调度决策转化为功率需求。

Result: 评估两类灵活性指标：短期峰值削减和持续功率降低的最大时长。基于真实GPU集群数据的数值结果表明，批处理负载时间平移可为AI数据中心提供可量化且电网兼容的需求灵活性，且对计算负载干扰有限。

Conclusion: 批处理负载时间平移能有效挖掘AI数据中心的需求灵活性，为电力系统协调提供可行手段。

Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers has introduced new challenges to power system operation. As their power demand becomes larger and more variable, quantitatively characterizing their demand flexibility is increasingly important for effective power system coordination. However, heterogeneous workload characteristics and resource requirements make this flexibility difficult to characterize directly. This paper proposes a framework for assessing the grid-compatible demand flexibility of AI data centers via batch workload temporal shifting. An averaging-based resource usage processing method is developed to map fine-resolution CPU, GPU and memory usage into unified time intervals compatible with power system operation. A workload temporal scheduling model is then formulated to shift batch workloads while preserving execution continuity, delay constraints, and server resource capacities, and is coupled with a utilization-dependent server power model to translate workload scheduling decisions into server power demand. Two complementary flexibility metrics are evaluated: short-term peak demand shaving and the maximum duration of sustained power reduction. Numerical results based on real GPU cluster traces demonstrate that workload temporal shifting can provide quantifiable and grid-compatible demand flexibility for AI data centers with limited disruption to computing workloads.

</details>
